nag chu sa gnas srid gros dbu brnyes nas lo sum cu 'khor bar rten 'brel zhu ba'i ched bsgrigs/ /// /// / / :rdo / /:)nag chu sa gnas da sa rgyus ga gnas dpyad ga rgyu cha rtso ma sgrig khang nas bskrun/

'go brjod/nag chu sa gnas srid gros dbu brnyes nas lo ngo sum cu 'khor bar rten 'brel zhu ched 'di khul lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i yig cha re zung gcig sdud kyis rtsom sgrig zhus yod pa 'di dag gzigs pa po'i snyan lam du'ajug pa'i tshig gi sbyor bas dben na'ang don gyi cha nas yig rnyeng lo rgyus gtan tshig gzhir bzung dang rgan rabs myo nga ba can gyi 4‘dngos gsum gyi rgyu cha'i khog sbubs rig pas dbye zhib kyis mthud sbyor byas te rtsom sgrig byas pa zhig yen pas dpyad gzhi'i rin thang cung zad lda na srid/ de yang rangare'i khul gyi grub cha'i khongs gtogs stod smad gnyis kyi lo rgyus te stod nag tshang tsho khag gi lo rgyus dang / smad hor tsho so dgu'i lo rgyus rags tsam zhig yin pa de dag de snga deb ga' na gyi nang du thor bur bkod yod rung phyogs gcig tu sgrig rgyu byung med/ da res deb chung gcig gi nang du chatshang bsdu bkod thog bskyar zhus kha snon phran tsam dang / zhor du hor tsho khul gyi mi sna ming can ga rgya 'gram nag dang / ga tshab bar gyi 'ag0/ 'khrug skor gyi gnas tshul lo rgyus kyang phran bu zhig bsdu rtsom byas yod/nag chu sa khul gyi dbus dkyil byang rigs tsho pa'i lo rgyus ni 〈〈bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdam bsgrigs 〉〉kyi nang nas gzigs pa por spyan lam du bstar rgyu yin/

hor tsho so dgu'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ ( 1 )nag tshang tsho drug gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ la stod 'jam dbal/(60)tsho pa khag bgos kyi byung stangs/ (65)nag tshang du 'godapon sogs do dam mi sna rim byung dang 'gan dbang spyod stangs 'ga' zhig skor/ (69)tsho drug gi gzhung khral sgrub rgyug byed phyogs skor/ (76)dmag don so so'i skor/ (79)'go dpon so so'i thob thang skor/ (81)gzhung tshong dang rdzong sdod nas 'bam tshong 'phar brdabs byas skor/ (81)gegs bar byung skor/ (86)sngar srol byed sgo 'ga' zhig (87) — /de//de

hor ga rgya 'gram nag gi lo rgyus rags baspusadang ga tshab 'khrugs pa'i skor//ga rgya rang gi skor/ (92) ga tshab 'khrug pa'i skor/ (96)tshab shis btargyar dgra lan slog pa'i skor/ 0(104)ga rgyas tshab shir dgra sha zangs pa'i sko ra/ (111)ga rgyasakha'abum rgyud dpon bsad pa'i skor/ ( 114)ga 'azhagabar gyi don rkyen skor/ (115)byang spyi pha lhas ga rgya bsad pa'i skor/ (118)tshab shi ma rnam pha yul du logapa'i skor/ (125)ri ba dang ga rgya 'khyags ba'i skor/skam bkra 'das khar bcar 'dri zas pa/ ( 129)

da /blo/mi da /rdo(8 dzog rtar so dgu'i rgyus mdar bsdus/hor tsho so dgu ni/ da lta'i chab mdo mnga' khongs kyi steng chen rdzong dang / nag chu'i mnga' khul sbra chen rdzong dang / 'bri ru rdzong /snyan rong rdzong bcas rdzong khag bzhi'i sa khul yin/ yul de'i spyi ming hor zhes pa'i don ni hor ni so ga po'i mi rgyud (da lta 'i g.yung drung rgyal ba'i mi rabs gong ma )kyis sa khu‘ba der dbang sgyur byed kyi yod pa'i rkyen gyis dpon ming sde la thogs pa dang / tsho pa so dgu zer ba ni tsho khag gam shog kha sum cu so dgu yod par zer/ nam rgyun rgan rabs rnams kyis hor tsho rang nyid kyi lo rgyus shod skabs/ sog dus/ rgya dus/ bod dus gsum zer shod srol yod pa de ni skabs so so'i srid 'dzin khongs gtogs kyi 'brel ba'i 'gyur ldog la brten nas bshad pa zhig red/dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha ni 〈〈hor gyi rgyal rabs don 'dus nyi zer dru ba 〉dang 〈〈khyung rabs g.yu mgo ma 〉〉dang 〈〈gong sdon ma 〉〉de min 〈hor ye ba dpon gyi bka' gtan 〉〉dum zhig bcas 'di ga'i yig tshags nang nyar yod pa de dag dang / gzhan yang rgan rabs kyi ngag rgyun dang zung 'brel byas nas hor tsho so dgu yi lo rgyus 'di klog pa po rnams la dpyad gzhir 'bul rgyu yin/ dang po/ hor tsho'i sa khul 'di'i thog ma'i ma sde'i skor ha cang lde1

ba'i dus 'di khul sum pa'i stong bu chung zer ba phyi ltar zhang zhung sgo pa'i khongs su gtogs pa dang / nang ltar sum pa'i mnga' ris yin zhing /zhang zhung gi lo rgyus nang zhang zhung sgo pug bar gsum gyi sgo pa'i shel le rgya dkar zer ba de steng chen rdzong gi mnga' khongs su yod/ sum pa glang gi gyem shod zer ba de yang steng chen rdzong khongs gyang sngon chus la yod/ 'onakyang hor tsho de sum pa'i cha shas las cha tshang ma yin/ de bzhin yul skad nang du/ zhang skad lhag 'phro yod pa rang 'thag la 'chigadang / migal dmig sogs zer ba dang / zhang zhung gi dmar yig che chung yang bsdad yod pa red/ lo rgyus khag gcig nang smad a mdo'i khul la sum pa zer ba de ni yul gzhan zhig yin/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis zhang rgyalali mi rgya bkrong pa'i skabs su/ zhang rgyal ni sum pa'i yul du 'dun ma la'agro ba'i lam du dwang ra dung phug nas sgug ste bkrongs pa'i lo rgyus yod la zhang bod gcig gyur rjes sum pa'am cor tsho'i sa gnas 'di bzhin bod kyi khongs su gtoḍa kyi yod pas ma tshad/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum dang /bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug ces dbye ba'i skabs/hor tsho'i sa khul 'di la mdo khams rngul rdza zal mo sgang stod zer zhing sa gnas 'di'i lho rgyud dang shar rgyud sa babs cung dro ba'i khul du sngar nas yul sde yod cing de'ang mang che ba sa ma 'brog yin/ rgyal nang gi rgang ma hupa'i li se tshen han gyis sa skya 'gron margan 'phags par gsang sngags kyi 1/ji //)ste /rdo/blo /gri/rdo //blo/ /lnga// ////dbang ngas ga sa pa zhu dus da la kha gsum phul ba sa pa nang 2

mdo stod rta yi chol kha'i khongs su gtoḍa/ dud grangs ni sum pa'i stong sde'i cha shas tsam yin pas mang po med pa smos ci dgos/ nub rgyud dang byang rgyud rnams su gtan sdod kyi yul sde med cing / rkyang 'brong dang gnyanasogs ri dwags kyis bzung yod pa red/ 'on kyang nye dus sa 'og dur khung nas thon pa'i mi rus dang chabs cig sbas pa'i gzi/ 'chong mdog ldan lcags rigs kyi yo chas sogs la bltas na snga tsam zhig nas yul sde yod pa'am/ yang na pres su sde 'phe la rgyas kyis der thog mar gsar chags skabs dur sa sbas gnong ba'i goms gshis yod pa gang yin dpyad pa bya rgyu/de min ngar ngos 'ji na dka' ba'i dgonashul dang / khang mtsher gyi shul mal la nga yod pa red/hor tsho so dgu'i sa mtshams thug sa ni shar chab mdo dang / ri bo che/ byang mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi nang chen dang rdza stod 'bri dmar soḍa/ nub byang rigs kyi a mdo dang / nag chu/ lho lha ri dang /dpal 'bar/ lho rdzong sogs la thug yod/gnyis pa/ rgang ma yon rgyal rabs skabs hor khyung gnyis kyi sa gnas 'dir dbang sgyur byas pa'i sko ra/ khyung po ni zhang bod rgyal rabs thog ma'i skabs kyi bla mchod kyi mi rgyud yin pa dang / bod sil bu kha 'thoraskabs su khyungapo'i rgyud pa rnams stod mnga' ris sa khul du sdod ma bde ba'i gnas tshul byung nas mdo smad rma yul sogs sa gnas mang por kha 'thor skabs der khyung po mu lang sku mched ni gtsang dang dbus/ kong3

po/ spo po/ steng chen sogs brgyud 'dan khog la song zhing / de'i mi rgyud kyi mi rabs kha shas der gzhis chags kyang sbra gur phub ste sgar pa'i rnam pa yod bzo 'dug /spyi lo'i dus rabs gnyis pa'i stod du khyung po'igadung rabs kyi bla ma dam pa zhung sgom dang mkhas pa khyung dbus sogs rgyu bsgyu1/ /// /shes /)rdo — //// (1kyi /de /rngordog nga — da zhu gdan zheng du zhu —la bdang / zhu ston —sa nachen/ gzhan yang bon zhig khyung nag sogs dang mjal bdang / dbusagatsang khams sogs bon yod gar yod phebs te bstan pa dang 'dulabya skyong tshul gyi lo rgyus yod la/ 'bri gung bka' rgyud dang 'brelab byung ba'i bo sogs skabs 'dir bstan bya ma yin pas bkod med/ dbon po khyung dbus rin po che shes rab rgyal mtshan yang ging mas rjes su bzung nas mu yi gdan sa soḍa la gnas mjal chos zhuḍa dang dbus gtsang khamasathogs bon yul rnams su 'dul byar phebs pa dang gya ti la sngon te steng chen sa khul gyi rma mda' kha nas gser ri'i gzhung du pheb4pa/ de sngon — nas ོgnas der yod mus kyi rgya rigs yin pa'i dpon po rgya gtsug dator nyi ma 'brug grags zer ba zhig yod skad des rang gi gdan sa khyung bo baphulate khong nye 'khor stos bcas nang khul du loganas khong gi bdabon thob dang / rdzong gzhis sa zhing / 'bangs sde bcas khyung bo la phubab khyung pos bdagatu mdzad/ khyung dbus rin po che khong btsun pa yin stabs khong gi dbon po khyung bla ma dang / khyung po nang chen grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs drangs te yul de'i jus srid skyong dgos tshul bshad/ de

dus khyung dbus shes rab rgyal mtshan khong gi spun mched dang / nye 'khoraltos bcas dbus kyi byi'u lung mda' zer sar yod pa dang / 'dab sdod khrom tshang a sdis kyis sog dmag gi gser yig dngul bre sogs dngos po rkus nas khyung po rta rwar skung ba'i rkyen gyis khyung po tshang la ngan khag phog ste/ sog gi dmag dpon dor rdo dang / ye rtag gnyis kyi dpung gis khyung dbus shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi spun khyung po dpon dge dang /dpon dbus gnyis byang sde'i rtsa ras ded nas bkrongs pa dang / dbon bokhyung a bla zer ba'i phru gu de sog dmagagis sog yul du khrid song ba/sog dmag tsho gcig gis khyung 5bus shes rab rgyal mtshan rjes 'ded byed skabs rngul chu pha ri shagarang brag gseb zhig na bor song ba dad /ring min khong sa der sku gshegs nas zhal chems ltar chibs rta rje lding khyung 'bri gung gcung rin po che la phul ba red/ gcung rin po che ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i 'gor bzhuḍa yod stabs de dang khyung posas gnas 'dir dbang sgyur ba dus mnyam yin pas da bar lo bdun brgya lhag song yod pa rtogs thub/ khong gi zhal chems ltar sog yul nas gcung a bla sha ba rang grol gdan zhus kyis dus de nal bzung sa gnas 'dir khyung pos dbang sgyur ba dang / yul ming yang khyung po'i yul zhes btags pa red/ khrom tshang zhes pa'i mi sde de khyung pos mdo smad nas khrid yong ba'i lo rgyus 'dug a bla'i spun khyung po nang chen grags pa'ang gad na sar phebs/ khyung rabs nang 'khod don tsa khyung po nang chen ༵ḍa — —

la gong ma se chen han nas stag marga nor bu gcig pa/ las chib shel gyi tham ka/ ba so'i thi'u dmar tham rdzi/ bstan shed skyed pa'i 'ja' sa/gsal sgron 'are9 byad kyi 'ja' lce 'khrul kyi me long / gnarma don yon gyi las ka/ sa don yon gyi las ka/ chen po don yon gyi las ka/ mang po don yon gyi las ka rnams bkod 7 ces dang ‘‘don yon ni 7bon zhe4 pa'i don yin pas bon gyi mnga' bdag chen po'i don red/ yang khyung po nang tshen graḍa pa la rgang ma chan pos gsung bkod gnang ba ‘‘khyung rgyal nang chenagraḍa pa khyod khyung a bla bzhuḍa sar yar phebs dang / rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing klad na non/ chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa de zur du bkod ’ ces dang 6‘stod 'bri gung jo 'dab pyin chad/ smad tsha ba'i khab so yan chadakyi sa dang yul sde'i bdagathob gnang zhes sogs 'khod yod pa ma zad/khyung rgyal nang chen grags pa gong ma'i bka' yi gnang ba thob nas yar byon ‘ rgya ston dpon dga' ba gling khri'i sa khyung po steng chen du chos khrims gnyis kyi gra sgrig gis khrims gnyis rnga sgras gnam sa khengs par byas zhes pa sogs khyung po'i thob thang dang khyung phos sa gnas 'dir dbang sgyur byas lugs zhib tsam 'khod yod pa dang / de rjes mi rabs 'ga' shas song rjes khyung po dpon tshang rgyal ba grub kyi dus su khyung po sku mched rnams sde brgas byas te spun che bas dkar ru/ 'bring pas ser tsha/ chung bas nag ru bzung 4dkar ru la ri lung brgyad/ zhe zam chu/ sta zor/ sme lung / yar gdong mar gdong / gres mda'i pha bong phan chad/ gas 6

gyi sdo rdzong yan chad/ ze mo sgang gi phan chad bzhag ser tsha la julachu 'dus so'i phar tshur sa shod de'u dmar yan chad/ gam gang la mtsho gnyis tshur bcad/ lce yi bragal tshur bcad bzhag (lce brag la sogs byang ngos sa cha rnams da lta mtsho sngon gyis bzung yod )nag ru la gres phu lung dang gcig ko mda'i gres 'phong yan gyi bar/ smad nas 'gis brag g.yu mtsho/ 'dzag chu sngon mo'i zhol bcas bzhag ces dang de rjes mi rabs mang tsam song rjes khyung po 'bum rje grags pa'i dus (khyung po ser tsha yin )ma yig g.yu marga ma nas dum zhig drangs pa ‘‘'bum rje graḍa pa denyid dpung chen dmag las byas nas/ na dmar mtsho kha phyin chad dang /'bri 'dam byang yul tshun chad/ dngul chu gser ldan yan chad/ sa mi 'gyur rdzong gzhis bco brgyad bzhag sgar thog mgron po'i ja khral blangs zhes dang / bya ze dmar mo ja yig brdung / gong gsum btsan gyi 'grim lam na/ dgra 'dul mthing mkhar sdon po brdung /nu gzhung dgra yi 'grin lam la/ dgra thal bar brlag pa'i thal rdzong brdung / ri glang chen 'gying 'dra'i ri mgo na/ rdzong smug po gu lang khrag gis brdung / lci stod lci smad sa mtshams na/ lci yi ra tsa rdzong 'go brdung / ber 'grong gnyis la sa mtshams byas/ rke rdzi mkhar dkara'o mas brdung / sgom sde tsho la sa mtshams byas/ shag gi sbang du zam so na/ bum rje'i shel dkar smug chung brdung / stod smad hor bod dbang du bsdus/ sog lha ri lha rtse lha mkhar gsum/ khyung po skyid kyi mkhar gsum 7— — ———/de———

brdung / mi dpon dar thoḍa brgya re 'tshoḍa/ pho ngar chen mang po g.yas ru phab/ rma dang dpal skyim bar mtshams na/ stod na rgyal po seng ge rdzong /bar na blon po skya ga rdzong / smad na g.yog mo khru da rdzong / sa mi 'chug pa yi rdzong gsum brdung / lho sa dmar rdzi'i bu drug na/ ru sha rgya gnyis kyi khral de blangs/ gresamada' bya nag byis rdzong brdung / khra nag gnyis la gte nag dkris/ mang tshe'i gang mkhar skya bo brdung / ris gsar g.yasakyi stag dong yin/ stag mda'i stag rdzong khra yag brdung / khrom tshang g.yon gyi gzig shub yin/ ra skyes srin po kha dmar brdung / 'bru rong poganyis la gnya' sga gtad/ ging sdon nyag gi lam gong du/ gser gyi ka ba 1da chung brdung / rgya dbusamagron po'i lam khral blangs/ de rdzong gzhis bco brgyad yin tshul lo/ yang khyung po 'bum rje grags pa des/'dam gong ba rgyal gyi dbu rtse na/ gsas mkhar 'dra 'dra bcu gsum bkod/ 'bri 'dam sa yi ming yang blangs/ 'dam cog la mtshar rtse mtshar gyis bstod/ stod gyang smug po ja yis bstod/ shis lcaḍa 'o ma rgod kyis/ bstod/ 'dam rgyal chen bco brgyad mi the ba'i/ 'dam mi ming thob pa'i ri gsum de/ 'dam sa ma ri yi tshe brtan dang / tshe brtan nu bo tshe 'phel dang / tshe brtan nu bo tshe dkar gsum/ ri de tsho'i sa bdag khyung pos byas/ 'dam gyi rgyal chen bco brgyad nang / khyung po ser tsha'i bla ri la/ 'dam gong ma rgyal gyi 'bod med de/ dpa' bo so byas pa 'dra/ gtsug na rgyal sa bzung 'dra'i ri/ khyung po 'bum rje graḍa8

pa yis/ gsas mkhar gtod pa'i bkra shis so/ khyung dkar nag gnyis kyibla ri ni/ 'dam khri btsan rjes dbu zur de/ pha bla ma gdan la bzhugs 'dra zer/ khyung a bla sha ba rang grol gyis/ gsas mkhar gtod pa don 'grub bo/ khyung tshab tsha mdo dpon gyi bla ri ni/ 'dam skya li rjes kyi byis rnying de/ bo rgyus med sa mtha' bud pa 'dra/ bud nas rgyal sa zinapa 'dra/ khyung tshab tshas gsas mkhar der gtod na/ a mdo yul du bstanapa dar/ zhes so (ci brag la mda' zug dang / 'dam rgyal chen bco brgyad/ mang che ba da lta mtsho sngon gyis bzung yod )yang nyin la rkyang 'phrang bco brgyad rgyab/ srib la ja khral dang la khral len/ nyin srib bar la bza' tshang 'khon/ mdzo g.yag gu 'phag rgyag rnga ma tsub khyor/ zhing mu lam zhug so gas kyi khrims mang / yul re la sa zhing la sa gte 'byog par rtswagate bzhag de yan la dpon dang g.yog cher med/ da lta ser tsha tshang gi dgos riḍa thams cad sgar pa 'bum rje dang / nang pa drung chen gnyis kyi dus la gte dgos pa'i dus yin/ khyung po rgyal ba'i dus la sog g.yag la se bo phyir bcad/ gzi nag po ger pa yan chad/ khyung po 'bum rje'i phur pa btab/ radam rgyal chen bco brgyad dang / kham zor kha nag po tshun bcad gsas mkhar brtsegs mi khra rgan a 'bum yin 7zhes 'khod 'dug pa don du khyung po 'bum rje grags pa zer ba de stobs 'byor che tsam byung yod pa las de min khyung po'i dpon rabs rim dus da lta'i steng tshen shan gyi sa khul 'di rang la dbang sgyur byed kyi yod pa 'dra/9

khyung rabs rnams kyi nang du dpon rabs dang / bla rabs gong 'og 'dresakhyon che ba dang / brda rnying gi tshig nyob go ma bde ba mang po yod par re zhig zhib cha'i dpyad pa ma byas pa gal che don chen dang 'brel ba yod pa'i dpon rabs kha shas las bkod med/hor gyi rgyal rabs ni/ dang thog yon rgyal rabs kyi gong ma chen po'i rgyal rabs dgu pa/ thog mi mur gyi sku mched chung ba/ gu ron o lon tha'i ji zer ba de/ ngo 'khor rta pa bdun (a chen 'thor pa skya bdun zer )dang bcas sog yulanas bod yul gtsang sa skya'i phyogs su khagatad nas yong pa'i lam bar mi med lung stong mang po zhig brgyud dgos stabs lam nor thebs te sog na ra khug (da lta spra chen rdzong bon sog chus/ bra 'o shang sog gru khug )tu sleb pa dang / de gar sha ba brngon mkhan khyi ra ba 'ga' dang 'phrad nas mnyam du song zhing / mar tsam na sog gad dmar zer sa der slebs te gzhi nas yul sde dang 'phrad/kho tsho ni mda' rta dpa' rtsal 'gran zla bral bas yul de yi dpon por bkur/ lha rtse rdzong zer ba chags yul (da lta sog rdzong dang / spra chenardzong bar )'cham chu mar kha la rdzong gzhis bzung nas bsdad/ yul de'i bu mo kha btags bza' zhig lcam du bzhes shing yul sde de mnga' dbang sgyur/ rogs mi drug po yang yul der gnyen sgrig nas gzhis chags/ mi detsho'i mi rgyud da lta'ang bsdad yod/ o lon tha'i ji khong gi ming gzhan/ir ti cog la zer ba dang / de ga'i bod rigs yul sde rnams kyis khong 10

(15 /blo/ the rga / // /rmi/ lha/rto /rdo1/bye/dpa' rtsal bas kun las rgyal sa ma na btaḍa/ nga ra rgyal mi rabs dang po yin zhing khong dang gong mari rgyal rabs gab gtug nas rtsis na lo drug brgya lhag song yod/ 'di la sras rgyud ma byung bas slar sog yul du song nas/ khong gi sku mched thog thig mur gyi sras 'bring ba u yug rgyal zhes pa gdan drangs/ de dang mnyam du sog po dud rabs bzhi bcu sde skal du rag nas mnyam khrid byas yod pa red/ khong ni hor rgyal po'i mi rabs gnyis pa red/ rgya ston sde pa'i sras mo gu ru skyid khab tu bzhes par sras gsum yod pa'i nang / che ba rgyal po dmar pos yab kyigadan sa bzung ba rgyal rabs gsum pa yin/ dgung lo brgya dang bco lngathub zer/ spun 'bring ba rgyal po dkar po 'bri gung rgya ma khri khang du song ba gzim shag hor khang gi mi rgyud red zer srol yod pa brtag dpyad bya rgyu/chung ba rgyal po nag po 'jang yul du song nas 'jang gi sa sgo gong ma blangasazer/ skabs der kurma bka' rgyud kyi bstan pa hor yul du dar/ de'i gong bon po yin/ de nas hor tsho'i phyed tsam bon chos dang de 'phro ban chos spyod / chung shos hor nag shes rab rgyal mtshan steng chen khul gnas chen ngu ra rgyal gang bzang soḍa dben gnas bzung / rgyal po dmar po'i sras ya ga rgyal po rgyal rabs bzhi pa yin/ de'i sra sa rgyal po phag mo rgyal rabs lnga pa yin/ de sras gnyis kyi nang rgyal po bsod nams rgyal gyis gdan sa skyong ba rgyal rabs drug pa yin/ de la sras bzhi yod pa'i nang che ba hor stag las yab kyi gdan sa bzung ba de rgyal rabs bdun pa 11

yin/ skabs der hor dmag nang chen la song nas nang chen mnga' 'ogatu bsdus/ dpon rgan stag la'i sras bdun gyi nang nas bkra shis yab kyi gdan sa skyong ba rgyal rabs brgyad pa yin/ de sras drug gi nang hor lha rgyal dar nas lo rgyus thog nas snyan grags ha cang che zhing dpa' rtsal 'gran zla bral ba zhig yin/ nang chen yab mes kyis dus hor 'og btsud par cha gnas ma byas stabs slar yang hor dmag dpung chen btegs nas nangachen pham par bzos/ nang chen o mo (bu mo )sdor shus la song ba 'phroḍa/ nang chen la nas khal brgya dang brgyad kyi khralabakal de rjes tshang gsar sde la dmag rgyab nas dbang 'og tu btsud/ de rjesarag shus la rgyab nas rta brang gsum phabs/ rta khral hor la 'jal rgyu byas/ de rjes9ri boche la brgyab nas ri ches rta brgya phul/ de rjes rgya ston labargyab nas rgya stonadrung pas rta brgya phul/ naḍa blon gnyis nas mdzo brgya phul/ byang rta sga khal dmag sgar rgyab/ skya mda' chos rjes nas khal brgyad cu phrag gnyis phul/de rjes nag shod rgyug rkyang khyims gzhung la dmag sgar brgyab/ 'bes sdo leb kyis nas khal brgyad cu phul/ nag shod tsho drug mgo btaḍa zhus/ de rjes lha ri mar rtsar rgyug smi thi gzhung la dmag sgar brgyab/ smad ma khag gsum mgo btags zhus/ de ru dkar nag ser gsum brgyab/ khyung gnyis la la dmag sgar brgyab/ nas khal stong dang nyis brgya'i khral bkal/ sgang dkar nag gnyis kyis mgo btags zhus/ nas khal brgya dang lnga bcu'i khral bkal/ cha 'phong kha la rdzong gzhis chaḍa/ yang 'brug yul la dmag rgyag 12

skabs (khyims mtshes rgyal khab 'brug pa )'brug pa'i gser 'phru mda' yis gtor/ 'brug pa'i go khrab tsha ga zhus rgan gyi gris bcad/ dmag dponabasad rta brgya dar btags blang zhes dang / hor jing gir se chen rgyal po la blon po ba yan nang chen yod/ 'bru rong po gnyis la gnya' sga gtad/ sgang dkar nag gnyis la bre rgya bcings/ kong jo mo rdzong lamada'achar phab/ ces sogs hor gyis rting ma ches cher gleng rgyu yod/ dus de nas bzung hor tsho gcig gyur chags pa red/ de'i gong hor sde (da lta'i sbra tshen dang / sog rdzong )gi cha shas tsam yin/ khyung po'i yul (da lta'i steng chen dang sog )gi cha shas bzung yod pa phud/ nag shod 'bri ru ni de skabs zur du yod pa dang / snyan rong mar rdza be sog ni gzhi nas yul sde chags 'go tshugs pa'i bzo 'dug khyung po 'bum rje grags pa'i skabs ha lam hor tsho dbang sgyur myong ba 'dra bo 'dug lha rgyal dar gyi spun chung ba dkon mchog rgyal ni rgyal rabs dgu pa yin/khong gis yab kyi gdan sa bzung / rgyal sa ba chen du spos (da lta sbra chen shan gyi sbra chen chus chags sa )sku mched kun thub rgyal sog gad dmar du sa bzung ba sog dpon tshang zer/ lha rgyal dar cham mdar rang 'jags bzhugs/ dkon rgyal gyi dus su mnga' thang je mthor song ba dang /dbang sgyur gyi sgrig gzhi cha tshang du btang ste ‘ srung kha'i bon po drug cu/yang chen sum cu/ blon chen yang chung sum cu/ blon chung rgan chen nyishu/ rgan chung nyi shu/ rgan 'bring nyi shu sogs yod/ smad o lod rgyal 13

khag gi bka' shog dang / yig tshang blangs ba ma zad/ gong sa lnga pa'i she bam sogs rgya bod yig tshang gi bdag po'ang yin pa'i lo rgyus 'dugagong ma ming rgyal rabs kyi dus skabs su mtsho sngon sog po rgyal po'i 'og tuhor tsho so dgu 'di bzhin dem chi nyer lnga dang de min gyi zi leng skye rgu'i khongs gtogs sog ste bcas bsdoms tsho khag bdun cu don dgu byas nas mnyam du dbang sgyur byas yod pa dang / lo gsum re'i mtshams su dud tshang brgya res rta re mtsho sngon du khral lam skyes 'bul zhu dgos pa dang / rta ma 'byor na dngul rgya srang brgyad cu 'jal dgos/ hor gyirgyal rabs rim par tha'i ji'i go gnas dang tham ka/ 'ja' sa/ yig tshang bcas yod pa red/ thang ka ni sdig pa rwa nyag rkos pa yin/ gong gsal gyi dus rim nas 'go btsuḍa cor rgyal po la nang khral rgyug rgyu'i lam lugasakyang rim bzhin chags yod pa dper na nang sde 'brog 'og dang / bon tha drug cu sogs la spus sgyur zer ba'i mar khral zhabs rim dgu chen btsa' byed dgu sha dang dgu lci yul sde shog dgu ste dmar ru/ ris/ gsar/ nyin tha/ srib tha/ tsha 'brong / nems tsha/ ral sum/ 'dre dgasdom pa/ yang pa bcas nas 'bru khral/ ar rdza gnyis nas bul khra' dang re khral sogs sgrub rgyug lam srol chags/ khyang po dkar nag ser gsum sosor so so'i mnga' khongs nas 'bru khral/ mar khral/ sha dang / lci 'ing sogs/ kyi khral rgyug dgos/ sog sde dpon la sog sde rang shog dang / khri nde bcas kyis khral rgyug dgos pa dang me tha dpon la spus sgyur zer ba'i 14

mar khral dang / dgu sha dgu lci sogs dang / de min dpon khag so sor rang nyid kyi thob thang che chung dang / lo rgyus ring thung ltar khral rgyug dgos pa'i lam srol chags pa red/ dpon khag gi byung stangs ni/ hor spyi khyab tshang gi ma rgyud las 'chad pa/ ye tha dang / bon tha/ drug cu soḍa kyi dpon rgyud/ de byings tsho stod dang / nag shod dpon khag mang po zhig ni sog po'i mi rgyud yin zhing / sog sde dpon ni hor rgyal po dang 'gal ba byung ste sog po thor rgod kyi mi rgyud dang sde skal dud bdun bcas sog yul nas gdan drangs pa red/ sgang ru dpon sogayo'aga' zheg ni sngar khyung po'i blon chen red/ de 'og so hrug gi 'go pa rda ro khani rgan po yin/ bskul 'ded bsdu gtong byed mi er chi ring thung ni horadang 'dra ba red/ tsho khag byung stangs thad khyung dkar nag ser gsum dpon spun gsum nang bgos byas nas tsho khag gsum byung ba/ de rjes ser tsha la bya ze dang / sgar khang gnyis gyes pa/ rdor shul stod smad gnyis gyes pa dkar ru stod smad gnyis gyes pa/ sma khrom gnyis ni smad nas stod du khyung por mgo btaḍa zhus nas yong ba/ hor ni bod sog pa dang khag gnyisasu gyes pa de la hor thog 'og ste/ ye tha dang / 'brog shod kha gnyis ye tha las sog sde 'brog shod la bon tha drug cu bcas gyes pa/ a graḍa dngardza dmar ni khams smad nas stod du yong ba a grags la stod smad gnyis rdzadamar la sger gzhung gsum ste rdza dmar gzhung / ge mo bra bo gsum gyes/ beru ni hor rgyal po'i mgo btaḍa gras yin/ ris gsar la nyin tha dang /15

srib tha gnyis/ btags tsha la nem tsha dang / 'dre dag ras sum sogs gyes tshul gzhi rtsa'i thog rtogs thub cing / nag rog dang bu yum sen tsha gsum rgya ston khongs nas hor la mgo btags zhus pa 'dra/ nag shod tsho drug dang / lho nem khri rdo'i tsho pa khag gcig byung stangs gsal por ma rtogs/ byang 'bri tsha'i tsha mtsho ni sog sde ba tsha a rgan gyis rnyed nas hor rgyal por phul ba de nas bzung hor tsho'i tsha len sa red/ (1531)lorasog po cha har len tan rgyal pos mtsho sdon gyi rgyal po gtor rjes bod sogazang zing gi nang hor tsho 'di bzhin khongs gtogs kyi 'brel ba nges gtanamed kyang sog sde so dgu zer ba'i zer srol rang 'jag gnas/ re dkar sog gsum ni (da lta sog rdzong )dang po hor sde yin (1541)lor gu shī bstan 'dzin choca/ rgyal gyis rgyal dbang lnga par khams rdzong drug phul zer ba'i nang gi rdzong gcig red/ dkon mchog rgyal gyi sras chu nga ba jo bo rgyal yab kyi gdan sa bzung ba rgyal rabs bcu pa yin/ cho lo ni u cing tha'i ji'i mtshan gsol/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus 'gor khong gi slar yang mong gol rje bo de ching kho 'o'u cher 'brel ba btsugs/de 'phral bod kyi srid skyong lha bzang han nas pho lha mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal can dpung dmag dang bcas hor tsho'i sa khul du btang ste/ hor rgyal po u cing thu ji la drag shugs kyis mgo sgu ra zhu ru bcug ste/ rta bcu phrag kha shas blangs rjes mnga' 'og tu gnas rgyu khas blang / jo bo rgyal la sras gsum yod pa'i nang khri dpon rgyal ni rgyal 16

rabs bcu gcig pa yin/ de'o skabs su a sa khan (amaban )rbad du 'byor ba dang (1723)lor pho lha mi dbang can rgya bod dpung dmag hor tsho dang / mtsho sngon bod rigs sa khul lhing 'jags byed par ched btang thog nag shod/ hor kha bzhi khyung po dkar nag ser gsum/ rdo shul stod smad (hor tsho )'brong pa stod smad lus shul (mtshosngon ) mi khyim khri phrag gnyis gong ma mchod yon gyi chab 'og tu bcug ces 〈〈mi dbang rtogs brjod 〉〉gsal gong gsal hor gyi rgyal rabs bcu gcig khar/ hor stag la'i spun dbang lu dang / dkon mchog rgyal gyi spun lha rgyal dar gnyis la tha'i ji'i go gnas yod pas hor spyi khyab par hor ser po'i dus tha'i ji bcu gsum zer srol yod pared/ sog sde sum cu so dgu rgya sde sum cu so dgu la bsgyur dgos don ni/ nang khul du gong mayon rabs dang ming rabs kyi dbang sgyur mjug sgril ba dang / ching gong ma'i skabs bod kyi sa khongs so sor srid 'dzin lam lugs 'thus sgo tshang du song ba dang / lhag par gong ma'i blon chen am ban bod sdod lam lugs ba tsugs rjes sog pos hor tsho la dbang sgyur ma thub pas red/gsum ba/ ching gong ma'i blon chen gyis hor tsho dbang sgyuragatong ba'i skor/ jo bo rgyal gyi chun ma ga bza' sngon mo'i sras bzhi'i nang khri rgyal rjes yab kyi gdan sa bzung ba rgyal rabs bcu gnyis pa yin/ yung ṭing khrilo dgu pa/ (1731)lor mtsho sngon du bca' sdod blon chen dbos hri chesazi khron bca' sdod krang kri/ bod sdod na shun ker ho tho gsum gyis sog 17

sde tsho pa bdun bcu don dgu de sa mtshams bzos nas dem chi sogs tsho 4 baṣṭha bcu tham pa mtsho sdon du sbyar ba dang / tsho pa so dgu zi khron du sbya ra ba/ them dud brgya re yan gyi 'go par bre hu dang / brgya ma zin pa'i 'go par bī cang / brgya lhag bī hu'i zhabs su bī cang bcas bskos/skabs de'i hor tsho'i them tho'i ngo bshus nang / nag shod nga ma pa ('gom )nag shod 'bri ru/ nag bom phan/ nag shod ta khe lu (sta / drug )nag shod la se (rag shi )nag shod se khra khra ring / shog drug la dud grangs/ 108(sger gzhung gsum khag bgos med )ar graḍa dud 49ar smad dud 12hor khrom tshang dud 42hor rdza dmar so tha (sog sde)dud 15hor rdza dmar so tha ki jo wa la gnyis la (phri rdo dang cung pa'i smad )dud/ 77hor('brog shog )112dmar ru nyin tha nem tsha/ khra ma sbu ma (tsha 'phong )bzhil dud 113nyi ya mo pa (nyi mo )nyi su dmar pa (nyin tha)li ta kha (srib tha )rdo ba/ mar pa (sdom pa )rong po bcas shog kha lnga la dud/ 105hor (drug cu)dud ca5ye rong hor (ye tha )dud 131bon tha hor dang se cor gnyis (bon tha dang rag 'i shog chung gnyis bon thar mnyam du zla 'grilab )la dud/ 53stod sgang ru/ smad sgang ru gnyis la dud 144khyang po na khu lu (nag ru )dud 477 byung po ka lo stod (dkar stod )khyung po ka lo smad (dkar smad )gnyis la dud 1004byung po ser tsha bya sgar gnyis mnyam du dud 587rdo shus stod smad gnyis la dud 137sen tsha dud 31bu rdzum dud/ 17 gong gsal dud grangs la gzhir bzung sngar lam 18

dud brgya rer rta re rtsis rta dngul la sgyur nas dngul rgya srang brgyad cu tham pa/ dud rer dngul rgya zho brgyad re rtsis pa'i dngul khral lo rer thengs re lha sdod am ban sar skyel dgos de la mang tshogs kyis rgya rgang ma'i dngul khral skar ma phyed brgyad dang / lo dgu'i khral dgu yang zer srol yod/ khral skyel mkhan la am ban nas lag rtags dngos lo dang /dud tshang rer gong ma'i phogs g.yu zer g.yu re sprod srol yod pa red/ lhaskyong khri banugs bcu gcig pa'i skabs hor bī hu khri rgyal rje rgang ma chen pos dbu phe'u ho khri dang / sngar lam shog kha bcu gcig gi 'arga 'dom byed rgyu dang / khral bsdu'i bza' sgo rang 'jags khar rgang ma chen po'i blon po'i gras su bcug khong ni tsho pa so dgu dang dem chi nyar lnga bcas kyi spyi khyab dā bī hu yin lugs 'khod 'dug de nas bī hu khri rgyal gyi sras che ba lha mkhar bstan rgyal gyis yab kyi rgyal sa bzung ba rgyal rabs bcu gsum pa yin/ lha skyong khri lo lnga bcu gcig par sbyar che kra dā lo yer nas khong la hor tsho so dgu'i bī hu dang bre cang drug cu re grangs kyi tsung brehu la bskos/ lha mkhar bstan rgyal dang / gshen bza' dpal 'dzin la sras gnyis yod pa'i nang / tshe ring rab brtan yab kyi rgyal sa bzung ba rgyal rabaca bcu bzhi pa yin/ bca' chin khri lo bzhi pa spyi lo (1803lor dwa lo ye nas tshe ring rab brtan la sngar srol dbu ba'o rtsal yod pa — red/ lha mkhar bstan rgyal gyi btsun mo chung ba/ khor bza' lha mo la sras gsum yod pa'i chung ba tshe dbang rgyal nas gdan sa bzung ba rgyal 19

rabs bco lnga pa yin/ khong la bca' chin khri lo nyer bzhi pa spyi lo ( 1811)lor tsung chen hu'i go gnas dang dbu ba'o rtsal ba dang /dmen hu'i go gnas rgyud 'dzin gyi bka' gtan sprad/ de'i sras gsum gyinang nas khri dbang rab brtan yab kyi rgyal sar skyong pa rgyal rabs bcu drugapa yin/ khong la rda'o kong khri lo bcu gnyis pa'i skabs dbu le'o thob thangartsal/ de'i sras gsum pa'i nang nor bu dbang rgyas gyis yab kyi gdan sa bskyangs pa rgyal rabs bcu bdun pa yin/ zhan spung khri lo gnyis pa (1855)lor rgar dmag gis bod la btsan 'dzul skabs/ bod sdod blon chen am ban gyis bskul bsnga ltar hor tsho'i dmag chig stong dmag dpon hor spyi khyab kyi sku tshab stong dpon rdo dga' btang ba dang / kho tshos rgar dmag tshar gcod kyi don du byasarjes bzhag par hor spyi khyab la byu ru'i tog chu mig bcu gsum rma bya'i ldem sgro thig drug skor zer ba dang / stong dpon rang nyid la dwang shel mu men gyi tog dang / o rog gi ldem sogs gzigs bzos rtsal/ nor bu dbang rgyal 'das rjes khong gi sku mched rnam rgyal dbang 'dus btsun pa yin pas khri las babs rogs zhus te rgyal sa bzung ba rgyal rabs bco brgyad pa yin/ khong khri las babs pa'i sdom bshagabon 'brog gnyis nas blu phug dgon la bu gsum bar ma'i grwa khral rgyug rgyu khas len byas (1859)thung ṭi khri zhuḍa lnga pa'i dus rnam rgyal dbang 'dus la ho kri dang cho lo byin/ thung ṭi khri lo dgu par byu ru'i tog dang / rmabya'i ldem gnang / rnam rgyal dbang 'dus kyi sku mched bkra shis dbang rgyal 20

gyis spyanga'athing gong du dpon tshang gzhis chags hor drug cu'i dpon rabs rdzoḍa tshar stabs drug cu'i dpon 'gan blangs/ khong ni dpa' rtsal shin tu che bas marga log gi tshur rgol rjes 'ded kyis tsho dem bar 'dam dkyil ri'i shar snarararga log sgar chen mi grangs lnga brgya lhag gcig kyang ma lus pa rtsa med bzos/ de min rgya bodabaka' don ltar sdo yu dang nyag skad sogs jag tshogs mang po gtor bar byasarjes gzigs bzos thob/ dpon bkra shis kyi sras gnyisanang tshe dbang lha rgyal rgyal sar bskos pa rgyal rabs bcudabu pa yin/ kong shu khri bzhugs nyi shu pa (spyi lo 1889)lor khong la dbu the'o dang mthong gsos rtsal/ kong shu khri bzhugs so gcig pa 1905lor nang khul gyi 'arga pa 'ga' zhig dang 'gal ba byung zhing /de'i nangakhong gi dpon rgyud kyi bgos dud chu kha dpon tshang rnam rgyal lha ralanas hor spyi'i dpon gnas rang nyid kyis 'phrog thub pa'i tshed du tshe dbang lha rgyal yab sras yum bcas gzim chung du lkog bkrongs byas pa'i 1do/ /rte/ cashe 15 1sdo /rtswa/ /re /rje/ /rngo/ (rngo/ chesgo /ze/na na dag da da na na cagam ban nas sa dra ra ra ba sku tshab btang nas zhib 'jug gis lag dmar ba the la grwa pa dang gtsang bsabarke bcad nas srog thog gi nyes chad gtong skabs der mang tshogs kyisakhrims ma drang ba'i gleng phyogs yod pa red/ nyes don phugs gtug byed mkhan phyira'adon du ma bcug pa/ (ga rgya rgyu dkar dang lha dge gzi dkar )sogs la zer gyi yod/gong gsal bī hu khri rgyal rje nas tshe dbang lha rgyal bar rgyal rabs 21

brgyad la rgan rabs rnams kyis rgya nag po'i dus kyi chen hu brgyad zer srol yod/ tshe dbang lha rgyal rkyen 'das rjes 1905lor lo phyed ring dkar ru rpā hu spyad rta mgrin dbang rgyal hor spyi'i dpon tshab byas / lo de'i lo mjug tu me tha hu rpā hor rgyal po'i mi rgyud yin pa'i nor bu dbang rgyal de hor rgyal po'i gdan sar 'bod (1910)lor shon thong khri bzhugs skabs nor bu dbang rgyal 'das tshab tu sku mched tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gdan sar 'khod/ chu glang / (1913)lor dmag 'khrug byung nas bod sdod blonachen gyes hor tsho do dam bya rgyu'i dbang cha shor ba red/bod sdod am ban gyis dbang sgyur byed pa'i dus rim nang hor tsho yongs lahor spyi khyab rgyal po'i 'og che hu gnyis/ rpā hu bcu gsum/ bre cang bani bcu yod pa dang / hor sgye khyab kyi rgyal gzhis pho brang ni a dkar dgon pa zer ba de yin/ der thog brtsegs nyis thog can khang mig bzhibacu skor yod/ hor sbra khri 'dus stong thong zer ba'i re ba'i spra nag de'i rgya khyon ni spyi khre gru ba ne ma drug brgya'i tshad tsam yod bzo 'dug nor sbrakhag kha shas dang / rta sbra bcas yod/ pho brang du nang rten gser zangs kyi rnam par rgyal ba'i sku brnyan thog brtsegs gnyis slebs pa sogs gser sku dang mchod sdong grangs mang / bon po'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur lhag par rtsa che'i rten dri med shel sku sogs yod/ a dkar dgon gyibla grwa ni hor spyi khyab kyi bla mchod yin pas thor spyi khyab kye zhabs brtan sgrub dgos/ der bla ma dang dbu dge gnyer sogs dgon pa'i sgrig gzhi 22

cha tshang yod/ de'i nang sngags chen bcu gnyis zer ba cung thob thang che ba yod pa red/ de min hor spyi khyab kyi nang blon smug po che brgyad/ phyiblon rag pa che bzhi/ phyag mdzod dang gnyer pa drung yig gsol dpon/gzim dpon bcas yod pa ma zad/ chu 'thung brgya dang brgyad cu zer ba'i sku srung dang mngags gtong sogs don du mi grangs bcu phrag kha shas nor dpon dang / rta dpon sogs dang ma byan dang / chu len/ yos 'thag sogs nang g.yog bcu lhag tsam/ nor rdzi dang / rta rdzi sogs phyi g.yog bcu lhag yod cing / khong gi mnga' khongs nang sde tsho pa so dgu'i khar/ phyi sde mgo btags khag lnga shog drug zer ba yod pa rjes su be ru ma gtogs hor tsho'i khongs su tshud/ dgon sde'i skor hor khyung gnyis kyithog mar dbang bsgyur nas bzung / sog g.yung drung gling gtsos dgon sde che chung bcu phrag kha shas sog dmag gis gtor shul yod pa dang / bon po dang / rnying ma/ bka' rgyud gsum gyi dgon ste 'ga' zhig phyis dgelugs par zhwa bsgyur ba yang yod/ de nas bzung bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dbang ma bsgyur bar du rim bzhin phyag btabs pa'i hor tsho yongs la bon dgon sum cu so brgyad/ ban dgon te bka' dge rnying gsum gyi dgon pa bzhi bcu tham pa yod de'i nang bon po'i bla sprul thob thang che shos—klu phug so brgyad mkhan po dang / de 'arga rtse drug sprul sku/ rgyab ri'i bla ma/ spa dgon dbu bla/ bon dgon sprul sku sogs yin/ ban de'i bla sprul thob thang che shos stag phu sprul sku/ chag ri nyi grags/ 'bri ru23———— — —

zhabs drung sogs red/ grwa grangs ni dgon pa che bar mang shos sum brgya skor dang / ri khrod rnams de'i gras su the med/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dbang bsgyur rjes phyag btab pa'i dgon sde yang 'ga' zhig yod4/thon skyed skor/ 'brogalas dang / zhing las yod pa phud zhor lad gtso bo/ 'brong / sha ba/ gla ba sogs ri dwags brngon rgyu rgya che tsam byedasrol yad kyang / bod sa gnas sred gzhung gis dbang sgyur skabs khral 'khur lci ru song bas dus tshod dkon pa dang / bkag ri rngon rgya yang dam po yod pas snga lam khyi rwa rgyag sro‘pa ha lam med par gyur/ de min shing bzo dang / rdo bzo lcags bzo/ dngul bzo/ lug rgyagapar brko ba/ ri mo ba/ yig 'bri ba/ rdo ba rko ba/ tshem bu ba/'thag las pa/ 'phyeng bzo ba/ mnyed mkhan sob/ sa/ de'i nang khyung po'i lha 'bri ba dang yig 'bri ba ni bod yongs kyi nang lag rtsal ang dang po red/ 5 steng tshen rgyud du yod ) rig gnas rgyu rtsal skor/bod spyi 'brelagyi bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas/ bon chos gnyis ku'i lugs dar khyab 'bring tsam dang de'i nang sman bcos lag rtsal cung drag pa yod/gzhas dang / zhabs bro/ ras pa/ ge sar sgrung / sgrung thang dang gtam dpe/ lde'u sogs kyi khar/ rta rgyug mda' 'phen zhar 'phen/gong 'gyur shed tshad pa/ shugs rdo 'gyog pa sogs cung dar khyab che tsamayod/ sho sbag sogs rgyan rtsed yod pa ma zad/ lha phab rgyu sogs kyang rtsed mo'i gras su brtsi/ gom gshis bza' bca'i skor zhing khul thug pa dang /24

chang 'thung ba mang / 'brog khul du mar spyod pa dang / sha rjen zos—mang ba yod/ 'bru riḍa gtso bo byed/ spyir skad luḍa dang gyon chas sogs khyung po dang / hor nag shod tsho stod sogs spyir btang 'dra ba'i phyogs yod la/ mi 'dra ba'i phyogs kyang yod pa red/ gyon pa pho chas ni ra lug pags tshags dang / snam bu sogs kyi mtha' rgyan nag po gos sna thung ba/ lhar yu ring / dgun zhwa wa dang tshar ru/ dbyar zhwa sgar zhwa/ skra ltag phud/ glo 'dornga lnga zer ba khab 'bug gri me lcaḍa bzhi/ de thog phor shub kyang 'dokha / phyoḍa thon skabs sngar dus mda' mdung gri gsum/bar du bod sngo da dang gri mdung / rjes su 'phrul mda' dang / gri rgyab gā bcas yin/ mo chas paḍa tshags snam bu'i mtha' rgyan can bzhi rgyan dang /gsuporgyan/ nyis rgyan gos sna ring ba/ lham yu ring / dgun zhwa wa dang tshararu / dbyar zhwa ra gos dang sbrags 'bying zhu'am snam bu/ dor ma gyon srol med mgo skra khyung po phud/ de bying lan zhib mang la g.yu byur dang / dngulachas kyi skra rgyan mang ba/ sged la sked chab darnga glo la bzho char las/ gdub/sor gdub/ ske ga soḍa 'dokha/ gzab mchor ska bas pho mo khyad med ste rgyan/rna rgyan/ glo rgyan dngul thag thoḍa pa/ sdod sa byang 'brog sbra dang / lho rong mkhar/ gzhan rnams sbra mkhar gnyis su sdod/ 'das 'jug ni so so'i chos lugs dang bstun nas zhib rgyas che tsam byed/ gnyen sgrig mdzad sgo'i gtam 'don dang / ston mo sogs 'khos 'byor la dpag pa'i rgyas gshom che tsam byed/ de min dgon ste'i lo ltar gyi dus chen dang / yul 25

so so'i spyi rim sogs kyi thog spro skyid 'du 'a dzomasakyi byed sgo spel ba dang /lo gsar gnyis 'os 'tshamasashig gtong srol yod/ hor rgyalapo sogs dpon rigs che gras kyi bu sring gtong len dang / gshin po'i 'das 'jug mi ser gyi lag nas bsdu srol yod/ dpon rigs chung ba rnams nas rang nyid nas 'gro song gtong dgos/ rgang gsal thon skyed dang /latsho ba/ goms gshis rig gnas sogs lo rgyus 'phel rgyas song ba dang chabs cig dal bu'i sgo nas 'gyur ldog byung yod kyang zhibaphra ma bkod/bzhi pa/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis hor tsho'i khul du dbang sgyur pa gtong ba'i skor/ rgya sde so dgu bod sde so dgu 'a bsgyur dasos don ni/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis bod la btsan 'dzul byasapa dang / nang khul du lo rgyus 'phel rgyas song ste lcangs phag gsar brje lang pa'i mjug 'bras yin/ gang yin zhe na/ gal te btsan rgyal ring luḍa kyis bod du btsan 'dzul byasamed pa dang / rgyal nang du lcags phag gsar brje langs medapa yin na/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis gong ma'i srid gzhung la kha gtad mjal mi phod la/ bod sdod am ban dang / lu'u cun dmag bcas phyir skrod byed mi thub pa shem gsal red/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis chu byi dang chu glang (1911)dang (1913)lo gnyis nang bod sdod gong ma'i blon chen am ban dang / gong ma chen pos bod srung skyobs su ched gtong lu'u cun dmag bcas bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas phyir 'bud byed skabs lu'u cun 'thor dmag lnga bcu zhig hor 26

tsho'i sa gnas rgyud phyir bros byas par bod dmag gi mda' dpon ra ga shag dang / mda' dpon gnang byung ba/ mda' dpon bying pa bcas snga rting gi slebs pa dang / de thog sog rdzong re dkar sog gsum dmag dang rgyal ston lding dgu'i dmag lho star sho gsum khyung po nag ru bcas kyi rgyab snon dpung dmag bsdus te gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis rjes 'ded btang bas lu'u cun dmag la nang khul lcags phag gsar brje'i dus skabasayin pas dpung snon 'byor ma thub pa dang / tsho khul nas nag shod dang /ser tshwa sgang ru/ khyung po dkar ru sogs lam rgyud nas dmag snon nyung shas ma gtogs bsdu ma thub rkyen/ 'bri ru dang / ser tshwa/ steng cheno bcas dmag sa gsum nas khams sde hor tsho'i sa gnas yongasardzoḍa bod dmag la shor ba red/ bod dmag gis lam 'khel sde dgon mi bsad rgyu 'phrog mkhar dngos mer bsregs tshangs chen bzos pa'i dgon shul dngagrong shul da dung mthong rgyu yod pa dang / mnar gcod 'khel ba'i sa khul dang khyim dud tshos zhib gsal shod rgyu yod pa red/ shing stag (1914)lorabod sa gnas srid gzhung gis de sngo na bod sdod am ban gyi 'dzin skyong sa khul rnams se ra dgon par sprod rtsis kyis se ra nas mkhan po ngo 'khor bcuskor zhig ched gtong gis ring/ gyis sde rtsis len skabs ga re 'gag (da lta steng chen shan khongs )tu sgang ga tha zer ba'i yul sde rnams nas sa gnasasrid gzhung gi dbang sgyur nyan ma 'dod pas steb gcig tu langs te se ramakhan po ngo 'khong mang che ba dmar gsod btang ba red/ de rjes bod 27—— — —— — —

sa gnas srid gzhung nas mda' dpon bkras mthong dang / mda' dpon khyung ram dmag bcas dang / me 'brug (1915)lo hor tsho khul du srid 'dzin hor spyi dang po mkhan chung grags rnam btang thog khong gi sa gcig nas chu glang g.yul 'khrug skabs lu'u cun dmag dang 'brelaba'i don rkyen zhib 'jug gis mi 'bor ha cang mang po zhig srog thog dang /dbang po gcod bregs sogs lus thog gi khrims gcod byasab/ khyim dud mang po'i mkhar dbang yongs rdzogs dang / 'ga' shas mkhar dbang byedatsam gzhung bzhes btang ba/ de min 'brel yod sa khul gyi khyimadud tshang mar rgyu nor gyi nyes chad sna tshogs btang khar bod mda' yongs rdzogs bsdus te bod mda' ngo grangs khri gcig 'bri yi tshab byas nas hor tsho'i sa khul du bkrams pa khral la bsgyur nas 'char can gyi me she zhes zer zhing se ra mkhan po gsod mkhan sgang ru de shog kha byed mi chog pa sde dud mang tshe bdamar ru la sbyar ba dang / kha shas khrom tshang la sbyar ba ma zad sgang ru'i bre hu dang / bī cang gi go gnas dus gtan du bskyar gso byed mi chog pa byas/dkar dpon rang shi brgyab/ dkar dpon gyi za sgo yongs rdzoḍa gzhung 'dzin byas mdor na don rkyen de'i skor rgyu lus kyi nyes pa phog pa'i khyim dud stong phrag brgal yod pa red / graḍa rnam gyis gcig nas rgya bod g.yul 'khrug skor gyi don rkyen bskyar zhib dang / zhor du rku rgyag jag khrims soḍa nyes donagazhan dag kyang thag gcod drag po byas pa red/ gnyisanas mi'i zhib gzhungabazos te khral 'ul gyi lam lugs btsugs pa der me 'brug zhib gzhung zer28

zhing de skabs hor tshor them dud dgu stong lhag yod pa dang / tshugs skyel 'dren gyi lam lugs rdzong skyel dang / sa skyel gzhung lam dang 4tshuḍasogs zhib phra'i gtan 'bebs byas nas me 'brug gan rgya bzos/ gsumanas lder yod hor tsho'i dpon khag rnams kyi rga gnas gsar pa gtan 'bebs byas pa de'i nang hor spyi khyab rgyal po'i tshab tu sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' don ltar grags rnam rang gis byasapa dang / de snga'i hor spyi'i mi rgyud dang / dkar ru/ stag drug sogs chen hu rnams kyangabre hu'i gras su bzhag rpā hu rnams la ngapon gnas lnga par bsgyur ba de gras dpon khag bcu bzhi/ tsho pa rer bre cang re dpon gnas drug par bsgyur ba de gras/ 25 bre hu'i 'og gi bī cang rnams lding dpon du bsgyur ba de gras 43 de 'og blon po dang / rgan po rang 'jagasasu bzhag yod pa red/ tsho pa so dgu'i nang khul nas kyang lcags thag lag sbrel gyi gan rgya zer ba zhig bzhag myong ba red/ bzhi nas 'bri ru dang / stengachen ni sngar lam chen hu gnyis bzhugs yul yin pa ma zad lu'u cun dmag dang 'khrug pa'i g.yul sa yin pas gnon stems stabs bde yong tshed sa gnas de gsum la rdzong re brgyabayod pa red/ sngar nas skabs der tsho dem sa mtshamasabaskyar sgrig gis hor spyi graḍa rnam ngo tshab ru dpon la shar ba dang / mi ser spyi 'thus hor 'brog shog rgyu ne bsod rgyal mtsho sdon zi ling gi ngo tshab bcas kyis sa mtshams 'damachus phar bcad tshur bcad yin pa gtan 'khel bzos pa de skabs mtshams bar stong mang po 29

zhig zi ling gi khongs su sngar med gsar bzos kyis chud songab de dag sde dmangasakyi blo la ma babs par sog sde sogs byang sde 'ga' zhig 'dam chu brgal nas go bo ri gseb sogs su skya spos byed bzhin yod pa red/de rjesagrags rnam rang nyid ni hor tsho'i sa gnas steng chen du grongasab red/ hor spyi gnyisapa rim bzhi sman spel skabs hor blon ga rgya bstan dar gtsos cor tshos kha gtad byas te phar par bzos pa dang hor spyi gsum pa mkhan chung g.yu thog de'i skabs hor blon ga rgya bstan dar 1—nu )/tho /de/ /bye/ /ji/ rwabye /sdu//bye/ //rmiphyag ma da ba sa pa dang / nga ba ga'u nga —ra ba ba gzhung ga sa pa de blangs skabs hor tsho yongs la them dud khri gcig dang nyer bzhi zin pa dang / sngar hor rgyal po'i sger sde mgo btagasakhag lnga shog drug nang be ri tsho gcig rtsis nas tsho khongasasu bzhag sngar yod za sgo rnams ga rgyas/ gzhung 'bul byas/ hor spyi bzhi pa rim bzhi ka shod pa'i slabs su/ hor blon ga rgya bstan dar gtsos pas gyen sdog bya rtsis byasapar/ 'go pa 'ga' zhig la tshabs che'i nyes brdung dang mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes/ than dmar gsod kyang btang yod cing gyod gzhi de mthar sa gnas srid gzhung rang nas thag bcad pa red/ hor spyi lnga pa mkhan chung grags pa rgya mtsho nas sngar rgyun ltar khral bsdu khrims gnon gyi las ka byasapa/ hor spyi drug pa rim bzhi snye mo mdo mkhar skabs su'ang spyir btang rgyun ldan ltar khral bsdu khrims gnon byed kyi yod cing / skabs de dus kyang hor—tsho'i 'go dmangs kyis ngo rgol byas ba'i lo rgyus 'dug hor spyi bdun pa 30

mkhan chung thub bstan pad ma'i skabs sngar bzhin khral bsdu khrims gnon byed mur nag shod rag shi'i sa gnas su grongs pa red/ hor spyi brgyadapa rim bzhi khyung ram pa'i skabs/ sa stag zhib gzhung zer ba zhib tshags ha cang che ba zhig bzo rtsis byas kyang ma grub pa dang / de skabs bon tha'i kho ngas nas rga rna ron rgyal zer ba zhig gis nang khongs 'gal bar brten nas ste dum zhig dang mnyam du rwa bla'i rgyal thog dus mgo btags zhus pa red/ (rjes su bod zhi ba'i bcing 'grol gtong skabs klu zog tsho pa zer zhing da lta u pe shang zer ba de red/) hor spyi dgu pa stag brag gzim dpon mkhan po'i skabs/ tsho stod nas hor blon ga rgya 'gram nag gi4nang khul tshab shi dang phyi ru mtsho sdon dem chi'i khongs dge rgyas ri bar dgra brgyab pa'i don rkyen byung yod pa red/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis tsho khul du hor spyi'i srid dbang sgrig 'dzugs byasastabs hor tsho'i dpon rigasarnams kyis phyogs gcig nas rang nyid kyi dbang sgyur rgyun 'khyongs thub pa dang sra brtan gtong ched/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis sprad pa'i go gnas dang / laca/ 'gan dang len zhus pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas khong tshor mes rgyal gyi 'du shes shugs chen yod pa dang / shā—/ sngar lam hor rgyal po'i mi rgyud spyi khyab ma bskos par sems gting nas rme rangs mi byed pa ma zad/ 'khon du bzung gi yod/ der hor rgyal mi rgyud 'brog dpon la sngar lam brtsi bkur bya rgyu dang / tsho pa su zhig la gong 'og gang thad nas gtser bsun byung tshe gcig rgyab gcig snon bya rgyu sogs skyid sdug /1—— ————

mnya tsomyong byed rgyu'i lcags ga lag sbrel gyi gan rgya bzhag yod pa red/rje su hor spyi dang hor tsho'i 'go dmangs bar 'gal ba che tsam byung skabasartar tsho'i 'go pa mang che ba mnyam sbrel gyisahor spyir kha gtad gcogagi lod kyang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis kha bral bzo gi yod stabs gdung shugs gcig gyur rang byed thub kyi med/ dper na cor tsho'i dpon khag gam/ mi drag re zung gis go skabs dang bstun nas bod sa gnas gzhung gi pang du 'byar rtsis byed mkhacha yang byung yod/ 'go pa spruga' shas kyis hor spyi rim bzhi sman spel dang / ri ma bzhi ka shod pa rim bzhi khyung ram bcas la kha gtad byasayod cing / skabs der bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis kyang hor spyi de tsho'i las 'gan ma 'then rang 'then byung yod pa red/ de rjes bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis tsho pa'i thun mong gi skyid sdug kha bral ma byasan nam zhig gyen ldog yong rgyur blogasanas rtsa 'dzugs kyi byed thabs spyad de tsho khongs/ zhung sde rnyeng pa rnams rdang gcigamatshungs bya rgyu'i jus gzhi gsar pa zhig bton pa ste/ chu rta (1941)lor bod nga/ ba/nas sri da gzhung nas hor tsho rdzong khag drwag la bgor/ pa dkar stod/ dkar smad/ nag ru/ rdor shus stod ma/ rdor shus5 smad ma bcas la steng chen rdzong dang bya ze dang sgar khong gnyis la ser tsha rdzong /dmar ru dang khrom tshang rma rong / nyin tha/ srib tha/ nyin mo bcas la/lho pa shog drug dang / jem tsha/ 'dre dag sdom pa/ yang pa/ ral gsumabacas nem tsha shog lnga/ de thog khri rdo gnyisabasnan par khri rdo rdzong 32

'brog shog dang / ye tha/ bon tha drug cu bcas la sbra chen rdzong / ar stod/ kyigar smad/ rdza dmar bra bo/ ge mo/ sog sde/ be ri bcas la snyan rong rdzong / 'bri ru dang / khra ring / stag drug 'argam/ rag shi bomaphan bcas sdom nag shod tsho drug dang / nag rog bu yum sen tsha bcas nag shod tsho dgu la 'bri ru rdzong bcas rdzong 'go khag drug la bgos pa red/ rdzang so sor dzo nga sdod ser skya zung re bslos pa dang / sprod zhib ser skya bcas lhan bzhi je 4 gyi sa khyi/ba gzhung gsum pa chu rta zhib gzhung zerab blangs skabs der 'or tsho yongs la dud grangs brgyad stong lhag yod skad 'dug de nas ba3 nga ho ra tsho sa khul 'di bzhin rdzong sdod so sos do dmabyed kyi yo 1 pa dang / spyi'i do dam nag chu'i byang brgyud spyi 'doms pa'i 'og tu tshud kyi yod pa dang / chu rta/ (1941)lo nas ce gas yos (1957)lo bar lo bcu skor rdzong sdod brje len thengs gsum re byung yod pa dang / skabs der 'bri ru rdzong zhabs nag shod tsho dgu ni stang/ brag rgyal thog la mgo btags nas sger sde'i khongs su tshud rjes rdzong dpon yang stag brag bla brang nas gtong gi yod pa dang / gzhung khral zhi drag rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khral rigs zhar chag mi chog khar stag brag bla brang la sger khral yang 'phar ma 'jal dgosapa byung yod/ sa gnas srid gzhung ste bod sde pa gzhung gi dbang sgyur skabs 'char can gyi khral rigs ga mar dang / ga dngul/ 'bru phud/ me she/ mdzod sbug she mar/ 'bu rdza/khri dkar mdo las shog ritsha dmag dod dngul/ 'bras spungs ri khral 33

so gas rdzong sgo so sor gcig gyur min pa'i khral yang 'ga' zhig yod pa/hor spyi'i skabs them tshar them srang dang / rta thab sdod sgrig bzhu mar lag g.yog rdzong gi skabs rdzong gi sgrig sgo tha na btson lto yan sgrub dgos/da dung sa tshiḍa khag mang gi sdod sgrib /dang / rta khal mi gsum so rung bcasargyun 'dzugs dgos/ 'char 'phar gyi khral zer ba khag 'dogasasna tshogs kyi khral 'phar/ 'bam tshong spus sgyur/ bun skyed che gtong so gas sne mang rtog 'dzing gi mang tshogs la khur po ha cang lci po yod/ bcings 'grol ma zin bar sa gnas srid gzhung gis hor tsho pa'i khul du dbang sgyur lo sum cu so drug byed ring dang / lhag par bcing 'grol zin nye'i skabs sde pa gzhung gis khamasaskyod dpon dmag rgyun ma chad pa mang du 'gro gi yod pa de tshor sdod sgrig dang skyel 'dren rdzogasargyu med pa zhu dgos pa ma zad/ tsho khul gyi sa gnas khyung po steng chen dang / ser tsha/ khri rdo/spra chen/ 'bri ru snyan rong sogs la bod dmag khag bgos kyi bca' sdodabyed kyi yod pa dang / 'grul bzhud kyang sa tshigs yod med la ma ltos par gang sa gang du rang snang gang shar gyis skyod kyi yod pa ma zad/ sa gnas srid gzhung gi tshwa sho dang / bal sho'i sho khral do dam pa ngo ma dang ngo tshab / sa srung 'go dmag bcas kyis 'grul lam gang 'khel gyi sa gnas so sor gtan sdod byas shing / byang spyi dang rdzong sdod so sos tshong las gnyer mkhan mi sna je mang du 'gro ba dang / tshang mar dmigs bsal gyi dbang cha nges can yod pas mang tshogs la nga/nga byung gis nyes 34

brdung dang / za bed brdabs mnar byed kyi yod pa red/chu spre (1931)lo nas 'go btsugs hor tsho'i yul dmag chig stong tham pa gla lto go lag rang 'grig bsdu thengs bzhi bsdus yod pa de ni khralapa dud tshang dgu rer dmag khral mi re bsdus shing mi 'gro ngo ma ni khral khur mi thub pa'i dbul phongs shig glas nas gtong ba dang / kha shas kyis dbul phongs shig 'ju bzung byas te dmag khongs su bcug pa soḍa mi 'dodabazhin du bsdus pa'i tsho pa'i dmag mi chig stong lhag tsam dang / de la spyi 'doms 'go 'dzin ma 2 dpon mi gcig dang / mi nyis brgya lnga bcu re la ru dpon re/ nya brgya re la brgya dpon re/ mi nyer lnga re la lding dpon re/ mi bcu re la bcu dpon re bcas dmag khongs de rang nas bskos yod cing / khong tshor dmag 'gro'i ring la ma gtogs go gnas med/ dmag gi sgrig srol dang dmag rtsal sbyong lugs sogs bod dmag byings dang 'dra zhing / dmag gi go lag dang / lto gos sogs 'gro gron rnams sa gnas srid gzhung gis sprod kyi med stabs dmag bdag mi ser rang nas lag 'don byed dgos pa dang / dmag gi thob thang yang bod dmag byings dang mi 'dra bar phyi nang dbye ba yod pa red/ tsho dmagade bzhin bsdu thengs bzhi bsdu myong yod pa'i bsdu thengs gsum ni rgyal nang du lu'u cun dmag 'gog srung ched du yin pa dang / thengs gcig nirwa spreng dang se rar dpung 'jug byed pa'i dmag snon ched du bsdus pa red/tsho dmag thengs dang po bsdus pa ni mtsho sngon dem chi nyer lnga'i nang chen co 35

rag khog bar btang yod cing / skabs de'i mda' dpon nag shod stag drug gi ldang 'chang a gur zhes pa de yin zhing / kho tshos bod dmag dang mnyam bskyod skabs lam khar rgyag res rgyag pa dang / nub rer mi tsho dang tsho byas nasarang yul du phyir bros byas pa red/ bsdu thengs bar ma gnyisani bas tsam ma gtogasadangos su dpung bskyod byed dgos byung med cing / bsdu thengs rjes balcagasastag (1950)lo mi dmangs bcing 'grol dmag bod du yong bar bkag 'argag bya rgyur tsho dmag gi nus shugs la shugs snon rgyag rgyu dang / hor tsho'i dmag gis bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi don du nus pa 'don spel byed ched dang thog hor tsho'i 'go pa rnams skong 'then byed par/ 'brog shog dpon ni hor rgyal po'i mi rgyud yin par brten mda' tshab kyi go gnas dang de 'og dmar ru dpon la ru dpon/ steng chen/ ser tsha/'bri ru/ snyan rong bcas rdzong khag bzhi'i nang dpon khag bzhi bskos te brgya dpon gyi 'gan 'khur rgyu'i gtan 'bebs byasayod/ bod dmag gi ang grangs sgrig srol ltar hor tsho'i dmag la yang tsa dang dmag sgar zhes btags te bod dmag gi gsham du mthud yod pa dang / mda' tshab kyi sku srung me mda' mde'u dgu 'gro kha shas dang / bdelasgam khashabakyang sprad yod pa red/ hor tsho'i dmag dngos su bsdu skab4sngar bzhin bod dmag dang rgyag res rgyag pa dang / mtshan nub rang khyim du phyir bro byas par nyes chad ji tsam bkal yang bskyar 'gug bskyar bros sha stagabyayostabs rgya 'ub 'du thabs bral te rang gnas su phyir slog byas pa red/36

gong gsalagyi gnas tshul thog nas hor tsho 'di bzhin bod ljongs kyibod riḍa sa khul zhig yin yang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis mes rgyal 0 dang kha bral te dbang sgyur bya rgyu de rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi blo la ches mi bab — pa zhig yin stabs ma'o kru'u zhis mi dmangs te mi dmangs kho na ni 'dzam gling lo rgyus gsar skrun byed mkhan gyi sgul shugs yin zhes gsung pa ltar srid dbang btsugs nas lo sum cu so drug ring g.yo 'gul dang 'thab rtsod kyi rnam pa brgyud nas dus 'das pa las / thabs brgya jus stong ji ltar byas kyang srid dbang sra brtan gtong thub pa byung med la/ mi sems 'gug thub pa zhig de bas kyang byung med pa gsal por mtshon yod pa red/sdon chad hor tsho 'di bzhin dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul re zung mgatogs/ spyir btang spyi khyab tsung chen hu dang / tsho pa so so'i dpon 'arga rnams kyis khrims 'dzin dbang cha spyod cing / khrims lugs kyang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi khrims srolaspyod kyi yod/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dbang bsgyur rjes khrims 'dzin dbang cha che shos spyod mkhan ni sngon chad hor spyi dang / de rjes byang spyi yin zhing / rdzong sngod dang tsho paso so'i dpon khag gis kyang dbang cha gang 'tshams shig spyod chog gi yod pa red/gtug bsher gyi 'gro stangs ni/ dang thog gyod ya 'gug 'bod byed par brda tho 'am/ yang na lag rtags zer ba rta lcag gam 'phrul mda'i mde'u/ g.yag rwa sogs skur ba dang / 'gug bya'i mi des bang 37

mi'i rkang gla 'jal dgos pa dang / lag rtags phyir 'bul zhu rten ngangos po yang 'bul dgos kyi yod/ gtug bsher mkhan phyogs gnyis nas khrims dpon la dang po mjal zhu dang / bar du skyabs rten zer ba'i dngul dngos thengs grangs kha shas 'buladagos/ yang na skyabs 'dzin phul te don spen son mtshams dnguladangos bu lon ji bzhin 'jaladagos kyi yod/ ngag rgyun du kha mchu gtug bsam na/ rgyal po mjal byed dar dang rgyal khrims nyo byed dngul dgos zer ba dang / kha mchu gtug mkhan yin na phu thung dar gyis gang / am khrag dngul gyis gang / kha nang gtam gyis gang dgos zhes zer srolayang yod pa red/ dngos gzhi'i gtug bsher skabs gyod ya'i zhu tshig rnams zhu tho 'am/ ngag zhus zhu res bcas byed chog spyir btang gi gyod gzhi rnams gyod yas su la zhus na des bdag sprod byed chog kyang me bsad gyod gzhi bsher khang nas thag gcod byed pa phud gyod gzhi che rigs hor spyi 'am/ rdzong sdod kyis thad kur bdag sprod byed cing / gal srid gyod ya phyogs gnyis kyis gsham 'og bar 'dum thag gcod bya rgyur blo mos yod tshe gong la nang seng zhu rten phul te slong 'bebs zhu dgos pa dang / thag chod zin rjes khrims 'deḍadang nyes chad kyi rgyu dngos gong 'bul byed dgos yang thengs dang po'i thog thag gcod dpyad khra gyod ya'i blo la ma bab pa dang yang na gyod gtug mkhan 'ga' zhig gis gyod ya dka' ngal bzo ched gzhung gtug zer ba bka' shag la gong zhu byed kyi yod cing / de yang khrims sa ji tsam mtho na38

de tsam gyi gyod gzhi zhib bsher gyi dus yun ring ba dang gyod don gyi 'gro song mang ba ma gtogs/ thag gcod drang 'brelayong khag po red/ spyir btang khrims sa 'ga' shas kyis gyod gzhi thag gcod kyi yun tshad ring du btang ste skyabs rten rgyu dngos thengs mang rag thabs byed kyi yod pa der mirnams kyis gyod mnar yang zer gyi yod/nyes gsog tu brtsi ba'i rigs ni mi bsad dang rku jag brgyab pa/rgyag res brgyab pa/ ri klung skam gsher gyi sngo na rgya bci /sa pa/ dbon pa'ichos khrims dang 'gal ba/ bla ngapon la thob thang ltar gyi gus lugs ma byas pa/ khrims thag bcad par gyen ldog byed pa sogs khrims 'gal du brtse gi yod/nyes chad ni gtso bo rigs gnyis te/ rgyu thog chad pa dang lus thog gi rtsa ra zer ba gnyis yin zhing rgyu thog gi chad pa ni gser srang gi grangs (gser srang gang rer dngul srang dgu dang zho drug re )sam phyugs zog dngul dngos/ tha na kha dbang gzhung bzhes bcas byed chog cing /lus thog gi rtsa ra ni/ mig ril 'don pa/ rkang lag gcod pa/ sna ngang rting rtsa bregs pa/ pus mo'i lha nga bkog pa/ rlung rtse'i nang 'jogapha/ sme la sgo dang / lag par a 'de bkon pa/ rkang lcags rgyag parta lcag dang / 'gram lcag zhu ba/ tshe btson dang dus bkag btson 'jug byed pa'i skabs su btson lto ni rta zam 'khel ba'i mi ser gyi lag nas bsdus te chu 'khol dang rtsam pa ltogs shi ma thebs tsam zhig sprod kyi 39/de ———

yod pa dang / btson lto 'am nang mis bskur ba'i btson gro bcas kyi nang nas btson srung gis kyang bar zos byed kyi yod/ btsona'ajug la'ang rigs gnyis yod cing / btson nag zer ba mun khang nang bcug ste skyag gcin yang nang du gtong dasos kyi yod/ rigs gcig ni bzang btson zer ba rta zam la rtsis sprad nas 'jo ga pa'ang yod/ gzhan yang rgyu nor yod na lus chad rgyu yes blus chog pa dang rgyu nor med na rgyu chad kyang phul / thog tu myong dgos kyi yod pa de la lug bal yod la bal dang nya spu med 'a khram zhes zer srolayod pa red/gyod don bden rdzun dbye ba 'byed thabs ni gyod ya phan tshun gnyis kyi zhu tshig dang / bar mi dpang tshig sogs lagani 'dzin dgos kyang / rnyog 'dzing che rigs la mna' bsher sho rgyag bcas kyi thabs shes la brten gyi yod cing / kha shas ni kha shugs dang rgyu shugs kyis bden rdzuna'abyed pa'i skabs dang / thag gcod byed pa'i skabs bcas la nus pa nges can thon gyi yod pa red/thag gcod byed stangs ni spyir btang khrims yig gzhir bzung bsad pa la stong dang rkus pa la 'jal/ rma kha khrag sbyor la rma 'jal/ khyo shuṇaphan tshun skyur na skyur 'jal/ ma nyes kha g.yog dang / dma' 'beb soḍal dkar 'don/ bla dpon gyi thugs dang 'gal na che bshags/ khyim tshanganang ma 'cham par bgos phud bzhi zur phud pa'i phyed ka khral rten de 'phros ma zur phyed 'khyer dang / tha na zhu tho'i 'bri stangs dang / kha 40

zhus kyi tshig sgros 'grig min tsam la'ang nyes chad 'gel gyi yod pa red/gzhi rkang khrims yig gzhir bzung thag gcod byed khul yang/ khrims dbon gyi 'dod blo'i rjes 'grel don dngos dang mi 'tsham pa'i thag gcod kyang byed kyi red/ de bzhin srid dbang 'dzin mkhan dpon rigs tshos gang byung nyes brdung btang nas shi bar phan tshun 'gebs srung byas te khrims nyes las g.yol gyi red/ thod dmag gis mi bsad na mi stong skaralnga re sprod dgos zhes zer srol yang yod/gong gsal de dag ni bod sa gnas yongs kyi gnas tshul dang gzhi rtsa'i thog gcing/ gyur yin ning hor tsho khul du lo sum cu so drug ring lag len bstar ba'i mig mthong lag zin gyi dmigs bsal gyi dpe mtshon gsham gsal/bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi hor spyi dang po mkhan chung grags rnam gyis cor tsho khuladu khrims don gsar pa lag len bstar skabs mes rgyal la blo dkar zhing lu'u cun dmag largyab skyor zhu rmyo nga mkhan tshang ma brtsad gcod kyis yang ba'i lus khrims btang yod pa dang / phyogs mtshungs nyes don gyi byo/da gzhi brtsad gcod byas te mi mang po mig ril bton pa dang / rkang lag bcad pa/ rting rtsa bca da pa/ sna breg pa byung po dkar stod tsho pa gcig sdo la sna 'bo brgyad cu zer ba yod/ btsonadu bcug pa/ rta lcag dang 'gram ñtsag zhu ba sogs byas/ te sdug gsod btang ba dang / dbang po yan lag ma tshang ba bzos yod pa ma zad/41——/de

mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes sogs rgyu nor btsan len gyi grangs tshad kyang ha cang mang po yod cing / steng chen dang / 'bri ru/ spra chen gsum la ched mngag gi btson khang dong 'og mun khang yang bzos yod pa red/chos lugs dgon de'i grub mthar yang the jus byas te tshang ma dge lugs par sgyur rgyu'i thabs shes byas yod kyang 'grub ma thub pa red/ skabs der mang tshogs kyis kho pa'i ming tsam thos na'ang dngangs skrag skye gi yod/ de rjes hor spyi rim byung gis grags rnams gyi byed stangs rgyun mthud de mang tshogs la ya nga ba'i lus khrims gtong rgyu dang / rgyu nor za rngam gcig las gcig che ba yod cing / kho pa tshos tsho pa so so'i dpon 'go'i bar gyi 'galab bed spyod byed pa sogs kha mchur brten nas rang nyid phyugapor 'gyur thabs byed pa tsam gyis ma tshad/ kho tsho'i dbang sgyur sra brtan gtong ba'i thabs shes shig kyang red/ de rjes hor spyi rim bzhi ka shod pa'i skabs bon 'brog drug gsum 'go pa kha shas nang 'ga' lo da pa bed spyad de /bo par rten bcar skyabs zhu yag po ca/ byung ba'i 'go pa 'ga' zhig khrims bcar dus 'gyangs song bar khag btags nas 'dzin bzung khrims gcod dang / 'ga' zhig sdug gsod btang bas ma tshad khyim dud mang po'i mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes btang yod pa red/ skabs der 'gopa kha shas 'u thug nas sa gnas srid gzhung la gong zhu byas pa'i rkyen gyis gyod ya rnams lha sar bka' shag la rtsis 'bul byas yod kyang / sa gnas srid gzhung gis mi de dag btson bcug dang / rta lcag thengs grangs mang42

po zhus te lo drug bdun tsam gyi rjes su gzhi nas thag gcod byung yod pa dang / gyod don de'i skor sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'brel yod dpon riḍarnams la skyabs rte na dang / lkog rngan nyes dngul sogs 'gro song bon drug 'brog gsum gyi mi ser thog nas khal g.yag chig stong lhag dang /bod dngul ṭam rdo stong phrag kha shas bcir len byas yod pa red/ skabs der 'brog drug gnyis ku'i las thog dpon po spyang 'thing nor bstan zer ba de'ang lha sar rgyad 'khrun ma chod gong grongs pa red/ de 'phros 'go parnams lus thog gi nyes chad lci po 'khur te srog ma thor tsam nas rang yul—du phyir log thub pa byung yod/gzhan yang dkar ru dpon dang / blon spyang ki bstan 'dzin bar gyi gyod gzhi dang / lho pa thog drug dang rong po rab brtan dgon pabar gyi gyod ga'i/ glu ting phur gsum dang sog tsan dan dgon pa bar gyirgyad gzhi/ ye tha dang khrom tshang bar gyi gyod gzhi/ sde khag nyi shu dang snyo lha ri bar gyi gyod gzhi bcas gyod gzhi che rigs mang po bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' shag dang / mdo spyi bka' shag gnyis kyis thadakar bdag sprod byas shing / skabs so sor skyabs rten so/gas gyod don 'gro song btang ba'i dngum ṭam rdo stong phrag mang po dang / khal ma brgya grangs/gzhan gyi dngos rigs phon 'bor gang che mi ser gyi thog nas bsdus te gtong dgos byung yod pa ma zad khrims bcar zhu mkhan mang che ba lus chada'akhur dgos byung ba dang / 'ga' zhig dpon gnas shor ba de ༵na /de——

khrims sa nas rang yul la log ma thub par shi ba sogs dka' ngal dang / gyong gun ha cang chen po myong ba las/ grub 'bras gang yang thob ma thubapa red/ skabs der mi rnams kyis gyod la mkhas na rgyu la gzan zhes shod sro‘pa yod pa red/hor spyi'i lam lugs de rdzong 'go'i lam lugs su bsgyur rjes su'angabyang rgyud spyi 'dom dang po mkhan chung pha lha ba'i skabs su hor sbra chem du tsho skor thengs gcig yong skabs hor gyi blon po ga rgya 'gram nag zer ba snyan grags nges can zhig yod pa der phrag dwog gis bkras tshang dpal ldan grags pa bed spyad nas mna' shag 'brel ba brgyud nas mgo skor btang stelkog gsod byas rjes kho pas mang tshogs lazhed nas rdzun chas spras te lam seng nag chur phyir log byas pa red/de bzhin byang spyi rim pa dang / rdzong 'go so so'i rdzong dpon rimapas khrims don lag len bstar skabs lus khrims btang nas sdug gsod byas pa dang / mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes/ phyogs mtshungs thabs brgyajus stong gi gyod ya phan tshun gnyis dang 'brel yod ltos bcas kyi rgyu nor 'bor chen btsir len byed pa ma zad/ khrims 'og tu shi ba'i mgo lag rdzong gi sgo 'gram du btags te mang tshogs lazhed snang yang skul gyi yod pa red/shog gyod kyi rigs dang / dgon ste dang bla dpon sger gyi rgyad don 'gro song yang mang tshogs kyi lag nas bsdu dpo/sa kyi yod pas bod sa 44

gnas srid gzhung gi khrims lugs ni dbang sgyur gral rim gyi khe phan srung skyobs byed pa dang / mi dmangs mang tshogs la gnya' gnon gtong ba'i lag cha yin pa tsam gyis ma tshad/ gyod gzhi la brten nas mang tshogs kyi rngul brag btsir len byas te dbang sgyur gral rim phyug po chags pa'i gal che'i bya thabs zhig tu brtsi gi yod pa red/mang tshogs kyi gnad don byung skabs mang che ba rang nyid la stabs bde yong ched sa gnas de rang gi dpon khag lazhu gtug byed kyi yod cingadapon khag so sos kyang sngar srolagyi khrims lugs gzhir bzung thog sa gnas srid gzhung gi khrims lugs dang zung 'brel byed par brten gyod don thog gi dpal 'byor gyi 'gro gron dang / nyes pa phog tshad cung chung tsam yong gi yod kyang gzhi rtsa'i thog hor tsho'i dpon khag so so yang sa gnas srid gzhung gi khrims la brten nas rang nyid kyi dbang sgyur srung skyob byed mkhan yin pas mi dmangs kyi khe phan ji bzhin mi sgrub pa smos ci dgos/ 'on kyang kho tsho rang nyid kyi yun ring nyams myong la brten phyogs gcig nas mang tshogs ladrag gnon byed kyi yod kyang / phyogs/ gzhan zhig nas mang tshogs kyi blo 'gug thabs kyis 'brel 'dris byed pa'i phyogs shig kyang yod pa red/hor tsho'i nang gi dpon khag nyung shas kyis bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas dmigs bsal dbang cha'i lag 'khyer blangs te mi ladabang po gcod breg gi khrims lugs spyod mkhan yang yod pa des rkyen bod sa gnas 45
