nag tshang tsho drug gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/stod 'angam dpal/nag tshang ni rang ljongs kyi sa mtho'i byang phyoḍa su gnas yod/ sa rgya tshe zhing rang byung thon khungs 'dzoms la gangs ri che chung dang / mtsho dang/mtshe'u mang ba/ mdzes sdug phun sum tshogs pa'i sa gnas shig yin/ de'i rgya khyon la lho nas byang bar khal tshugs kyi nyin lam nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / sharanas nub bar nyin lam bco lnga tsam yod cing / shar phyogs ni gnam ru dang / 'dam sa skya/ g.yag pa shing sger bcas dang 'brel nas yod padang / lho phyogs g.yag pa phru ma drug bcu dang / bzhad mthong smon/khams dos sogs dang 'brel nas yod/ nub phyogasamanga' ris skor gsum khongs phyogs bcu stod ma/ 'brong pa sger rtse bcas dang 'brel nas yod/ byang phyogs ni shin cang dang bod ljongs gnyis kyi samatshams suthug pa'i bar der mi med lung stong yin pas/ byang sa rgyab stong yang zer srol yod/ deng skabs la mtshon na nag tshang sdon ma'i mnga' khongs der da cha shan gsum tsam gnas pa dper na/ sba tsha thar ma shang phud shan tsha shan dang / se ba shang phud mtsho gnyis don gcod khu'u/'um bu don gcod khru'u/ nag tshang gi dwangs ra nang khog tu/ gnam 60

gshis tsha grang snyom zhing sa bab yag pa'i sa cha der/ 'um bu shang dang /phyug tsho shang / dwangs chu shang bcasal sa zhing gshin po yod la 'bru rigs kyi thon 'bab kyang cung mtho po yod thog phyugs zog dkar nag kyang yod pa'i sa ma 'brog yin pa dang / byang phyogs kyi sa cha khag gcig sargya che yang / rtswa chu mi 'dzoms thing sa sdo bye thang / brag ri sogs dang yang na tshwa chu bul chu/ mu zi'i chu sogs yod pas 'brog pa'i phyugs zog rtswa za'i mthun rkyen mi 'dzoms pa'i sa khul yin/ khul der skad grags yod pa'i bod kyi gang chen star sgo dang / rgyal khang lha mo zhal gang 'jam/shi yer gangs/ a 'ur gangs/ smu gal gangs/ rdza lashang gangs/gtsang se gangs sogs dung las dkar ba'i sa 'dzin mtho brjid gnam la reg pa ltar dang / gnas mchog dwang ra g.yu mtsho/ skye ri gnam mtsho/ zi leng bdud mtsho/ skya ring mtsho/ bzang mo mtsho/ rtsid bkud mtsho/ngang se'i mtsho bcas mtsho chen nam kha'i 'od mdangs sa la lhung 'dra 'dren byed lta na sdug pa'i ngo mtshar yod pa gna' dus mi tsho'i ri chu yul ljongs la bshad pa yod pa stod nag tshang sde la sde mthud/ gangs mu gal ri la rimathud/ mtsho skya ring mtsho la mtsho mthud/ phyugs dkar nag khyu la khyu mthud/ lha star sgo la tshes bdun rol brgyad/ shig nyin rgyud la mtho pobacu gsum/ da dung spyir btang la ri chu ming can dang / lha ri gnas ri gnyan ri sogs ji snyed cig yod pa dang / yul der ri dwaḍa 'brong /rkyang / rtsod/ sgo ba/ rna ba/ gnyan/ dred mong / gzig 61—— —————/de—— ———

gsa'/ spyang ki/ 'phar ba/ wa mo/ g.yi sogs rtsa che'i srog chaṇarigs sna tshogs dang / 'dab chags kyi rigs/ khrung khrung / khra ne le/ 'ug pa/ rgod thang dkar / thang smug glag bcas sna tshoḍayong pa/ sa 'og gter rdzas ni/ rin chen gser dang / gzi rdo/lcags/ ze tshwa/ mu zi sogs gter rdzas 'dra min sna tshogs yod pa'i mdzes sdug yid 'ong kyi yul 'dir/ gna' mo lo rgyus thog zhang zhung khongs gtogs yin par grags zhing / zhang zhung la khri sde bcu gnyis khongs mnga' ste drug bcu tham pa yod pa ste sbar te dang / rkang khran/la dwags/ bzang dkar/ gar sha/ nyung ti spi ri khu nu/ tshang sa drug nyi/ nyi ti/ skyo gnam/ sha khog mgar yang / tsha rong /ri dkar/ slu mo/ 'om lho/ se rigs/ dos po/ krug skyes/kor kha/ mang yul sogs lho rgyud dang / ru thog gu ne/ spu hreng skor gsum dbus su bzung ba'i kha yug kha skyor/ kha rag cing shang / ci na/ phyogs bcu/ ra sang / nag tshang / gu rub/shing sger sogs byang rgyud khri ste bcu gnyis dang / mnga' sde drug bcu dbye ba la/ zhang zhung rgyal po zhes grags che ba la/ dbus la mkhar bzhi yod pa ni/ khyung lung dngul gyi/ mkhar/ spu hring stag la mkhar/ma spang spos mo mkhar/ sme shang byi ba mkhar bcas bzhi dang / phyogasakyi rdzong chen stag seng khyung 'brug bzhi ni/ dang rwa khyang gi rdzong / se rib 'brug gi rdzong / ru thog seng ge rdzong / mang yul stag mo rdzong 62

bcas yod pa skabs shig la zhang zhung leg min skya zhes mnga' thang dang 'byor pa stobs sogs lhan pa'i bod rgyal dang 'gran nus pa'i zhig yod/li rgyalalte ba'i bzhuḍa gnas ni dwangs ra khyung rdzong yin/ zhang zhung dang bodaganyis dmag 'khrug skabs bod rgyal dmag zhang yul du 'byor skabs zhang bod dmag 'khrug thengs 'ga' byas mthar zhang zhung sgo mo bar ma dwangs ra khyung rdzong gi pho brang ni phyi la la phrang chu gsum btsan pa dang / nang la sa 'ob mkhar rdzong brag ri btsan pas bod dmag rnams g.yul las rgyal ba'i re thag chod stabs g.yo rgyu'i thabs 'phrul ci rigs shig bya rgyu'i blo rig bton pas zhang rgyal gyi btsun mo byang chub sgron ma nor dang gser dngul gyis bslus te zhang rgyal dbang du bsdus mtshams kho mo bod rgyal khri srong gi btsun mor 'argad rgyu'i dam bca' byas pa dang zhang zhung rgyal blon gtso bo rnams nam rgyun mkhar rdzong btsan mkhar 'dzin pa las/ yus thang gsang thabs kyi dmag jus byed par phebs par btsun mo las sus kyang shes kyi med pas dus gcig rgyal blon rnams g.yul salte ba dung phug dang g.yu phun gnyis la phe bas bstun btsun mos bod rgyal la yig lon mngon cher bya thabs bral yang brda rtaḍa su g.yu gcig dang / dung gcig bod mi zhig brgyud bod rgyal la phul stabs de'i brda don rtogs te g.yu phun dang dung phug gnyis su bod kyi dmag shuṇa gcig sdud kyis rgol gtong byas mthar li me rgyal po dung phug nas bkug ste sku srog bkrong pa dang / g.yu phun dmag blon rnams phams nyes byung mthar zhang zhung li me sku srog bgrong 63

pa'i btsun mo rgan pa khyung si mtsho rgyal dmag blon 'bangs bcas bod rgyal lamago sgur nas zhang zhung bod khongs su gtogs pa dang / byang chubasgrol ma bod rgyal gyi btsun mor bsus pa red/ de'i skabs nag tshang yang zhang zhung sgo mo bar ma dwangs ra nang khungs zhes pa de yul sde bye brag cig yin pa da ltamang nag tshang yul skad nang sdon zhang zhung gi yul skad mang po zhig gnas yod la/ sa cha der rdzong chen dwangs ra khyung rdzong dang / khyi tshe rdzong / tang thal rjong / 'bum nang rdzong / 'om bu rdzong sogs chags yul gyi/ mkhar rmang gyang ro da lta yang bsdad yod/ nag tshang ni gna' dus zhang zhung khongs gtogs yin 'dug pas/ de nas chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan nas zhang bod gcig gyur bzos par brten nag tshang yang de ltar bod kyi khongs gtogs su gyur pa red/ bsdoms nas bshad na/ nag tshang khul 'di rgang sa lnga pa'i sdon du rdzong gzhis 'di'i khongs zhes dmigs bsal med par khral rigs gang sar dka mo gang nyal chog pa zhigayin 'dug 'on kyang chab srid dang / chos lugs sogs spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos kyi 'gyur ldog sna tshogs kyi thad la khyon yongs kyi 'gyur ba ji byung gis nag tshang la'ang shugs rkyen nam/ 'gyur ba 'ga' zhig byung yod pa smos ci dgos/ dus 'di'i yas mas nag tshang gi tsho ming ni bod khri skor bcu gsum zhes yod pa'i ya rgyal la stod lho khri skor dang /la stod byang khri skor zhes yod pa 'di de snga khyon yongs kyi ming 'di/da lta cha shas kyi ming tsam gnas la/ lho deng ri la stod/ byang nag 64

tshang la stod ces gnyis da lta 'bod srol yod/tsho ba khag bgos byung stangs skor/dus rabs bcu bdun nang / gong sa lnga pa'i sku dus su la sing sde gzar langs skabs/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags bya (1581)lor bkrasalhun dgon grwa rigs sog po dga' ldan tshe dbang dmag dpon du bskos nas stod mnga' ris phyogs su ched btang gis mnga' ris skor gsum dbang du 'dus te gzhung khongs su chub par byas pa dang / de skabs nas nag tshang yang rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang gi zhoraskyong byed kyi yod lugs nag tshang gi gtan tshig 'ga' re'i nang gsal ba rang nyid kyis mig mthong byung zhing / de'i skabs nag tshang du tsho pa brgyadabazos yod pa dang / rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang gi dus 'jug tu/ste srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang / lha sang khang dbar sogs sa gnas srid gzhung gi nang khul rnyog 'dzing 'ga' zhig byung ste nag tshang khul yang bar stong du lus thog sog po jun gar dmag gis gnod 'tshe phog ste de sngatsho brgyad yod pa nas tsho gnyis bud stong du song ba red/ de rjes dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i nang mi dbang pho lhas 'dzin skyong byed pa'i dus skabs a jo zhes mi gnyisadang / spo bo zhes mi bzhi las grub pa zhig btsugs pa der nag 'go drug sprel zhes zer/ de skabs nag tshang 'di bzhin de sngon tsho brgyad kyi dus las kyang de bas stobs che dang gra65

rgyas su song 'dug bud stong du so nga ba'i dpon smad dang / rub tsho gnyis phud pa'i tsho drug ni/ 1 dpon gzhung dang / 3 rta sadakar ba/sum 3 sang phyug ser gsum/ 4 ladapon 'om gsum/6 gom nag 5 gro dpal bcas yin zhing / de skabs stod smad kun tu mi phyugs gnyis ka dar rgyas gang 'tshams byung yod/ de snga dus rabs bco brgyad nang ma ru nga jun gar mi sun gyi 'dre dmag bod du lhaḍa'abyor skabs nag tshang sa gnas lho sngo mo gzhung dang / byang khri gshod bcas pa jun gar dgra dmag yar mar lam khel skabs nag tshang gi mi dbang pho lta'i bka' yig dgongs don bzhin rta dmag lnga brgya tsam gyis dpa' ngar ngang bstan dgrar rgol 'dzing byas te rang dmag la shi rmas cirigagobyung rung / bstan dgra jun gar dpon dmag mang po bsad luḍakyi jun gar dmag dpon bsad pa'i mgo lag blangs te 'om po don gcod khang dwangs chung dgon pa'i mgon po lha khang du yod pa dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur sngon de khongs yul mi tshang mas mthong myong yod pa dang de skabs dwangs ra nang khuladu la phrang chu gsum btsan stabs jun gar 'gog srung thub ste nang khog bon dgon dang / rnying dargan la gtor skyon ma byung lugs shod rgyun yod pa red/ 'ing 'brug ( 1 04)lor dbyin bod dmag 'khrug skabs bod ljongs ser skya mi mang gi bstan dgra phyi gling par dpa' ngar gyi 'gog rgol byas pa'i nang nag tshang gi yul dmag lnga brgya yas mas g.yul sar phyin pa dang / rgyal rtse brgyud 66

nag tshang da ga gis dgra bor bod mda' dang gri mdung sogs la brten nas dpa' 'dzing byas pa dang / kong dmag dang / nag tshang dmag la skad grags chod pa dang / lhag par nag tshang rta rga'i lha dmag red zer ba dang dza drag tshe ba'i dmag 'thab skabs shig la nag tshang dmag gi gri 'dzing ral kha la brten dbyin dmag khyon che bsad pa dang /nag tshang dmag mi yang nyi shu yas mas dgra bo'i 'khrul mda'i 'og rang srog dor ba red/ rong chen dog sa dang / mun nag la nag tshang dmagagi me gri mdung gsum phud/ 'ur rdo yang 'phen te pha rol dgra dmag rnams kyis bod dmag khag gcig la gzhan la med pa'i thag pa'i gzhu mo dang / rdo yi mda' mo soḍa thag gzhu rdo mda' de ni ha las pa'i drag rtsal zhig red ces bshad skad 'dug rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gnyisapa'i sku dus rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me 'brug (1855)lor rgar bod sde gzar skabs/ nag tshang gi dmag mi nyis brgya skor bod dmag dang mnyam du g.yul sar btang bar/ bod dmag gi 'go 'dom pa gtso bo 'phan po lcang rgyab ces pa zhig yod pa kho pas nag tshang gi dmag mi rnams g.yul 'khrub skabs nyen kha che sar gtong ba dang dmag rdzoḍa la gyong gun ster ba/ rgyun du nyes brdung dang gshe gshe gtong ba soḍa phyoḍa ris kyi byed stangs sna tshoḍa byung bar brten/ nag tshang dmag gi rang khongs kyi 'go pa brgya dpon gnyis nas kho pa'i kha la ma nyan par gyen log brgyab ste kha 'dzing yang yang byas pa ma zad/ nag tshang gi dpon dmag tsho rang 'tshams kyis rang 67

rang yu'/ du phyir log kyang byas pa red/ skabs der bkod 'dom dmag dpon cing ba/rgyab pas bshad pa/ nag tshang ni sna yin pas sna thag nga tsho'i lag tu yod ces bshad lugs dang / de rjes lca nga brgyab palha sar logarjes nag tshang dmag gis de snga gyen log byas par 'khon 'dzin bcang ste bod sa gnas srid gzhung la nag tshang gi dmag ni bstan don la mi bsam mkhan bkod 'dom dang bka' khrims la srung brtsi mi byed mkhan/ ngan shed sgal ral gyi byang thang rta pa mdung 'khyer gyi bya spyod byed mkhan ngan pa lang shor can yin tshul snyan khra zhu sbyor yang yang byas rkyen/ sa gnas srid gzhungagis kyang kho pa'i zhu don la yid ches byas te/ nag tshang gi do dam la shugs snon rgyag ched/ tsho zhib don gcod kyi 'go pa 'phan po lcang brgyab pa kho rang la bsko gzhag gis nag tshang sa khul du dpon dmag hrag bsdus btang don kho pas tsho zhib byed skabs sngar 'khon zhe 'dzin gyisadang thog nag tshang a jo gnyis po go sa gnas dbyung btang ba dang /skabs de'i nag tshang dmag gi 'go pa brgya dpon gnyis kyis gtsos dmag mi re re bzhin nyes 'gag rtsad gcod dang 'brel lus steng rta lcag dang rgyu thog chad pa bcad pa ma zad / kha shas la tshe lcags kyang brgyab pa red/de bzhin gor bod g.yul sar bstan don rgyab skyur gyis rang shed phyir 'then byas par nag tshang tsho drug spyir lo rer gor bod ching dngul gor ṭam chig stong tham pa re lo ltar rdzong kha rdzong brgyud bal yu la rgyal por gtsang 'phrod zhu dgos pa dang / lo ltar sdig pa gtan 'jags kyis rgyal 68

bstan ji srid nam gnas sgru ba 'bul zhu dgos pa'i nyes dngul bkal ba red / skabs de'i lcang brgyab tsho zeb der rma 'brug (1855)tsho zhib zer zhing de ni sa gnas sred gzhung gis nag tshang khul du byas pa'i zhib gcod thengs dang po de red/ thengs de'i kṣib gcod thog khral khrims sgrub rgyug byed phyogs skor zhib phra'i tsho bgos byas par dpon tsho dang /gzhung smad rta khro/ sang ser/ phyug tsho/ dpon stod/ la stod/'om bu/ gom nag gro dpal/ dmar tsho bcas gzhung rgyug tsho bcugacig dang / dwangs chung stod smad dang / ser ba zhi chags/ ngor rbakha/ ri khyu/ so hrug ser zhig bcas sger tsho bdun bzos te gzhungasger bsdoms khyon tsho bco brgyad du bgos yod thog rdzong gi nye 'gram du seng rgyug zhes pa'i tsho chung zhig btsugs yod pa de ni nag tshang tsho drug zhes pa de don du tsho bcu gcig las grub pa zhig yin pa des dbyar ston gnyis kyi dus tshod las 'dzoms mi dgos par rgyun ldan char 'phar khral rigs rtsag rtsig gang thon khral rgyug byed mi mi ser nas 'gan len byed kyi yod pa red/ tsho drug ces pa'i 'bod srol ni/ nag tshang a jo dpa' sangs zhes pa'i skabs byung ba las/ don dngos thog lcang brgyab pa'i me 'brug zhib gzhung ltar gong gsal gzhung rgyug tsho bcu gcig de rang yin/nag tshang du 'go dpon sogs do dam mi sna rim byung dang 'gan dbang spyod stangs 'ga' zhig skor/nag tshang gi sa khul so sor de snga rang rang gi yul dpon che chung 69

sna tshogs yod 'dug pa de dag gi nang nas khyi 'brug tshe dbang stobs rgyal dang / dwangs ra dbang po sog kyi skor la rgan rabs kyi shod srol cung mang ba 'dug rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang gis zhor skyong byed pa'i dus skabs su nag tshang 'go pa ngag bsam zhes pa'i dpon rigs shig dang / de 'og re zung byung ba dang / de rjes bod la nang zing 'ga' re byung ste nag tshang khul la do dam byed mi 'di yin rang med pa'i bar stong zhig byung 'dug dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i nang rgyal ba sku phreng bdun pa'i skabs su nag tshang la cung zhib phra yin la rgyun ldan can gyi srid 'dzin do dam byed 'go btsugs shing / mi dbang pho lha nas nag tshang la do dam byed lugs mi dbang rang nyid kyis rtsal ba'i gtan tshig nang / a jo zhes pa'i mi gcig dang / las bya a jo zhes pa'i mi gcig spo bo zhes pa'i mi bzhi bcas las grub pa de dag rim pa gcig mtshungs mi drug la 'go lhan drug sbrel zhes pa zhig rtsa 'dzugasabyas pa dang / de dag gi nag tshang yongs kyi khral bsdu khrims gnon gyi 'gan dbang spyod kyi yod cing / de 'og tsho pa rer rgan bo gsum re bsko gzhag byas yod pa dang /de rjes 'go pa a jo/ spo po de 'og rgan po sogs su zhig yin rung /'das grongs sam dgongs zhus kyi tshab bsko gzhag bya rgyu'i lam srol yod lugs 'khod 'dug de skabs dpon rigs rnams la mi ser gyis brtsi bkur che tsam yod pa dang / lhag par rim byung dpon rigs nang snyan graḍache shos nag tshang a jo(dpal bzang rab brtan )zer ba zhig byung 'dug 70

cing / nga tsho'i shes ldan rgan rabs rnams kyi shod sro la la khong ni nyam thag mi ser la byams pa/ gzhung drang ba/ 'dod chung chog shes ya rab can/dgra gnyen dang / bzang ngan la chags sdang gsal ba/ blo gros dang /dpa' rtsal mchog tu gyur pa/ gtam yig rtsis la mkhas pa/ phyogs lhung med pa/ btsan po dang / khrims 'gal yan por mi 'jog pa/ mi chos kyi tshul gang la'ang mkhas shing / bab rling ldan pa sogs phyi nang gang sar skad grags yod pa 'i/ga yin la/ skabs der nag tshang gi don dang bdag dbang gang thad la nyams mi dma' ba'i mgon skyabs shig byung yod pas ya rab kyiyon tan la bstod mkhan 'ga' zhig gis ‘‘nag tshang a jo dpal bzang spyimir bab na drang la don mir bab na rgod pa/ gtam la rang dbang thob pa sogs kyi bsngags brjod byed kyi yod pa dang / 'on kyang gzhan sde dang /che btsan dgra zlar langs pa rnams kyis ‘‘nag tshang a jo dpal la/ rang sder byams yang mi sder sdang ba dpa' mdzangs che yang gzhung drang med pa ༵ṭwāṃn po sna yan shor ba'i ya med 7red ces shod mkhan yang yod pa de rjes me 'brug lcang brgyab kyi tsho zhib nas bzung nag tshang a jo ngo las gnyis go gnas med pa bzos te rdzong sdod ser skya gnyis dang /de'i las rogs su sa khul rang gi spo bo mi gcig dang / tsho dpon mi gcig sgar dpon mi gnyis bcas bsko bzhag byas pa red/ der sngar bzhin lhan drug sbrel zhes 'bod kyang don dngos thog rdzong sdod gnyis kyi ci 71— /de/

gsungs bka' sgrub zhu rgyu las thun mong thog 'os 'gan spyod dbang med thog de tshun nas nag tshang la yang shan tsha rdzong zhes 'bod kyi yod pa dang lo gsum re nas rdzong sdod brje len byed kyi yod pa red/shan tsha rdzong zhes gzhung 'dzin rdzong 'go zhig yin rung / rdzong nub ces rdzong sdod ser mo ba de 'bras spungs sgo mang bsam blo khams tshan nas gtong srol 'dug rdzong sharade sa gnas srid gzhung nas shod drung zhig gtong gi yod cing / rdzong sdod ser skya gnyis kyi bkod 'doms 'og spo bo dang / tsho dpon gnyis nas khral 'ul gyi 'gan 'khur dgos pa dang /sgar dpon gnyis kyis dmag don gyi 'gan 'khur dgos pa spo sgar gnyis tsho bzhi gang rung nas thon dgos la/ tsho sgar gnyis tsho gsum gang rung nas thon dgos gshis rgang gsal lhan drug sbrel gyi 'og tu gzhung rgyug tsho bcu gcig la rgan po sum cu so drug dang / brgya dpon bzhi/ sger tsho bdun la rgan po re bcas yod cing / khong tsho'i rga gnas dang 'gan dbang ni sa gnas kyi tsho chung ngu re'i dpon dang ha lam gcig mtshungs yin/ zhib phra dwabye na dpon tsho tsho gcig la rgan po bzhi dang / gzhung smad tsho gcig la rgan po bzhi/ rda khro tsho gcig la rgan po gnyis/ sang ser tsho gcig largan po gsum/ phyug tsho tsho gcig la rgan po gsum/ dpon stod tsho gcig la rgan po gsum/ la stod tsho gcig la rgan po lnga/ 'om bu tsho gcig la rgan po gnyis/ rgam nag tsho gcig la rgan po bzhi/ gro dpal 72

tsho gcig la rgan po bzhi/ dkar tsho tsho gcig la rgan po gnyis bcas yod pa de dag gis rang tsho so so'i khral bsdu'i 'gan dbang spyod chog la/khrims gnon gyi bya ba chung tsag kyang byed chog 'on kyang khrims 'gal zhu gtugs che rigs rdzong lhan drug sbrel lam/ rdzong dpon gnyis kyi thag gcod byed kyi yod/brgya dpon bzhi yod pa'i 'byung khungs sngar srol ltar/ dpon tsho nas brgya dpon gcig gzhung smad nas brgya dpon gcig rgam nag nas brgya dpon gcig la stod dang / sang skye/ gro dpal gsum gang rung nas brgya dpon gcig bcas thon dgos/ brgya dpon gyis sgar dpon gnyis kyi 'go khrid 'og dmag don gyi las ka byed dgos shing / dmag don gyi las ko'i khyab khongs cung rgya khyon che tsam la khral bsdu khrims gnon byed pa dper na/ rdzong lhan dang / sgar dpon spotsho bcas kyi 'og gzhung tsho bcu gcig las med kyang / dmag don thog gzhung sger tsho bco brgyad yod cing / dmag yongs la sgar dpon gnyis dang / de 'og brgya dpon bzhis zhi drag gi bkod gtong chog pa gtan 'bebs byas yod/sger tsho bdun gyi dpon khungs ni/ dwang chu stod smad gnyis la gnyer pa gnyis/ ser ba zhi chags la 'arga pa gcig bcas kyi dpon khungasase ra bla spyi/ ngor sba kha rgan po gcig (dpon khungs ngor dargan pa/) rikhu rgan po gcig (dpon khungs snyer pad tshal ) so hrug rgan po gcig73— —— — —/de

(dpon khungs sger rdo ring )ser zhig ces pa ser zhig dargan pa'i khongs gtogs yin kyang gzhung rgyugs sang skye mnyam du khral 'ul kyang phran tsam sgrub rgyug dgos kyi mod pa bcas yin/rgan po so so'i 'og tu rtswa za'i 'gan 'khur rtswa dpon zhes mi drug bcu tsam dang / 'ul lag gi 'gan 'khur ba 'ul dpon sum cu skor/ brgya dpon gyi 'og bcu dpon nyi shu skor bcas yod pa'i dpon chung de rnams tsho che chung la dpag pa'i mang nyung ma gtogs tshang mar yod gshis de snga nag tshang du thog mar dpon 'arga che ba grags can re zung byung rjes dpon rigs che ba bzhi pha rgyud bu 'dzin gyi lam lugs chags te/ spo bo rus rgyud gtsang pa dang /tsho dpon rus rgyud dbon po/ sgar dpon gcig ra ba dang gzhan zhig zhung po yin/ sngar pha shul bu 'dzin yin na'ang bar lam khral khrims kyi 'os 'gan lci ru song ba'i dbang gis 'ga' res las go mi pher ba dang / 'ga' res phyogs lhung dang bza' rngams brdabs bsig ha cang che stabs mang tshogs dang 'gal ba che ru song bas tsho so so'i shes ldan mi drag 'ga' shas dang mang tshogs bcas kyis rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog la zhu gtugs snyan zhu phul bar mang bsam don son byung stepha rgyud bu 'dzin gyi lam ngan med pa bzos shing / gna' dus a jo dpal bzang dus kyi sngar lam bzang po 'gyur ba med pa'i don son marga mchan byung ste mang mos 'os 'dems bya rgyu'i lam lugs slar gso byung zhing 74

de rjes spo bo dang / tsho dpon sgar dpon gnyis bcas 'das grongs sam dargangs zhu byas pa'i tshab tu tsho bcu gcig gi 'os snyan bsdus te mang ba der gtan 'khel dang 'os snyan 'dra mtshongs sam/ ha lam 'dramatshungs yin na brtag sgril zhus te bsko srol yod/ de rjes spo tsho sgar bcas 'phos len ji ltar byung yang mang mos 'os 'dems byed pa'i lam srolachags yod pas 'dems bsko byas te thon pa'i spo bo thog ma rgam nag gi don grub phun tshogs dang / bod ta tshe don/ gro dpal dpal ldan/ tsho dpon dpon tsho'i rdza ba dang / khyung po'i dbang ma/sgar dpon sang skye rnam bkras dang / rgam nag khyung lo/ phran gyi pha o rgyan sogs byung yod/ bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol thob nas spyi tshogs la legs bcos dgos par brten sa gnas srid gzhung nang du'ang legs bcos las khungs sogs 'phar 'dzugs byas pa dang / shing rta(1954)lor bod yongs la rtsa tshig don tshan lnga 'khod pa gcig 'grems spel byas don ltar nag tshang la'ang spo tsho sgar bcas mi bzhi dang / gzhung ster tshobaco brgyad kyi spyi 'thus gcig mang mos 'dems bsko byed dgos pa bzhinaspo bo a kun dang tsho dpon dbang grags/ sgar dpon o rgyan dang tshering dbang rgyal bcas dang / spyi 'thus phran la stod 'jam dpal bcas 'dems thon byung nas dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur bar gnas mus yin gshis spyi 'thus kyi 'os 'gan ni/ rdzong sdod sne mo ba'i lo ltar khral riḍa gzhung rtsis zhu bar mnyam bskyod kyis lta zhib bya rgyu dang / nag tshang par75

phyi nas rtsod gzhi byung ba'am rdzong dang mang tshogs bar gnad don sogs byung tshe spyi 'thus kyis dmangs tshab byed dgos pa red/tsho drug gi ga'ung khral skub rgyug byed phyogs skor/rgan rabs rnams kyi shod srol dang / yig rnying 'ga' shas sogs la gzhigs na/ nag tshang 'di bzhin gna' dus yun ring po'i nang khral rigs sgrub rgyug ma dgosapa zhig yin na'ang de rjes rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang skabs su gzhi nas rgyal po lo khral zhes mar dngul phran bu re sa gnas srid gzhung la 'bul dgosakyi yoda'adug de rjes 'phan po lcang brgyab pas me 'brug zhib gzhung zhes khral rigs sgrub rgyugs skor zhib cha'i gtan 'bebs bzos pa ste/ dang thog nag tshang sa khul gyis phyugs rigasamarga grangs zhib brtsis thog rta lug ra gsum nor la phabs te brtsi stangs rta nor 'dra mtshungs dang / lug drug la nor re/ ra bdun la nor re brtsis pa'i nor lnga dang phyed ka la leb ces pa'i brtsi srolazhib bzo byas te leb grangs nyis khri bzhi stong lnga brgya dgu bcu rga bdunadang / drug cha gcig btan 'khel thog sgo phyugs 'phar chag ji byung la ma ltos par leb kyi tshad gzhi der nam yang 'gyur ba gtong mi chog pa phyugasazog gi leb kha ma long na/ phaleb 7re la rdog ma zhes pa brgya dang nyi shu tham pa re brtsis te leb phyed la rdog ma drug cu dang gsum cha gcig la bzhi bcu dang bzhi cha gcig la sum cu tham pa sogs rim bzhin cha brgas 76

kyis brtsi srol zhib phra yang satan 'bebs byas pa red/ leb grangs der lo khamasasbyar te me 'brug gzhung leb che mo zer gyi yod/ leb rngo da ces lo gsum re'i mtshamasatsho pa so so phyugs zog ngo snyom grangs rtsis re byas te/ rta/ nor/ lug ra bcas rtsis bsher byed mi gzhung bskos rgan po sum cu so drug la zung sbrel rdzong gi zhabs gras re gnyisasam skabs re gsum bzhi tsam bcas sa gnas so sor mnyam bskyod kyis mi ser dud tshang re re bzhin phyugs zog marga grangs brtsis te leb rngod grangs rtsis tshar rjes zog tho rnams chabs gcig tu bsdus nas nor bsgril gyi gzhung lebal ga thug pa'i cha brgas leb bzo byas te tsho bcu gcig la rang rang tsho par phyugs zog mang nyung rjes 'brel gyi leb grangs mang nyung la gzhigs pa las dmiḍa bsal su la'ang med par khral gzhong gcigal la ga pa rgyag pa dang /rtsis gzhong gcig la de'u gtong dgos zhes pa ltar khral khrimasatshang ma gcig mtshungs yin/ tsho drug spyi nas lo ltar bla phyag las khungs su gzhupamar che mo mar dmar 'degs kyi khal bdun sto nga 'bul dgos pa ma zad/'brong ni ri dwags yin kyang nag tshang la 'brong rtsa yod lugs soḍa la brtenakhral 'gel gnang ste lha she 'brong mar zhes khal brgya tham pa dang yang 'bri she khag gnyis te lcags phag 'bri she khal brgya tham pa/ gro dpal tsho pa'i rgan dam chos zhes pa'i nor brgya she nor du bsgyur ba'i dam chos 'bri she mar khal brgya tham pa mar khal bcu gnyis la mar ltang mon do 1lon pa red/ smon lam mang dod dngul ṭam dkar sum stong tham pa/ gzha~X 7yang — —— /de—

lo de'i khral bsgrubs zin pa red/ lo ltar rgan po dang / gnyerapa (ma rgan yang zer ) so so nas rdzong lhan drug por zla drug pa'i ches 1dang zla dgu pa'i tshes 1nyin dbyar ston gyi mjal dar dus 'gyangs med par 'bul dgos/ gal srid 'gyangasatshe bka' nyes 'gel gyi yod/rta khal 'ul lag rgyugs phyogs skor/ nag tshang la sa tshigs bcu gsum yodapa ste/ shar nas nub tu rtsis na/ 1shan tsa/ 1seng rgyu/ 3dkar tshang / 4chu phra ril/ 5na marga 'khyog 5'bri ngur chen/ 7spong chen/dbye sbug del nag 9na 'dam chen/ 10lu ma sdon mo/ 11sto khrul sgo/13na bo lug 13chu 'arga dmar po bcas yin/ yar mar che btsan gzhung 'grul ni gzhung gser dpon zhes rtse phyag jo lags ngo g.yog sum cuskor la rta khal sdod sgrig mang bsar le med dgos shing / der tshod rtsis byas na rta 'ul ba zhi bcu skor dang / khal ma bdun brgya skor gtong dgos/ de min stod se le sbug spu hreng / sha 'bi gling / tho gling /yag ra bla brang / sger rtse dpon bcas la yang 'ul lag rgyugs dgos par kha grangs nges med sa tshigs 'ul dpon rnams kyis 'thus tshang gtong dgos/dmag don so so'i skor/rgyun ldan so sa bcu gsum zhes 'bod kyang / dngos su so sa lnga yodapa ste/ sog da kar dpal ldan so sa/ ze po gsum pa so sa mo mo 79

yer yer so sa/ rgya len so sa sogs la so dpon gcig dang so mi lnga bcuskor yod pa rnams kyis da gra jag yod med bya ra byed dgos/ dgra thon ki brda rgyugs zhes nam rgyun sgar dpon gnyisakyi bka' sgug ste sdod pa'i rga lag rta bcas 'thus tshang yod pa dmag mi nyis brgya tham pa dang / da dung nyen kha che ba yod phyin thon gnyisapa zhes gra sgrigs dmag mi gsum brgya tham pa bcas bsdomasadamag mi lnga brgya tham pa yod pa red/ de dag gi khongasanas stod smad tshwa mtsho khag la mnga' zhabs mi ser gyi dbyar dpyid tshwa pa rnams dgra nyen 'jigs skyob tu tshwa kha rer dmag mi lnga bcu skor 'gro dgos/ nag tshang ma yin pa'i phyogs gzhan nas tshwa len mkhan nas sgar dpon lhan la tshwa len khal g.yag drug re nas dngul ṭam dkar redang / khal lug sum cu re nas dngul ṭam dkar re phral 'bul dgos pa der ‘‘sum cu drug ṭam zhes 'bod srol yod/ khral dngul de dag ma gzhi sgar dpon gnyis la 'bab kyi yod kyang / sgar dpon ngo ma'am ngo tshab su slebs kyang dngul khag cig dgongs dpyad kyis dmag mir me mda'itsha rgyal du gsol ras gnang gi yod pa red/ dmag mis tshul min gyi bya spyod byas tshe sgar dpon nas dmag khrims bcad chog pari gtan 'bebs yod la g.yul 'gyed skabs g.yul sa nas thob pa'i dngos po rnams dmag nom bgo chog pa sogs kyi dmigs bsal dbang cha'ang yod/ 'on kyang lo rgyus thog sgar dpon gyis dmag mir srog khrims btang ba byung myong med/80

'go dpon so sozhi thob bang skor/spo bo dang / tsho dpon/ sgar dpon gnyis shing rta/ (1954)lo nas bzung nag tshang tsho drug dang / spyi rgan dmangs kyi spyi 'thus bcas gtso bo dpon 'go lnga la thob thang ha lam 'dra mtshungasayin cing /nor grangasasum brgya tham pa rer khral 'jal mi dgos pa dang rgyun ldan sku srung 'go dmag bzhi nyar chog pa/ phyogs 'gro'i skabs gzim dpon gcig dang / drung yig gcig gsol dpon gcig zhabs phyi gsum bcas khrid chog pa'i thob thang yod/ sgar dpon gnyisal sgeratsho bdun nas zhabs gla gsol dod mjal zhu sog4'bul dgos/ rdzong shar nub gnyis gsar phebs skabs thab gsar spus sgyur zhes 'bam tshong btang chogapa'i lam srol yod pa der snyad de rjes su mgo thar dpung 'jug gis 'bamatshong gi bal 'bab bsdu len kyang byed kyi yod/ rgan po re la nor brgya dang lnga bcu skor dang / 'ul dpon dang / bcu dpon/ rtswa dpon sogs la nor lnga bcu skor la khral 'jal mi dgos/ brgya dpon bzhi ni rgan po dang thob thang gcig mtshungasayin/ga'ung tshong dang jong sdod nas 'bam tshong gis 'bar brnabs byas skor/nag tshang khul gyi yul thon gtso bo ni bal yin la/ thon 'bor yang che bar brten der za 'dod 'gram chu ldang ba lta bur gyur te che 81—— — /de ——/de/

bcan khag gis snga phyi gang du'ang 'bam tshong spus sgyur gyi byed thabs/ bzung gi ro da pa red/ rab byung 1capa'i shing khyi lo tsam nas spom mda' gzhungachong lo bdun brgyad tsam byas pa ni spom mda' chos ldan zhes pa de red/kho nga gzhung tshong yin par brten sa gnas srid gzhung gi lag 'khyer yod pang byang khul gyi bal rnga pags rigs bsdams nyo byed kyi yod cing las/ 'byer nang bal rnga pags rigs rnams sger tshong khag la thad tshong byed mi chog pa dang / rin 'bab thad 'brog par mkho ba'i rtsam pa dang /'bru/ ja/ dngul sogs gyong gun med pa sprad chog ces 'khod yod pa ltar gzhung tshong spom mda' chos ldan gyis bal sgrub rin 'bab rtsam pa dang 'bru sogs 'brog par mkho dngos sprod par ma zad/ rin 'bab kyang yul thang dang he bag chen po rang med pa sprad stabs 'brog pas tshong zong phran bu dang / rang gi mkho byed tsam las de byings rtsa ba'i cha nas gzhungatshong pa rang las gzhan la tshong gi med stabs skabs der lug ngo grangs 'bum bzhi tsam las med rung bal (mon do rer chos khal zhes gtsang rgya brgyad re dang lha khal bcu gnyis re ) mon do 500༷skor 'bab kyi yod la nyo sgrub skabs kyang mi ser dang 'gal ba dang rnyog dra de tsam byung med/ 'on kyang rtsa ba'i bal rnams 6 tshong dang bla ma gang bzang ltar 'dod nyo 'dod tshong mi chog pa'i bkag sdom byed pa dang / zhib phra'i lag bltar skabs gang ltar mi ser la gyong gun dang 'phar brdabs kyi dka' ngal ci rigs yong ga yod pa ni bshad ma dgos pa red/ de rjes gzhung 82

gi tshong pa zhes pa med/ 'on kyang shan tsa rdzong sdod rim pas lam ngan mu 'byams kyis bal 'bam tshong byed kyi yod pa rdzong sdod cha pa sras dang / kashod pa/ sa lung pa/ me tog lcang gseb/ tsha rti gzhon pa bcas kyi/sa de ltar byas pa red / dper na cha pa sras kyis rdzong sdod lo gsum byed ring gi bod me phag lo nas sa glang / (1949)lo bar lo dang po ka thod par bogs mar btang ba dang / yab gzhis stag tsher dang tshong 'brel byas te yab gzhis la sa gnas srid gzhung nas nag tshang khul gyi bal rnams bsdams nyo byas chog pa'i lag 'khyer sprad yod/ 'on kyang lag 'khyer nang phan tshun gnyis mos byed dgos pa las mi ser la gyong gun btang mi chog lugs 'khod yod kyang mi ser nas bal gzhan la phyir tshong mi chog pa ma zad/ rin 'bab thad kyang 'bru rtsam phran bu las de byings ras cha dang /lham/ ja sogs mkho med rgya zog sprod kyi yod pa red/ de skabs lo rer bal mon do bzhi stong lnga stong bar zin gyi yod pa de rnams yul srol yin khul brdal gla phran bu re sprad de phag ri bar mi ser nas sa tshigs byas te skyel dgos pas mi ser la bal rin gyong gun ci che'i thog skyel 'dren kho na'i thog nas kyang lam 'khel mi ser la 'phar brdabs yong gi yod cing / lhag par cha pa rdzong mjug ma bsgril gong gi sa glang /(1949)lor sa lung pas cha pa 'phos tshab yin lugs kyis nag tshang khul ja rgyab nyis brgya skor dbor ba rnams dpon 'go so sor bkram ste phyi lo bal 'bab bsdu rgyu yod pa byed dgos pa'i btsan bka' btang ba red/83

bgos nas gnyis kus dpung rogs mi khrid pa dang / me sbod kyang ma khyerabar gdong gtug gri 'thab bya rgyu'i kha 'chad bzos/ phyi nyin snga mor zhogs ja btung tshar rjes ga rgya g.yog don ldan gyis bshol kyang ma bub par rta la bzhon nas thon pa dang / gtan 'khel gyi sa gnas su 'a/bu khra cung 'byor snga ba'i tog tsam sgug nas phyir log rgyag bzhin par/ ga rgya' byor nas lam seng ki brgyab ste gri yi lag g.yug byas pas 'bu khra rta kha slog nas tshur yong ba dang / phan tshun gdong thugs skabs dang po 'bu khras gri g.yug pa ga rgya'i phrag pa'i g.yon thog phog kyang gos checha tshar sbyar dang nang 'jug 'bu ras bcang pa tsam laca/ shar smug shur tsar/ las ma thon/de mtshams ga rgya'i gri de 'bu khra'i sog phrag la thebs pas gzhogs ma lhung tsamagyi rmas tshen btang nas 'bu khra sa la 'gyel ba dang / ga rgyas 'bu khra shi ma gson der gos kyi nang sha dbral nas rma ching brgyab nas sbe ras kyi bsdam te kho rang gi rta la bcings thog 'jo ru ba'i sbra mthong sa bar bskyal nas ga rgya phyir log 'bu khra shi khar bus bu ma do bas sems lus med ces bshad skad 'dug dus de nas bzung ga rgya 'gram nag dpa' rtsal che ba'i snyan grags byung ba ma zad/ mi tshos rmongs dad kyi thod srol zhig la/ ga rgya 'gram nag spra ba brag nag gi bu yin pas mtshon mi 'gro zer ba sogs gleng rgyu yod pa red/93—/de —

banyis ba/ ga tshab 'khyag ba'i skor/ga rgya 'gram nag ni gong gsal ltar la/ tshab shi a rnam zer ba ni/ bon tha tsho pa'i mi drug len la tshab thi tshang ni mkhar dmar bla brang gi mgo btags sger ste zhig red/ 'di'i mi rabs gong ma tsho smad khyung po nas stod du yong ste hor bon tha'i nang gzhis chags pa dang / klu dgon mkhar dmar sprul sku bstan rgyal gyi sku dus la mkhar blar mgo btags te sger sder gyur 'duga'on kyang bon tha tsho pa'i nang gal che'i khral khrims kyi byed sgor zhugs dgos pa dang / sde don la the jus che tsam byed mkhan zhig yin 'dugatshab shi tshang rgyu rnar chen po yi na pas / (sa mtsher/)tshab shi tshang zhes/ noratsho'i stod rgyud du rgyu che ba'i ming grags yod pa red/tshab shi a rnam ni shing lug lo pa/ (phal cher ) ( 1895)lor skyes pa dang / lo nar son rjes bon tha'i mi drag zhig red/ kho ni kha rtsal che zhing gyod la mkhas pa/ blo rgya yangs 'a/ ya yud kyi snying stobs che ba/ sems/ gnag cing lkog jus mang ba bcaru/ kyi gshis rgyud ldan yod pa red/1 ga tshab gnyis thog ca/'i 'khrug rtsa 'gal gzhi byung tshul/sngar me 'brug zhib ga'ang gi dgongs don sog rdzong nas khral 'ul rdzong ༄96
