bskor ba rgyag pa las 'gro ma thub pas bod dmag gis 'dzin bzung byas/ skabs 'dir sngon chud nas lan skyel ba'am gang ltarā sog ste'i blon stag rgod dbal yu sleb nas bar 'dum byas/ bon tha lha sar gzhung gtug la mi 'gro rgyu dang / hor spyis kyang bon tha dpon las la bka' nyes mi 'bebs rgyu'i nang mol stag sod ngabal yu dang / bod dmag lding dpon gnyis kyis byas skad 'dug de rjes hor spyis bon drug gnyis kyi gyod de thag gcod kyes sngar yod ṭam rdo dgu po de drug cu la sprod du bcu ga pa las bon tha dpon las la gnas skabs bka' nyes ra bkal ba red/ ga rgya bsod nams bstan dar ni sngon nas hor blon yin khar horaspyi g.yu thog pa'i skabs sbra chen phyag mdzod du bskos yod pa dang / ka shod pa'i thog ma'i skabs bri mdzod kyi go ming yod mus red/ hor spyi ka shod pas ga rgya ni nam rgyun bka' rtsi khrims khur de tsam med pa ma zad/ bon drug gyod don skor ka shod par khyad gsod byas par gnag sdad yod thog ga rgya bstan dar gyi ske la gzi mig dgu pa zhig dang stag log tshe bum ma gnyis yod pa tshong dgos bshad par ma btsong ba'i rkyen sogs gang ltar ka shod pa 'bri rur 'byor rjes nyin zhig da sgram drag po 'tshogs te ga rgya bstan dar dang bon tha'i las bya ngo che gsang grags bcas 'dzin bzung gi rta lcag btang nas btson du bcugs/ de dngadus mnyam hor spyis sngon nas srung dmag 'ga' zhig dang blo 'khel zhabs gas ched gtong byas yod pa de tshos kyang dus tshod tshes grangs gcig mtshungs thog bon tha dpon 98

rgyal rtse 'dzin bzung byasapa dang / ser tsha tshwa 'brong dgon nas ga rgya 'dra ba'ang 'ju bzung gis rda lcag drug brgya btang nas de gar gsangapa bcas byas shing / ga rgya sbra mdzod dang bon tha dpon las gnas dbyung gis mkhar dbangagazhung bzhes byas/ skabs der ga rgya 'gram nag lha sar phyin nas ga rgya tshang gi rten sa g.yu thog pas gtsos sa gnas srid gzhung gi sku drag kha shas yod 'dug pa de tsho brgyud yang snying pha bsod nams bstan dar de lha sar brdzang nas rting ma'i khrun gcod byed skyor dgos pa zhig bzos yod pa red/ der brte na hor spyos ga rgya bstan dar dang bon tha dpon las lha sar brdzang rjes lo shas nas rting ma'i thag gcod byung ste ga rgya bstan dar dang bon tha'i ngo che gsang grags kyis mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes byas pa phyir slo ga dang go ming skyar gso yin ba/bon tha dpon rgyal rtses gzhung dmag la me mda' brgyab pa'i nyes 'dzol che stabs mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes thog tshe sgo tshe lcags rgyag rgyu'i thag gcod byung yod pa red/ skabs 'di'i ring bon tha'i dpon tshab ni tshab shi a rnam gyis byas pa dang / lha sa nas 'di ga'i gyod skor zhib 'jug byed po sa gnas la 'byor skabs lha sar yod pa'i ngo che gsang grags kyis kyang 4 ba shi sdod ma tshugs yin tshul zhu sbyor byas pas a rnam lha sar ched bkug gis rta lcags chig brgya zed dgos byung ba red/ mdor na gyod don 'di'i 'gro song skyabs rten 'dzugs yas bon las ngo che gsang grags kyis mdzod sbug nas dngul ṭam rdo 35de bed spyod byas pa sgad bun 'jal 99

dus tshod zin mtshams tshab 'i/sa bon thar nang sprod dgos rgyu'i gan 'dzin bzhal yod pa red/ de 4rjes bon thas mdzod sbug la bun 'jal skabs tshab shis ṭam rdo 15de bun 'jal ma byas pas de'ang bon tha sdes 'jal dgoṭa/ byung ba red/ 'di dus bon tha'i dpon 'gan 'khur mkhan ngo che sa/sang grags yin pa'i ji ltar snyag rung tshab shiyi bun dngul ca/ sprad skabs bozo tha ngapom rgan tshos ga rgya la btsan sbyar thub na snyam snge ga rgya pha bu la tshab shis botsha thar dgos pa'i ṭam rdo nyer lnga'i ma skyed chabs cig khyed rnam tshang gi ma dzod ces gan rgya 4 rgya bstan dar gyi lag la bzhag pas skabs der ga rgya 'grapa nag nas tshab shi tshang nas bu lon lon rgyu khag pa'i skyur zhog zer rung pha bstan dar dang bu skar ma rgyu brnag che bas len gyi yin zer/ gan rgya de blangaca/ yod pa 'di ni ga tshabathog ma'i 'gal ba'i 'byung rtsa red/ de rjes ga rgya pha bus tshab shi la bon tha'i ngo sgyur gyi dngu0/ bun de ga tshod snyog rung tshab shis gtan nas ma sprad/ mthar hor spyi sbra chen sa gnas su 'byor skabs/ (rim bzhi lte mdo'am mkhan chung thub bstan padma gang yin ma nges/) ga rgya bstan dar nas gong gsal bun don skor tshab shir kha mchu btsub/sa pas hor spyi'i mdun khong gnyis gdong bsher byed skabs tshab shi a rnam nas ga rgya bstan dar kha grags rgyumed pa bzos pa'i skad grags chen po byung yod pa red/ mthar thag chod kyi rgyu don ga rgyas lon nas tshab shis/ bun 'jal byed dgos byung rung /gdong bsher skabs ga rgya pham pa'i ming rna shor stabs/ de nas bzung ga 100

rgya bstan dar gyis tshab 'ir dgra nag la rtsis te nga gnyis kyi gyod de ma shi bar mi 'grigs ces brang la khu tshur bsnu na gyin brjod kyi yod pa red/2 ga tshab 'gal ba 'phelanas 'khrug rkyen skor/de rjes ga rgya bsod nams bstan dar nad kyi mnar te grongs kha'i kha cheng du nga 'chi khar gzhan gyi sems lus med/ tshab shi a rnam la lan po 'ig ca lorwa bar shi dus 'dir mi—/ btsum dka'/ bu khyed tshosader dgra lan 'phrod pa'i khaca/ len nga yi shi lag 'khyags/ pa 'di khyed tsho'i gson lag tsha pos 'ju dgos zhes lab par bu gzham ca tshos ci bya med pa'i ngang bu dkon rgyal te 'grar nag gis pa'i lag pa 'jus nas tshab shi la dgra lan ngas sprod zhes khas blangs pa red/ tshab shi a rnam nas ga rgya bstan dar mi ba thos skabs/ ga rgyas nged gnyis gyod ma shi bar mi 'grig ces bshad kyi yod pa da de ring 'grig pa red ces bshad yod pa dang /yang dus stabaca/ de skor zhig la tshab shi a rnam gyi 'ud shob bshad de dpe bgrang ba ga rgya tshang la bu mo mang po red de/ phag la phag phrug bco brgyad yod kyang / sa nag 'grim pa'i byol song red/ tshab shi tshang la bu mang po med / stag la stas phrug re zung yin rung sa mdud 'gag na re res chog ces bshad yod pa ma zad/ de rjes ga rgya bu spu na ma 'cham par dud gsu ma du bgo skabs tshab shi a rnam nas ga rgya tshang gi nang 'grigamakho nga byed na drag gi red sogs kha dgra mang po bas/gas yod pa de tsho phan tshum dbar ngakrug ming rgyag mkhan gyi me kha shas/ (gtso bo be cang /01— —— — ———— ————

dbang grags red zer srol yod )yod pa des ga tshab 'gal ba me lashing snon brgyab pa ltar gyur yod pa red/3 ga tshab gnyis dngos su 'khrug 'dzing byung ba/( 1 ) ga rgyas tshab shi la dgra brgyab pa/ nyin zhig ga rgya 'grar nag gi nang 'a/ror a phrug bcu lhag cig khrid nas zo dor tshab shi'i sgor babs/ a rnam skabs der hor spyi stag brag gi gzim dpon mkhan po sbra chen du skyod ra ra ngo na tha'i gdong latshe sa tshig5 khar /bo rang gi bu chung ba khrid nas gra sgrig la song bas bsdad med pa red/ 'di dus tshab shi'i spo bo zhig gro ngas pas sbra ye nang du klu phug dgon pa'i grwa pa 'ga' shas dge rtsa zhe dgu sgrig nas/ (bdum/ tshigs bzung )yod pa de'i sar ga rgya'i.a phrug kha sha4 ga 'dzul nas a rnam gyi pha g.yang ma chog lo bdun cu zin pa de kha 'don byed sa nas bzung ste gri rub kyis bsad/ ga rgya spun 'khor kha shas khang pa'i thad du rgyug pa'i lo na bcu bdun longs pa'i tshab shi'i bu des ga rgya slebs pa mtho nga 'phralame mda' 'phen chog byas te khang pa'i sgo brgyab nas sdad yod par/ de mtshams ga rgya spebs nas sgo 'bud skabs bu des me mda' brgyab nas ga rgya'i spun nye dpal grags der bsad ba dang / g.yog po skyes rgod zer ba rmas pas ga rgya thad kur nang du ma 'dzul bar khang thog brko rgyu'i sta gon byas / bar der 'gram nag gi spun mched ga rgya rje rgyal gyis tshab shi'i bu mo dang sngon nas 'gab mthun lod pa'i 'brel bar brten bu phyir thon na mi gsod rgyu'i kha chad byas te bu 102

mos/ ming po 'jus nas sge'u khung nas phyir thon byung mtshams ga rgya'i a phrug gisathog kha nas me mda' brgyab te bsad pa dang / de nas tshabashi tshang gi mchod chas phud/ skam chas nang nor dang / der yod rta zog rnams bsdus te 'ded ram khar ga rgya 'gram nag gisasbra nang du yod pa'i klu dgon gyi grwa pa a mchod rnams phyi ru btang ste brjod don/ ngas tshab shi'i pha g.yang mchog rgas po gsod bsam pa med rung a brug tshos lag thal gyis bsad nyes shor 'dug grwa pa khyed tshos de'i ched du yang bskyar dgung zhag zhe dgu thengs gcig skyel dgos/ ma bsda da par dgon par logayong na ngas spra pa la (sa ming )nas grwa pa gcig kyang btang rgyu min zhes bshad nas de'i ched du 'bri grus ma bcu bzhag yod pa red/ de skabs tshab shi dge ma/ (a rnam sring mo )nas a rnam la lan skyel thabs byas rung a rnam nyam snang cher med pa ga rgya ma phyin bar ma log par bsdad pa red de rjerwa/ tshab thi a rnamanas hor spyi stag brag gzim dpon mkhanapor zhu gtug gis ga rgyar 'gug yig 'byor bstun 'gram nag dpon g.yoga'aga' zhig drag chas thu nga mda' rum du bcangs byas te sbra chen du hor spyi'i mdun bcar skabs/ hor spyis ci bya med par 'jam po'i sgo nayogyod don gleng tsam byas pa dang / ga rgyar ngo bstod dang bsgrags kha btaḍa zhig kyang bkon 'dug rjes su hor spyis gong gsal ga tshab byod gzhide thag gcod kyis mdor na phan tshun bsad rmas mgo gtug thog 'phrogayo dngos dang sems can phyir slog gis ga tshab gyod gzhi de gnas skabs 103— — — ——

'grigs tshul bstan yod pa red/ (2) tshab shis ga rgyar dgra len sgrog pa/gore gas 0/ ga tshab gyod don thag bcod skabs tshab shi a rnam gyis ho ra spyingare ngal//'a ci gnang dwangs len dang pod le na skabs ga rgyas ci bshad nya — pa lta bu'i rnamyo/ 'gyur nga/zung ba ma zad/ de nang bzung phye tshu'/ du dngo— 5/rwags ba rgyud gsum naru ga rgyar 'dud de mthun po byed pa 'i bzo bstan/ mi nas/ ring mid ga rgya lha sar 'gro/ rtsi ru/ yod pa tho2 skabasalcags shī tshopasla 11pa' ( 19‘11 ) nang dgong ci ga tshab she a rnamanas blo 'khel lte 'bre da nga gromigs po kha shas zo/nga nas ga rgya la dgra lo 'apro da mi na gror/— tsu —da ska bar sdo /zha na tshos ga rgyar dgra la4 sne lem rgyur shin tu da71'a ba da ra / rang nyid sdod dide byu ra na legs tshul bshad pa'i mthar tsha shi na nyig nga'i ba de bzho— nu 'i — stabasagri zhira'aso srid/rdordo/ /shā su na 2 nge'i ni gi / (shā ji 2 4 sa ji smyo ri rung pha lo 5 tho rang lo bdu ) cur ༄ 5nga pa gri she/ra phyi — pa de blo yul du mi ga/shong ba zhi ga red/ der ngardo dgra ladu/ ma long na song sa steng du bsdad kyang phan pa med / da thengs ngas ga rgyar rjes 'ded bya rgyu yin/ hyed rnams dgra 'bab kyi nang du dka' ngal dang nyen kha 'phrad rgyu g.yol thabs med par brten nga'i dpung rogs su 'gro ma nus rung khag med ces tshig thag bcad nas bshad pa der gzhan dag tshos kyang khyed kyi dngos 'brel dgra lan len rgyu'i blo thag chod na nged tsho su 'gro zer nas ga 104

rgyare rjes 'ded 'gro rgyur thag bcad pa red/ ring min lha skyod ga rgya 'gram nag nang 'khor zo dor tshabarngoshi'i nye 'a gram na/ nam sngon zer ba'i sa char zhag tshug byed skabs1tshab shi a rnam nas bu chung dang g.yog po 'khrid nas 'bri zha bub gcig gi mgo yu mar/ (sha mar ja bcas tshe tshang yod pa )khyer nas gsol zhabs yin zer ga rgya la phul ba dang chabs cig 'di skad do/ ga tshab dbar sngon 'gal ba med rung bar lam rkyen dbang gis de ltar gyur ba red/ 'on kyang da nas ngab khyed la ma thub shanapa lag dmar dgra min/ ma theg gser gyi pha bong rgyu min zhes pa'i dbe ltar dgra zlar mi sems la khyed kyis kyang nged tshang la sdang sems mi 'dzin rab/sa gnang / ngaca pha 'das pozi ched du lo bzhi rgyur lnga grug rtsis la ('i chos me mchod gceg ) gser dgos bal che bas nyo yas shig kyang ma bus bsnams rogs gyis/ tshab shis ga rgya tshang la skyar 'grosas byed par khyed thugaca/ yid ma ches na/ nga'i bu chung 'di yang khyed kyis mnyama'agrid mdzad rogs zhes tshig thag chod po sa bshad skabs/ ga rgya 'gram nag yid ches nas gyed kyi bu khrid mi dgos/ phyin chad khyed kyi zer ltar bya 'os/gser yang 'deng nges shig ngas lha sa nas nyo yong / dngul skur mi dgos zhesabashad de khong gnyis grogs 'grig gi rnaca/ pa byung yod pa red/ de nas ga rgya lha sar skyod nas dus yun gang 'tshams phyin rjes tshab shi a rnam/ dang spun nye spug lha a phrug ras pa skya bdag dang / a jus sogs rta sbod rang 'grig mi hrag dum zhig ga rgya'i rjes 'ded byas nas nag chur 'byor 105

—rjes ma co sprang por mang ḍa brngan gyis ga rgya'i sgar tshug gar babs lta bzhinasong / ga rgya nag chu lho ma shog kha'i ka chen la 'gram rtsa nga'i rga phug gi mdar/ (da lta lho ma chus chags sa'i 'gram ) sgar bab yo da pa'e lcags sbrul zla 11pari tshe jirwa 39yi mtshan mor tshab shis ga rgyari thog la blug pa/ gur gnyis yod/ pa gcig gi nang ga rgya 'gram nag bza' mi dang /g.yog po kha sha/sa yod gzhan zhig gi nang spun mched rje rgyal gtsos g.yob/ po kha shas yod par tshab shi a rnam dang ras pa skya bdag gtsos khag gnyis bgos te/ gur chon gris ba cad de mtshan gtib btang bas/ ras pa skya bdag 'gro sa'i ga rgya 'gram nag gi gur gyi ka rting ab khung du tshud yod stabs la ma seng 'gyel ma thub pa'i mtshams der ga rgya 'gram nag gcer bur bros pa dang mnyam du ngo che bu nor zer ba sbo lug mar bros pa gnyis/ thar ba dang / a rnam gyi satib pa'i gur dero mi re re bzhin zhu yin dris te gri gtsa ba kyi— bas da/ bya gu ga rjes dga' zer ba des nga mkhar dmar bla brang gi g.yog po yin lab pas der gri ma gzhus/ de'i rum du skar sdug zer ba sbas pas thar/ de min mdo pa bstan grags catsha re gnyis la rgyab tu rta hreng la so/nga bas rta drel dang mnyam du lus yod/tshab shis ga rgya'i mi de gar bsad pa ga rgya'i spun rje rgyal dang 'gram nag gi bza' zla/ a phrug ba ngan bstan 'dzin dang / gceng rgod/ 'be tsha khyung sras sogs mi dgu bsad yod pa red/ tshab shi ga rgya'i mi bsad pa ro bsher skabs 'gram nag shor ba shes 'phral nye 'gra5/ 106

du gab yod tshe ngar sha bslang na thon yong snyam te/ kho re ga rgya 'gram nag khyod kyi nang mi rnams bsad nas sha tshe lhu gtub dang / sha chung tig ga tsam gtub yod pas khyod shi ro min na thon shog ces brjod nas 'bod pa byas pas 'gram nag g.yog po gos 'byar zhig dang lhan du kong mog nang gab yod pas thos skabs 'gram nag shor rtsis byasarung g.yog pos nyen mchong ma byed brjod pas nyan tsam byung ba red zer rgyun 'dug yang zer srol gcig la tshab shis 'gram nag shor ba shes rjes rogs pa tshor/ nga ro gseb tu gab nas sdod/ khyod tsho phyir log song la ltos sdod/ 'gram nag nye 'gram la sdad yod tshe gang 'tshams nas 'dir yong nges red de skabs bsad chog ces lab par/ a phrug ras pa skya bdag gis khyed de 'dra ma byed nga tshos blos 'gan mi bzod zer ngu skad shugs chen brgyab pas tshab shis skya bdag gis ga rgyar sasang brda skyel gyi 'dug snyam nas dog pa zas pa ma zad/ 'gram nag shor don ni gtib rgyu'i gur gnyis po yang skya bdag gis bsnor byung snyam pa'i dog pa yod pa red/ rjes sor skya bdag bsad dom yang des brnag yod payored zer rgyun zhig 'dug gang ltara'agram nag shor rjes tshab shis brel tshub ngang ga rgya'i sgar chas dngos rigs rnams bsdus te phyir log yong ba red/ de rjes 'gram nag g.yog po dang lhan du sgar sar ro skor song nas bltas pa'i ba ngan bstan 'dzin shi ma gson yod pa de'i 'og na me mda' stag gzig de lus yod pa tshur blangs nas gnam la gtad de khob /07

gang brgyab pa dang / ba ngan bstan 'dzin nas 'gram nag bsdad pa mthor rjes ya a bu 'tshams 'dug pa blo bde zer nas dbug chad/ de nas 'gram nag gis kho rang gi bza' zla dang / spun gyi ro'i rkang lag bcad yod pa rnams tshur bsdu sgrig byas nas bye ma des gnag po 'di 'dra g.yug 'dug ces brjod skad 'dug nazu/ gsal nas cho bod (sa ming )la sno ma'i brgya dpon nam grags tshang yod sar phyino pas khong gnyi4 sngon nas thag po yin paca/ deng/ gnas skabs zadu she gos spyod chas sprod pa nga nga / rta hreng nas g.yog po da nga rta bcaru/ mnyam du 'byor/ nar kaḍa naru ma/ra ltang 4nyis g.yar na 5 mchod mi sdur te nger zhag sha sdad/ de nas brgya dpon naca grags dang // ryā dzi/'i pargya dpon zur pa she 5 rab blo gros gnyi9 grong bsdur na ga bye mji—/ chu bar bskya0/ ba red/ 4 du 'gram nag nas chu nas ro shes tshong rigs kha sa nas lha sa ra 'khyol thub pa'i dadze/sa cha ni g.yar te gra tre nag da 4 spo la lhag bde na rnamaca lha sar phyin/ lha sa/nga 'apyor nanu/ 'gram nag gi de snga ga rgya tshang gi brtsen ོ ri sku drag gam/ 'khon 'dra4 yod rnga 5 ka shod pa paca 5 sha sa ra ngacar naca ོ shed yud brjod ci rigs byas pas gang ltar bu no g.yar gyi ming thog nas ga rgyar dngul ngang me mda' mang po rag pa red/ skabs der tshab shis kho rang tshang gi 'dru sgrub tshong pa gtsang la song ba de ga rgyas 'phrog dogs kyis der bang chen ched btang zin pa'i mi de'ang ga rgya'i a phrug gi lag la tshud de bsad pa ma zad/ 'gram nag nas a phrug mdo ba bstan grags can bcas kha sham 108

btang nas shog bu la rgyab nas tshab shi'i tshong pa dang 'phrad pas der tshong mi g.yar dar gtsos mi bzhi bsad nas lag shog lnga drug tsam gyi khal 'bru chabs cig blangs pa red/ (lag shog rer khal ma 15re yod/)tshab shis ga rgyar dgra lan sprad de mi dgu bsad rjes phyir 'khor mtshams bon tha'i ngo che gas nga graḍa nas hor spyi la de don snyan zhu phul bas stag brag gzim dpon mkhan po'e ngo tshab phyag mdzod sgur ru/ (ming dngos ma shes )nas tshab thi a rnacha/ 'bre rur 'gug 'bod byed mkhan zhal ngo rgyal mtshan gtsos gra bzhi'i dmag mi kha sha 4 ched btang byas pa dang / ngo che ba/sang grags kyang khrims ca ra yong dgoca/ pari mang ḍa cha byas yod 'dug ska bas der tshab 'i/ a rnar nas zhal ri rgyang mtshan sngon nas ngo shes yi ma sngabs der mjal zhu nga nga gra sgrig yag po byar te/ da res nga nyeng pa che bas 'a bre ru la slebs rjes srog la nyen skyo da med pa sku ngos khyed mkhyen mkhyem zeng naca/ rgyu nor phra'e tsam skyabs 'jug zhu rten sprad pa ma zad/ ga tshab kyi/ gyod doza/ —'dir ngo che gsang grags dang 'brel bsngad yod stabs kho yang khrems ca ra mnyam khrid gnang rogs zhus par de bzhin byaca/ 'thus brjod/ de nas tshab shis nga 'bri rur yun ring khrims khang du tshud rgyu yin gshis rgyag gro 'dang nges khyer dgosapa'inyin re zung bka' 'gyangs gnang rogs zhus te/phyi tshul du rgyag gro'i do po'i sgro sgye'i kha nas nor sha'i lag mgo dang rkang 'ju mthong rgyu yod pa sha sgro red 'dug snyam pa zhig bcos/ don dngos 109— — — —

sgro ba'i nang la mag dang ril ma blug pa de 'dra'i dos brgyab 'ga' zhig bzos nas khrimasasar bcar rgyu'i rnam pa bstan/ nang don de'i ring a phrug tshor gsang brda bskyal nas 'bri rur 'gro khul gyis lam bar me mo 'gag nas sgug ra sprad de ngo che gsod rgyu dang bod dmag cab la sgugs rgyu'i gra sgrigs bzos pa red/ de nas ngo che dang chabs cig hor spyi'i dmag mi de tsho dang lhan du lam la chas pas me mo 'gag tu slebs skabs rta pa dum zhig khra tha re byung bas/ tshab shi shin tu skrag pa'i bzo bstan te de ring ga rgya bo 'dug zer nas bros tshul bstan pa dang bstun nas ngo che gsang grags kyi 'gram la bcar bas des kyang dogs pa zos te bros pas ma thar ba bzung nas gris gtsab ste bas da pa dang / phyogs mtshungs gzhan rnams kyis bod dmag gi me mda'i mde'u dang / spror tog blang nas me mda' khog yan de tsho so so'i ske la bkon pa dang a rnam gyis ngas khyed tsho mi bsad pa dang me mda' mi len rgyu ni sde pa gzhung la ngo log ma casgo /rgya/ /ji /spre :she :sgo 1spro rjes /de /to /spyobyas pas na/ da bzung ba ga dang ma 'u da na ra —stag brag gis rgyal khrims ras su bor nas ga rgyar rku mar dpa' dar dang /spyang ki tshe thar gyi dpe ltar byasapas yin sogs bka' sgyur bshad nas thon pa dang yar tsam na me mda'i spor tog chabs cag rdo phung zhig gi 'phris su bzhag de nas tshab shi khyim du 'byor 'phral snga sa nasathon chog byas yod pa'i nye dud gsum dang lhan du shar rer byang la thon nas mtsho sngon dem ji nyer lnga'i gras dge rgyas shar gling dpon pad bstan zer 110

bar rten nas ga rgyas dgra lan yong dogs kyis ming sgyur byas te bsnad/tshab shi bros pa'i rjes 'ded hor spyis tshwa sho dpal grags gtsos mi kha shas btang ba de tshos 'brog shog gang che shog gi mi 'ga' zhig rog pa khrid nas phar rtsam ded nas ma dod khul gyis phyir log byas yod pa red/(3) ga rgyas tshab shi la ngagra sha spangs pa/ga rgya lha sa nas phyir 'byor rjes/ chu rta zla 8pa (1941)nang ba rgya dpon g.yog skya mi 54lon che'i ko yog dil ltag la'adzomasanas nyin gnyis sdad de/ bsang bskor byas dmag dar khyer te tshab shir dgra lan du chas/ lam rgyus de tsam med pas ka 'brug dpon gyi blon po sku tsha dpa' seng zer ba nges lug ru nyi rdor can mi gnyis sa shes la btang ba red/ song song gi mthar ci smad shing lung nang slebs pa dang de ba'i lung rkyag cig tu nyin gcig dmag skung rgyab nas so len ring thung bzhag de'i gong nas tshab shi gang yo da lta bar skye mdo brgyud du ga byis bla mas gtsos mi lnga sngon la btang rung chur ma 'khor bas de dgong ga rgyas skya mi go hrag bcu drug sngo na la btang ba dang phyi nyin la 'gor 'dzomasadus bzos/ sngon bskyod skya mi 15po phyin pas nam smad rdza la zhig gi rtsar nyal nas gnyid khug la ma khug skabs khyi skad dang rdza rdo ril b.ri sgra thos pas ra langs mtshamasatshab shi yang de ru slebs yod pas me mda' 'then res gang 'tshamasabyas rjes tshab shis g.yol phyin pas ma mthong /111— ————

ga rgya'i gras nam langs skabs la 'gor mnyam 'dzoms byung ba dang myur skyod byas pas sde dud kha shas yod sa zhig na rgas po zhig la tshab shi gar yod btsan 'dri byas pas shing lung nang zer bar yod lugs bshad/ lam nas ga rgya'i rta dril kha shas chad lus byung bde gar bzhag naca/ lam 'khel 'brog dud kyi rta drag kha shas btsan 'phrog byas te skyod pas shing lung tshab shi'i ru thog gi spra mthong sa/ra 'byor/ de gar ga rgyas tshang ma la de ring ga tshab rgya' pham thag gcod kyi skabs yin pas/ rting ma blang na dpa' dar yod tshul bshad pa dang / phar tshur gyi ri rtse 'dzin mkhan mi kha shasamangag rjes mang ma der bzhag dpon 'khor trag thus shig tshab shi'i sbra thog tu blus pa red/ skabs der tshab thi a rnam ni de'i gong tsa ra nas ga rgya lha ru / nas 'khor yong tshod la der dgra lan len rgyu 'am/ gang byed lta bar a rnam dpon g.yog hrag bsdus yar tsho khul du yong ba'i lam bar 'brong pa stod ma'i dpon sba nyog / thug 'phrad byed skabs/ sba nyog gis tshab the chang la ma bos par spra sgo nas bos te/'o skug mo ma/ (ga rgya zer/) rta dmag mang po songathal ngar nga 'a skad cha byed dgos med// mgyolas po gyis zhes ga rgya dgra lan du song ba'i tshig brda gsal po spra da skabs/ a rnam 'tshab sha langs nas phyir nam nyin shed rtso'/ gyis yong / gong gas/la rdza la'i khrod du ga rgya'i sdon skyod a phrug dang thug nas 'phe na res thug rjes ga rgya sbra thog tu slebs/ nyer yod pa shes rung stobs shugs che chung gis do zlar mi thub snyam 1 2

nas kho rang gi sbra mthong sa'i khug kyog gi ri rtse zhig nas rgyang so btsug nas sdad yod pa red/ skabs der tshab shi'i nye dud bcas sbra dud lnga tsam yod 'dug pa mi go hrag bra bo tshe lha las med pa des kyang me mda' 'a phen gin brag 'as/ga tu bros te yib/ ga rgyas sbra thog tu babs nas tshab shi'i bu khyi phrug dang bza' zladzo/ satsos nang mi nye 'khor khyon mi bcu gcig bsad/ zol/ ri nas sdus te nor 100lhag tsam dang / rta/ra/ ca ra ga dos rgyab 'gaspru zhig bcas 'ded 'khyer byas/ zi rnams gyis la/tubs/ sno da rnams bcag ste blta nyan med pa bzos nas phyi dro tsa ma la yar log yar lam a phrul tshor ste za ru ma bcug dpal thangal slebaṭa pa dang ga rgya 3 5 tshab shizi ri bsad mkhan kun bzang sogs la mi re rta re— nga —/ ོ—ra dmas rer 'bri re / da/ tshab shi'i dngo 5 chas rsha ri —5 ) 'ding ཿ pa blangardorga pa'i nang rgya dngul rdo tshad 'ga' zhig dang bka' gtan/ sdo na ka rgya'i gzi byur rigs/ me mda' sbo da rga na bcas dang ma chod chasasil spub/ gla rtsi so gas ga rgya rang gi bdag byas so/ ga rgya 'gram nag tsho sdod ring ga tshab 'khrug pa dngos byas tshul 'di tsam nas 'jug sgril ba red/ tshab shis 'di skor (dus skabs gsal po ma nges/)yar hor pa dgra thengs gcig yong na sa ga rgya'i thog blug ma spob par 'brog shog gang che shog gis sngo na tshab shi rjes 'a ded pa byas pa dang nam rgyun ga rgya dang nye poyod pa'i 'kho'o bzung ste gang che'i dud kha shas kyi semasacan ded pa dang mi gnyis bsad pa bcas byas yod pa red/11 3——/de———— — — —— ——————

gsum ba/ ga rgya 'gram nag nas 'bum rgyad dpon bsad ba'i skor/bod chu lug zla 9( 1943)lo tshab shi skya mi 14 sgo stod rgyud/ stod ma nang nas song ba yin tshul gyi lan brda zhig ga rgyar 'byor yod pa dang / de dang dus mtshungs skya mi bco lngas 'brog shog gang che thog kha nas nor brgya skor jag 'ded shor ba de dag gab sgrig pas tshab shi yin rtsis bcangs teg 'gram nag gisarna a phrug 'ga' shas khrid nas thon pa dang / gang che'i gur gu drag gtsos khyon bsdomasag rgya dang gangache'i skya mi bcu bdun ra mdar rgyug pas nyug chu brgal tsam gyi rgya/ba kyi ri ldebs nas nor lugs brgya skor 'ded mkhan jag pa skya mi bco lnga 'dug pa mthong skabs jag pas sa 'bur gnyis bzung bas ga rgya'i gras kyang tsho gnyis bgos te ga rgya me mda' 'then gin rta 'dur rgyug gis jag pa'i nye sar bcar nas 'phen res tog tsam gtug pas jag pas sa blangs ste phar tsam phyir 'then byas rjes bskyar du sa cha gzhan zhig bzung nas me mda' 'phang bas ga rgya 'gram nag 'dar ma 'dur gyis jag pa'i 'dzingar la bsres nas khyim stod smad tsam nas me mda'i char phabs pas 'bum rgyud dpon gtsos mi gsum de gar bsad/ rogs pa tshos jag pa gnyis bsad/ gsum rmas pas de 'phros jag mi tshangams mgo sgur tshab shi min pa shes nas su yin 'dri skabs 'bum rgyud dpom gras yin bshad/114

(mtsho sngon dem phyi nyer lnga'i gras ) nye thug 'phen res skabs ga rgya'i me mda'i ru la mdel sog nas chag skyon byung ba las skya mi tshang ma skyon med pa red/ de nas gang che'i shor nor tshang ma tshur blangs khar 'bum rgyud pa'i rta sbod tshang ma blangs/ rmas ma skyel yas rta bzhi skur nas rjes su gyod dus bya rgyu bzos/ rjes sor ga 'bum gnyis gyod 'grig par 'bum rgyud dpon gtsos/ bsad pa'i mi stong nor 20 gang ches spra da pa dang / rta re zung phud de 'a phros phyir slog gis kha mchu mtha' 'dom byung yod/ de ma ji'i khul jag pa rgyag res kyi srol ngan yod rung shog kha'i dpon po dngos su jag la 'gro ba nyung / lo der 'bum rgyud dpon gyis nga nang la skyid ོ/ ci 'dra byas rung skyid snang med/ jag la 'gro nas dpa' shed ngom pa dang lam bar sa gar skyid la skyid po gtong /ji/ lha:/ mar /rte/ /ste/ 3)sdi the rto /ba/ /bye/ /rtsa/ lha/ton nga na da las da pa 'dug pas da sa ngas da da ra ra la jag rgyag gcig 'gro'o zer nas/ rogs mi bcu bzhi khrid de lam bar 'thung yas 'bri zho rta rgyab gcig bkal nas yong ba red/bzhi ba/ (ga rgya 'gram nag gis dmag dpon byas te 'brog shog tsho pas dge rgyal ri ba la dgra brgyab pa'i gnas tshul lo rgyus ni zur du bkod yod pa ltar yin/)lnga ba/ ga 'gom bar gyi don rkyen skor/sngon ga rgya bsod namasabastan dar lha sar bzang btson du 115

yod skabs der gro kha skyel mi bu ga rgya skar ma lha bskyod lam bar nyang gu rgyud nas nag shod 'gom sgro ba be hu'i/ (dpon ) nye 'gram nas rta gnyis / sku thor ba rtsad chod pas 'gobya/ dpon la zhus nas de don 'grig min gyi rgyu ma tshan tog tsam byung bar brten ga rgya 'gram nag lha sa nas mar zhor 'gom dpon tshang saro song na g.yo ga pos dpon tshang sbra nang nas me mda' phabs pas dngo rsha tshang ga yog pos 'dzin grab skabs/'gram nag gis dpon tshang bu rmar bu yo da pa'i sbra nang du me mda' lag sbod bzung bzhin 'dzul bca nor bus kyang / khyim sbu ga nas me mda' mar tshad nas rgyag rtsis byed slabs/ nor buri mna' ma nag chu byang ma'i brgya dpom a gong bsod rab tshang gi bu mo des ma byeng zer bar du 'tshang bas rgyag ma nus mus/ ga rgya 'gram nag gis me mda' brgyab nas mna' ma'i gzhog g.yas rmas khang nor bu'i brang la phog nas grongs/de 'phral ga rgya dpon g.yog phyir log de rjes 'gom dpon dngos su byed mkhan spun mched bsod namasalha rgyal so/gas 'gom tsho bas ga rgyar dgra lan len rtsis yod skad ga 'gom bar gyi mi bsad gyod gzhi de mthar hor spyi stag brag ngo tshab phyag mdzod sgur ru'i skabs 'bri rur gyod gtam byas pa'i dang thog cor spyi‘ze bcad khrar ga rgyas ma nyar/ par rta sga brgyab ste thon rtsis byas/ 'gom dpon can nas 'gom ling drug gi hrag dmag dang / dgon gas/ra gyi grwa dmag bcas bsdus te ga rgya 'gro skabs 'bri ru'i yar nang 'phrang 'gram nas/ bkag ste 'dzing rtsis byed 116

nga/ bcas kyi gnas tshul mthong skabs hor spyi'i— lasarogs grwa bzhi'i ru ngapom ba'i bskal bzang dang / de bzhin phan tshum nye phyob/sa tsho pa'i dpocha khag kha yas brel tshub tshub kyis phyogs gnyis dbar rgyug nas ching 'dom gyis 'bras/ re zhig nyi nga babs slar yang kha mchu gtamasanas ru ngapon skal bzang gis hor spyi'i lhanalang du 'gom ngapon dang 'gram nas shag grogs sgrig thub pa bzos rū ga mi stong rnar phon che 'jal rgyu byas pa de ja dang me mda' sogs dngos rigs thog rtsis nas sprod len 'brel yod dpon khag la byed rgyur bcol nas ga 'gom bar gyi gyod gzhi 'dum 'grigs byung yod pa red/ 'on kyang rjes sor stonga'ajal 'phro lus / cung yod par brten/ 'gom nas ga rgyas gzhung gi bka' la mi brtsi zhing log rgyu khram skor btsugs yod pas de med par gtong dgos pa'i 'dod tshul 'khod ba'i snyan zhu brka' shag la phul skad 'dug gzhan yang shing spre ( 1944)lor/ ga rgya 'graca nag gis de snga mi mang po bsad pa'i sdi ga bshag yin zhes tsa ri rong bskor la phyin pa red/ de dus bod sa gams srid gzhung gis mang ḍa gtong byas pa'i dkyil sgar sde pa zhes pa'i bzhung 'bas snang med btang naca/ kho rang gis rong bskor mar ca'i sho stang ba/zhacha zhig sgrigs 'dzugs lta bu byas te klo ba'i nyer 'tshe las sgrol nas phyin tshul lo rgyus gleng rgyu yod 'dug rung nga tshos go tshul tsam las zhib phra shes chogs yod mkhan bka' 'dri zhu sa 'byor ma byung bas bya thabs dben /17— — — /de —

drug ba/ byang sbyi pha lhas ga rgya bsad pa'i skor/chu rta lo nas bzung hor tsho rdzong drug dgos kyi yod pas/ de tshun rdzong 'go so sor rdzong sdod ser skya sbrel po re yong gi yod pa nged/ shing sprel lo'i skor sbra chen rdzong drung 'khor stag sna dang / brtse drung mgodakar/ (ming dngos ma nges )gnyisagasar du slebs pa dang / bkras mthong sras kyang spra rdzong la 'byor nas rgya sgor rtsa tshig sbya ra ba dang jo nga nang khul du tshogs 'du 'tshogs nas rdzong dpon gyi brjid nyams ston pa'i nang 1(1 /)ji (11 snye/( //// ///ga rgya da na ga ga kha shas ra nas nga 'gra ma bar rta ma babs pa dang / nang la yong dus rdzong dpon la gus tshul ma byas pas/ bkras mthong sras dang rdzong dpon shin tu khros kyang ga rgya'i mdun khong khro khog tu bcang nas sdod pa las thabs gzhan ma byung bkrasasras yar log rjes byang spyi pha lha dang / sa gnas srid gzhung la 'gram nag zer ba des gzhung sa'i dpon rigs mig nang du mi 'jogs par mthong chung khyad bsad byed kyi 'dug pas med pa bzo dgos tshul zhus yod skad ma zad/ drung 'khor stag sna dang 'gram nag 'a grig po gtan nas med pa'i byang spyi pha lhar rta dri'u kha shas sprad de ga rgyas rgya mi la ngan 'brel byed kyi yod pa dang /sbra rdzong rkang 'og tu drangs kyi yod pas mi de ma bsad thabs med yin tshul nang zhus nan po byas yod tshul gleng rgyu 'dug rtse drung mgo dmar gye ga 118

rgyar stun thabs byas pa'i grogs po chags yod pa red/ 'brog shog na ga rgya dang ma 'grigs par nag chur bros te bsdad pa'i 'bru zhig lha mchog('bru zhig sgur ru yang zer/) zer ba zhig yod pa des byang spyir 'gro khungs btsal nas ga rgya med pa pazo thabs zhus pa dang / sngon bon tha dpon tshe sgo tshe lcab /sa kyi thag chod byung ba'i rgyal rtse yang skabs der nag chur btson ming nang mi'i rnam pa'i thog byang spyi pha lha la ga rgya gsod thab sa brgyu da skul zhus/ des ma tshad a gong brgya dpon bsod rdor nas sngon 'gom dpon gyi sras ga rgyas bsad pa'i dgra sha len phyir kho rang byang spyi'i spyan bsal yin pa'i gnas babs la brten rgyun du ga rgya gsod thabs brgyud skul byas/ da dung nag shod ge dmar sa tshugs kyi rgan po zhig la ga rgya tsa ri bskor ba'i tshur lam rta 'ul khrid shog bshad par lam yig ston dgos brjod stabs rgan po der ga rgyas rta lcags 'ga' shas ngazhus pa'i gnas tshul zhig byung yod 'dug pa de don nag shod tsho ba gang yin zhig gis byang spyir snyan zhu phul 'byor byung yod skad 'dug gang ltar byang spyi pha lhas ga rgya gsod rgyu gtan 'khel rjes phyi tshul du ga rgya tho gsod par 'gro rgyu ma yin pa shing spre 1944 lo'i ston dus su byang spyi pha lha zi bod don sko ra 'dam dkyil ri shar sna la yong gi yod tshul sbir grags byung bamada' yig kyang sbra rdzong bar 'byor yod pa red/ de'i gong tsam nas pha lhas snyan rong rdzong rgyal mtshan yon tan brgyud ga rgya dang 'brel ba bzang ba'i sbra rdzong brtse drung mgo dkar la byang spyi tsho dem sar 119—/de—— —

pheb skabs ga rgyas byang spyir 'gyangs po ma byas bar mdun du bcar te nye po byas na slad ga rgya tshang la phan thogs che tshul nang gnas yin mngog gis brgyud shod byed du bcugs/byang spyi pha lhas ga rgya gsod mkhan dngos 'ju khas len/ nya dang brgya dpon dang gra gzhi dmag gi zhal ngo blo bzang zer ba gnyis bkod sgrig byas pa dang / ga rgya mgo sko ra gtong mkhan ni ga rgya 'gram nag dang /mdzub mo dmar 'gug gi mna' bzhag grogs po tsha sho dpal grags zhes pa des bya rgyu sogs gra sgrig zin nas sku srung rta dmag nyer lnga khrid da nag chu nas ldag thon gyis chig su bar dang / de nas ‘ no༅ / kyang / de nas ge dmar/ de nas me mo ‘pa brgal nas gdong du 'byor/ gdong lam du bo na thas gra sgri ༅4 5/ spyi ra btang las ma byung nga/sa/ pha lhas bon tha da pon chu mgon dang rgan po bane bkupo/ nas gur 'di 'dra'i nang nga grwa ba gra rkyang zhig gi ngos nas byas na sdod lo rung gzhung nga —/'a ldan pho brang pa'i mkhan rem zhig gi ngos nas bshad na sdod mi lo/ nga zhung sa ri mtshan snyan de dkyus gur 'di tsam gyi nang gshong bar brtsi ba ne ba rnyas bcos che thag chod pa red zer nas rta lcags bstso re gzhu rtseg byas par skyab sa dngos phul nas/ ja dang brgya dpon dang zhal ngo blo ba zang nas nu pargyudabyas pas rta lcags ma gzhus tsam byung ba red/ ya nga 'di'i gong tsam nas drung 'khor stag sna spa cog bshig nas sbra chen du 'gro / gyor ba/ rgya'i nang du phyin nas kho rang go gnas phabs lugs dang da dung byang spyica zhib 120

'jug ngadzad rgyur brten de dus ga rgyas byang spyir zhu phyogs mdzad rogs kyibashad yod pa red/ sno nas pha lha gdong lam nas sbra chen du bskyod nyin ga rgya sdong sa'i spra ba mdor thabs bsu byed skabs/ 'gramanag gis phyogs gcig nas pha lhar mjal zhu phran tsam bzhag nas bcar ba dang phyogs gzhan zhig nas de nyin ga rgya tshang gi khang pa'i zag dmag dar bkal yod pa red/ byang spyis ga rgya bu sang nyin sbra chen du phebs shog lab/de'i phyi nyin ga rgya 'gram nag sbra chen du phyin nas dgong mo nang la log ranapa dang / byang spyis sang nyin yang bskyar phebs shog nga tsho bag rgyag bshad pa bzhin phyi nyin slar yang 'gro rtsis skabs spun mched ga rkya skar ma sogs nas 'o/ da yag tshod yin 'gro ma mang bsdad na dga'/ sde pa gzhung gi sku drag gis ci byed nges pa med ces bshad de bshol kyang 'gram nag gis mi skyon zer nas ma nyar par sbra chen du phyin/ nyi ma dgong dro tsam la pha lha dang lhan du gnyis kos gos chen dmar po gyon nas dmar chems chems su sngar gyi spyi khyab tshang gi dzi phub sa'i rgyud du 'cham 'cham la 'gro gi yod pa red/ 'di'i dus byang spyi pha lhas ga rgya gsod thub pa'i la nye brtag na4ga rgya'i mgo thog tu ku re'i tshul gyis lag pa bzhag pa red zer rgyu 'dugade nas ga rgya'i nad nas ang phrug brgyad dgu zhig go lag rang 'gri sa 'gram nag bsu bar slebs pas ga rgya 'gro rtsis skabs/ blo bur du tshwa sho dpal 'grags/ yong nas des sku ngo sang nyin phebs thon gnang rgyu red/ do dgong ga rgya bu bzhugs/ skyid skyid byed/ bag 'dra rgyag gsung gi12 1

'dug ces bshad pas ga rgya sdod rgyu byas/ ab phrug rnams yar slogagayog po skar sdug gcig po nyar/ ga rgya skabs de dus nas chang mang pobatung yod pas ra bzi yod stabs tshwa sho dpal grags kyis ga rgya'i thung mda'i nang gi mde'u phyir brjes nas mda' log brgyab ste bzhag de nas dgong mo spra rdzong thog khang du byang spyi pha lha dang ga rgya bcas bag rgyag chang 'thung ci dgar byed kyin zhabs gras tshos ga rgya la res skor gyi ngo chang drangs nas yun ring mthar ga rgya ra shin tu bzi ba'i bzo thon/de mtshams pha lhas do dgong bag mtshamasade tshod yin/ ga rgya bu sku ra sbrid yod pas mar skyel zer nas 'gro ba dang / kho rang glog bzhu khyer nas rjes su yong / sngon tshud nas grabs pa'i nya dang brgya dpon dang /zhal ngo blo bzang gnyis ga rgya'i g.yas g.yon rten pa'i zol gyis skas nas — babs skabs skas thog nas rdo bzhus pa dang / 'ju mkhan tshos gri rdo'i char phabs pa'i nang thengs gcig ga rgya'i lag g.yon shor te thung mda' blangs nas skas thog pha lhar bltas te 'phang rung mda' log blug yod stabs ma 'bar ba red/ mtshamasader ga rgyas kho re mna' za na a ga ma mna' zosapas da ma yer zer bod skad 'dug de nas rdo rub brgyab nas ga rgya 'gyel te shi ma gson bzos/ skabs der g.yog po skar sdug gis ga rgya gsod kyi yod pa mthong / gsang spyod kyi spyod mig nang nas mar babs te bros pa'i sbra chen srung dmag gi bza' zla phrug gu skyes ma thag pa zhig la thung mda' 122

sprad nas rum du gab nas yun ring sdad rjes dmag mis rogs byas lcags ri'i gyang rgyab brgal du bcug nas bros thar ba red/ de mtshamasabyang spyipha lhas ga rgya thi ma gson du bkyig nas ka ba la bsdam ste bka' sgyur gtong skabs 'dir 'gram nag rang lo sum cu so bdun red/de nas 'brog shog dpon hor rgyal sras dang rdzong sdodace drung mgo dkar bos te de gnyis/ la'ang bka' sgyur btango zhing / byang spyis ga rgya'i mgo lag breg nas yar 'khyer rtsis byas yod pa med/ phyi nyinanam gsal rjes sbra rjo nga sa srung kha dang dmag ru shog gcig yod pa des ga rgya bsad pa shes rjes sems sdug chen po byed kyi yod pa ma zad brgya dpon skal rab dang / skal ldan zer ba gnyis kyis pha lha'i ngo 'khor la ma 'dod rnam 'gyur ci rigs bstan pa red/ 'brog shog gis 'bri thus ma 35byang sbyir sprad de ga rgya'i mgo lag tshur lon thabs byas pa'i nang brgya dpon gnyis pong shugs rgyab yod skada'adug nam rgyun ga rgya 'gram nag dang sa srung grwa bzhi dpon dmag bar ha cang mthunapo yod pa red/ de dgong byang spyi'i sku srung ja dang dmag nas sa srung gra bzhi dmag la gsang bdam po byas yod pa ma tog ga rgya gsod pa tshor na 'gram nog phyogs su langs nas zing cha slong rgyu yin pa mi tshos tshod dbag byed kyi yod pa red/g.yog po skar sdug bros rjes nang la slebs nas byang spyis ga rgya bsad pa dngadapon rgyal sras 'dzin gi yod tshul bshad pas de 'phral ga rgya'i a phrug —nang gi tsho 'dzin jus 'don grags shos mdo ba bstan grags myul ma'i 123

tshul gyi sbra chen la phyin pa4ga rgya bsad pa las dpon la skyon chag med pa shes/ gra bzhi brgya dpon gnyis nas ga rgya'i bu mo gnyis/ (skar ma dang kun grags spun gnyis )la zer/ pho shad med pas zur za'i tshig dang ab phrug tshos lan po thengs gcig e lon lta tshe lkog nas me mda'i mde'u gang dgos rogs ram bya rgyu'i 'dod tshul gyi skad cha byas pa yem skad shod rgyun 'dug a phrug kha shas kyi byang spyi yar log dus gabong lam nas thengs gcig 'dzing rgyu'i semasathag gcod kyi yod rung ga rgya spun gnyisadang mdo ba stan grags sogs kyi 'dod tshul ni spyir kha gtad kyi thal cha song na/ ga rgya'i 'khor yug chag re bral ba ma zad/ hor 'bros dpon ste yongs/ la sdod bzod mi bde ba yong nges yin pas// da tshar rgyu chang ma tshar bas ya len ma byas na snyam pa yod stabs phyogs 4nga spyi'i rgyu rkyen ba brten mthar a phrug tshos thengs gcig 'dzing snyam byed rgyu'i 'dum pa de 'ang chu yi lbu ba bzhin du gyur pa red/ ga/ rgya bsad pa zi phye zhin nas drung 'khor stag sna spa cog rgyab yod pared/ ga rgya skar 3/ dngag/kun grags spun gnyis nyin shas ring bros tsam byas pa dang / de rjes byang spyi pha lhas 'gram nag ngasad pa las gzhan dag spun gnyis la le 'dzugs nga yang byas med stabs ring min nang la log nas sngar rgyun gnas/ byang spyi pha lhas ga rgya bsad tshar rjes lan seng spra chen nas phyir log gi gdong lam du slebs nas dkyus chas spras te nag chur myur bskyod byas/mi tshos byang spyi tshed mngaḍa ga rgya gsod pa ra yong ba las/ bod don skor 124

bad dkyil ri shangarnar 'gro rgyu zer ba ni mgo skor gyi du yol zhiga'an pa gzhi nas rtogs pa red/ bdun/ tshab gi ya rnam pha yul du log pa'i skor/dge rgyas shar gling du yod pami tshab shi a rnam gyi nang mi dgra la shor rjes sgar yang a shag bza' gser lo zhes pa bza' zlar blangs nas sngon bzhin sbra dud kha shas lhan gcig gnas/ tshab shi'i nang khul a phrug ras pa skya bdag dang / a jus/ sra bo bu gsum kha 'gril nas a rnam la brtsi bkur de tsam mi byed pas a rnam nas slad kho tshos dbang cha 'dzin rgyur dogs nas de tsho med pa bzo thabs brtsam ste/ nyin zhig tshab shi'i spun rdo lung tshang gi bu a rgya zer ba des ras pa skya bdag rdo brko sar me mda' brgyab ste bsad pa dang / tshab zhi'i tsha bo 'u bdag gis a rgyus nyin gung gnyid nyal skabs dang bstun nas gri brgyab ste bsad/khong gnyis bsad pa shes rjes/ bra 'o bu yang gsod par dog te kho rang myur dzon byas pa red/ de rjes tshab shi skya mi 'ga' zhig yar yong nasanag shodagayag pa lding dpon gyi rta 1༷ded pa dang / bon stod thog chen tshang sa nasarta gcig dang / ja rigs tshang gi me mda' bcas 'phrog te phyin/mar yong dus phra bo ja lam nas mgo log sgar chen zhig dang 'phrad nasang nyin shas mnyam du yong skabs rogs pa tshos a rnam la/ mgo log 'de tsho dang lhan du phyin na nga tsho'i rta rnams mi 'phrog pa'i nges pa med pas 'di 125

namakhon gar phyin na dga' bshad pas/ a rnam nas sngar nas jag pas 'grul pa bcoms pa las 'grul pas jag pa bcoms pa'i dpe med / mi skyon zer nas song bas nyin zhig mgo log rbar pas tshab shi'i rta len rgyu'i lkogagros byas thog lam nas 'gro skabs glo bur du sdebs langs kyis 'grulayigasum bzhi res tshab shi'i gras kyi mi re 'jus te tshang ma bzung nas bkyig rta sbod rnams blang ba dang de nas mar tsam khrid pas tshab shis dgralen blang tshul las jag pa min bshad mthar tshab shi'i rta smug 'dzis gtsos rta drug rag yod pa las de byengs tshang ma mgo log sga ra pas 'phrog pa red/de rjes lo shas nas yang tshab shi a rnam gtsos skya mi dum zhig bon tha'i nang yong nas/ bru dmar co dang / gter ldan gnyis kyi rta 3༷skor jag naded byas pa dang / phyogs mtshungaca/ bon tha dpon bru chu mgon sar 'akṣelab byas te sngon ga tshab 'khrug rtsa bom tha yin pas da lta tshab shi tshang pha lhal du chags ba/nas yong men khyed tsho'i lag la yod zer/ dgra sdig daca gyod 'dun gnyis lda na gyi lhu bzhag yod pa red/ chu mgon nas 'brogashog/ dpon rgya / sngas la de don nang mol gyis tshab 'i a rnam bon thar log nas sngar mus sa chaṇa so/ra gnas byung na chu bde nya skyid mi bde rang byams ṇa/nga rgyur brten kha mchu ‘ragrigs na legaca/ tshul gcig gyur byung bas de don thag—bcad thog tshab shi'i sa/ra bon tha dpon rgan gyi yi ge dang spra gas gang mi ched btang byas pa red / bang mi ༅ra gling tshab shi'i sar 'byor bar ma rnam nas dang po nyul ma red zer zur bkar sdig rma yun ring — 26

byayomathar yi ge zhib bltas mtshamasango ma 'grigs 'dum byed mos yod pa sha/// // rtogs nas bang mir sne len gang 'tshams byas pa dang / yig lan skur ba'i nang bon 'brog nas dngos 'brel 'grig 'dum bya 'dun yod tshe sgar bon tha'i dpon tshab do chod gcig dang dpon rgyal sras kyis sku tshab rtong gtong dgos tshul bshad yod pa red/ de rjes bon tha dpon nas 'brag dpon rgyal sras la bka' skor zhus thog tshab shi sdod lo bzo rgyu'i nang don gros bsdur gtan rnakhel byas te bon tha'i dpon tshab 'brong pa mgur skyabs(tshab shi'i nye 'brel )gtsos mi drug bdun zhig tshab she'i sar mngags pasade rnams tshab shi tshang du rabyor nas a rnam dang gros mo' gyis thag chod byung ba tshab shi a rnam pha yul du log nas sngar rgyun ltar gzhis chags sa nga/zung bya rgyu dang / tshab shi'i rkyen ngan mang po'i gyod rtsa bon thar thug pas sdod rten bon tha sde nas dud rnar 'gram lug spro da rgyu/ tshab shis bru sater ldan la rtsod pa med stabs de'i rta jag 'ded byas pa phyiraslog bya rgyu/tshab shi pha yul du tshul ldan ngang gnas na/ sngon 'brog shog gi sde jag 'ded byas pa'i don dag chu brgya zam 'og tu btang nas brda 'ded med pa byas te nang mthun yi ge bzhag yod pa red/ de rjes tshab shi dpon g.yog skya mi nyi shu skor byas te bon thar slebs nas dud nor/'gram lug rnams bsdus/ nye 'brel dang 'khor gzhan dud kha shas sa nas dud nor mi dgos zer nas ma blangs/ bsdus zin pa'i nor lug rnams gnas skabs a ner bcol ba dang 'brog shog dpon sar bcar rjes zla 121

/spre / phyi lo de'iphyi lo byi( )ga lhag tsam bsdad nas ra ga phal ra sa 1ṇa48lor kho tsho dud tshang bzhi yod pa yar log nas tshab shi pha yul du gzhi4ḍazerdo sgyu bo zhi ci go zi rje ( )lopa / da bas ba ngas 'a la na sa chu 'brug 1952 ratshab shi ma rnam khyim du rang nad kyis grongs pa red/)28

ri ba dang ga rgya 'khrugs pa'i skor/skal bzang bkra shis kyis bshad cing nyi zlas bsdus sgrigs byas pa/thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug nang dngos su zhugs myong mkhan skal /khye/ /ni/ (rtse/ 315 /sbyo/ /ste/ /|/ /ji )bye bzang bkra sa yun nga ba lngar bar da nad sa na nas nga sdug gis ma grongs tsam yod skabs bod rang skyong ljongs chab gros rig gnayolo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs kyi las po'i dargangs don la khong gis rga ba blang te mal sa nas skabs 'gar sman bcos byas te sman chen dang dbug snon rgyag bzhin par 'chi nad kyi zug ngu khyad du bsad nas grongs la thug gi bar gsungs thub rigayogasungs pa dang sgrags 'brelayodami sna gzhan dag gis kyang kha gsab phran bu byas te rtsom sgriḍa byas pa yin/hor 'brog shog zer ba ni de lnga'i hor tsho so dgu'i ya gyal/ hor rgyalapo'i bzhugs gnas/ (da lta nag chu yon chus sbra chen shan khongs )yin/ga rgya 'gram nag ni hor 'brog shog khongs hor rgyal po'i nang blon yin/(ming ngo ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zer ) dge rgyas ri ba ni/ de snga'i dems chi nyer lnga'i khongs dge rgyas byang rong shog bzhi'i gras yin/12 — —— /de—

( da lta mtsho sdon zhing chen skye mdo bod rigs rang skyong kra'o/ rdza stod shan khongs )dang po/ 'khyag rkyen skor/bod sa stag lo yas mas tsam la pha yul stod nas yin pa'i rmi 'khyams ngasam grub zer ba zhig hor 'brog shog sang che'i nang slebs te rtasbod nyo tshong 'ga' byas nas zla gcig lhag tsam b.ri da/ de rjes khos der chi nyer lnga ni jag kun byed srol dar khyab che ba de ru 'gro bsam nas nga pha yul dang 'gal ba yod pas dog skrag yod tshul gyisader phyir 'gro dgos pa phar tsam skyel rogs zer zhing / ngas nyin shas sar skyel bar khos lam bar nga (skal bzang bkra shis )la go skabasabatsal nas gsod rtsis byed kyi 'dug ngas kyang dogs zon byas te tshur log pa yin/ mi 'khyams desadage rgyas ri ba'i dpon mi 'gyur la marga btags zhus nas bsdad yod pa red/ nyin zhig mi 'khyams bsam grub kyis mang ra 'brog shog nang nas bros yong bar 'khon lan len mdog kha po red bsam nas nga gnyis 'brog shog tu rta jag e 'gro yul de'i rta rnams ri rgyag byed srol 'dug pas rta jag thob nges red ces bshad/ mang ra dang dbang gis khyod kyi rgyus yod sa de 'brog shog gang che red/ de'i mi drag dar skyabs dang / gur drag gnyis dpon mi 'gyur gyi shag po yin pas dpon gyis rgyab skyor byed kyi ma red ces bshad/ ri ba dpon mi 'gyur ni kha dpung stobs shed che la/130

jag rkun byed rgyur dga' bas kho rang gis nam rgyan rdzig gtam 'don dus / / 〈〈sa btsan po mi yis ma zin le/ byang khog lcags mkhar sbug gu red/ pho skyen po mi yis ma 'dod le/ nga ri ba'i rgya rkya marga sngon yin 〉zer gyi yod pa red/ khos dpon mi 'gyur gyi gshis rgyud shes nas dpon la /rogs ram zhus skabs dpon gyi tsha bos gtsos mi drug rogs mi btang nas — khong skya mi bdun gyis 'brog shog dmar ru thog kha'i nang 'dzul skabs dmar shog jag zon gyi so pas mthong nas sde la sde rgyud kyis lan bskyal te dmar shog 'go ba dbang mchog gtsos rta pa sum cu skor gyis mtha' skor / / te me mda' 'phen res byas mthar jag pa mi bdun tshang ma bsad pa red / / de lan ri ba dpon mi 'gyur gyis 'brog shog gi skye rgu mdo nasir bdal / len mkhan blon 'khor tsha skar rgyan dang / —stag lung ba'o gtsos sgar chungare zung yar lam dge rgyas ri ba'i sa/ mtshazes brgyud dgos stabs dpon mi 'gyur nasalam sgug byas te ja dang khal g.yag sgar chas go lag bcas tshangam 'phrog khar da dung mi kha shas kyi mgo skra'i lhas ma ltag g.yu dang bcas bregs pa dang / rna long yang bkog ste 'brog shog dpon blon la brnyas 7 gtapogyi 'phrin cha bskur ba gtam gyi dpe ru/ 〈〈ltag phud rna long na /phru gsum/ pha rje dpon gyi sku skal red 〉〉ces zer srol yod pa 'di dpon/rgyal sras khyod la gtad pa yin zhes dang / da dung khyod kyi blon ga rgya / 'gram nag ni spa' brag nag gi bu yin zer gyi yod na/ nga ri ba' /'gyur yang brag chen ra rgod kyi bu yin/ (spa' brag nag dang brag chen ra 131——— —— ——— —————

rgod zer ba gnyis so sos rten sa'i rgyab ri'i gzhi bdag gi ming yin )yang 〈〈4btsan lcags dkabasbu gu la/ ri ba mi yi sbyang ki yo da/ bu—rta lcags kyi ser ba yin 〉〉 khyod dpon blon gnyis yong phod na nged skya ser gnyis dang ral kha bkye nas su rgyal su pham thag bcad chog zer ba'i ngar gtam sna tshogs bshad pa red/ de rjes 'brog shog gi dgra lan len mkhan 'phral du thon ma thub pas brnyas bcosabyed chog par rtsis nasari ba dpon mi 'gyur gyis slar yang rta pa sum cu lhag btang nas 'brog shog dmar ru shog la brgyab ste dkar tsha sba chung gtsos dud tshang 'ga' zhig gi gnag phyugs jag 'ded byas pa dang dkar tsha'i bu gro rgod zer ba'ang 'dzin khrid byas pa red/ gnyi ba/dmag rgyag gra sgrig dang dmag bskyod lam bar gyi gnas tshul skor/hor 'brog shog gi thor ma snga phyi gnyis kyis 'brog shog dpon blon labade sdug zhu 'bod dang sbrags ri ba mi 'gyur gyis skur ba'i 'phrin cha rnams zhus pa dang zhor du ri ba'i bu rta hrag tshul gyis dpa' zhum pa'i rnam 'gyur yang ston gyi yod pa red/ de nas 'brog shog dpon sdes ri ba ladagra lan ji ltar len rgyu'i gros mol byed skabs 'gram nag nas ri ba'i brnyas bcoyokyi skad char khong khro gting nas lang ste bshad don/ da thengs dponakhyed dmag la phebs mi dgos/ nga ga rgya bus ri ba mi 'gyur gyi mgo lag 132

len thub pa byed rgyu'am de min dur sa ri ba'i sa thog tu 'debs rgyu yin zhes tshig thag chod pos bamad pa red/ skabs der dpon rgyal sras nas der mos mthun byas te 'brog shog shog kha bcu drugagi dmag bsdu rgyu dang chabs cig sngar yod hor spyi khyab rang gi sgra hor sbra khri 'dus stong shong zer ba'i sbra chen po zhig yod pa de hor 'brob thog gi sa gnas ko yangs de'u stag zer ba la phub nas bla ma gshen spru pa thugs rje nyi ma zer ba gdan zhus kyis spyi rim gzab rgyas tshogs/ lcags 'brug zla 7(1940)lo dmag rtsis blangs nas go lag rang 'grig gi rta pa 250dang / dmag dpon ga rgya 'gram nag la jus bkod pa nag ru nam mkha' bsko bzhag byas/ nga tsho gang che shog dang thog dmag 'gro g.yol thabs kyis phran tsam nar 'gyangs byas rung dpon blon gyis bka' nan che bas u tshugs ma phod nas rang 'babs skya mi bcu gnyis de dmag sdu sar yong dus rjes ma'i gras red 'dug (de'i nang da lta bsdad pa nga dang dbang mchog thog med dar btsugs/ dung skyabs bcas lnga yod )nga tsho khang skor gyi skya mi bdun mnyam du dmag sgar la sleb nye'i mtshams dpon blon gnyis sbra ltag tu bzhengs yod pa mthong 'phral/ gus lugs ltar rta babs rtsis byas kyang dpon gyis mi btang ste rta ma 'bab shar rgyag song gsung bzhin rta ma babs nas dmag sgar du song ba yin/ de mtshams ga rgyas khyod tsho slebs phyi rung 'byor skabs mi rta hrag tsam 'dug zer nas mnyes tshor 33

gnang skabs sdon du nga tsho sleb phyi bas nyes chad phog mi yo nga ngam bsam gyi yod pa de'i skrag snang 'jags song / pha yul dge rgyas ri ba nas yin pa'i mi 'khyam rme ri dgra 'dul zer ba skongs 'dug pa de lam rgyus byed mkhan du khrid rgyu byas 'dug kho'i ming la'ang cang se zhes btags 'dug (cang se zer ba ni bo'o lugasakyi phyogs thon lam grogs kye lha yin pas ming de rten 'brel byas pa zhig red )phyi nyin bsang khri mtho pong bsang dud btang ba dang dmag mi rnams/ go rta rang 'grigs gis bsang bskor byas pa dang dus mtshungs bla grwa rnams kyis lha gsol dang dmag dpon gyis hor lugs kyi phud rgod mcho da/ sngags pa tshos dar rdeb 'phrin / bcol byed ba'i na par dmag mi rnamaru dmag bsdus sar 'byor rim bachin skya dar gcil phre nga byas nas thon pa'i phyed lhag rdzogs mtshamarme ga rgya 'gram nag /bong rang rgas chen smug khra'i tshar tsag cig gyon/ sbod rga na ra zhes pa'i me mda' sbu ra de khur/ hor rgyas sras kyis mdzod dar zhig mgupa du skon/ rta 'brong nag pa bzhon te nang 'khor ga rgya'i a phrug skya rme nyi shu skor bcas de snga'i hor spyi khyab tshang gi hor ser mtshon pa'i gos ser gyi dmag dar de sgengs zhing bskyod kyi 'dug nga tsho yang de'i rjes su / 'brang nasabashar song ba yin/ de nub gur dkar tshwa kha zer sa nga sgar rgyab te/ ga rgyari a phrug mdo ba bstan grags nas rtsis rgyud ltar dmab rgyag gis tshes grangs dang sgra can bskor te dmag rgyag skabs kyi kha gtad phyogs gtan 'khel byas/ phyi nyin nas bzung nyin lnga yi thog tu dems 134

ri 'brong pa smad ma'i sa thog tu 'khor khong bye la'i phar nang la sleb/nyi nger 'brong smad spyi srib kyi ru dud rnams ston mtsher skya spo byed skabs ngang 'khel 'dug pa sa nga tsho mi kha shas kyis mi tshang zhig la lci ba sprod dgos 'a ba skabs zi de'i nang nas mi lo na mtho tsam zhig thon nas khyod tsho mi rkyang rta rkyang gi lci bam rnyed na nga tsho skya spo byed mkhan gyi ga la rnyed zer nasaje da ma byung / de mtshams nga tsho'i gras kyi rta phug a khi zer ba des nga nang du 'dzung nas lci ba sgye phyed gcig 'dug pa de 'phrog ska bas mi de ngar lang nas khyi lto blud sa'i shing phong de sanya' bar gzhus nas thang la ril ba dang / ngas gri bton nas kho'i gnya' bar gri ltag gzhus pas khrag thon nal sa la 'gyel song / de mthong ba dang nye 'gram gyi ru dud tshos mi bsad song zer nas me mda' lag khyer gyis mi 'ga' zhig ne'u thang du rgyug ste/nga tshor 'dzing rtsis byed kyi 'dug skabs der ga rgya mgyogs myur yong nas rta las babs te kho rang gis rang gis 'gram par 'dzub mo btsugs te mi de tsho la / 'dzing bsam na nga la rgyob nga ga rgya 'gram nag yin zhes zer skabs kho tsho tshang mas mgo sgur ba yin zer ba las me mda' rgyag phod kyi mi 'dug de nas lam du bskyod bzhin par lam khrid rme ri da gra 'dul nas ga rgya la de ring gang ches don med 'dzing mo slong ba ngang / khar seng khe tshab nang nab/ yong dus kyang zho 'o sogs 'phrog bcom byas par kho tshos ri bar lan brda skyel nges red/ gal srid ri bas dgrazon gyi gra sgrig byas tshe sa cha shin tu btsan stabs nga tshos dmag rgyag rgyur 135

dka' ngal yong gi red ces bshad par/ ga rgyas 'o na nga tshos ri ba la gzhan gyis lan brda ma 'phrod gong slebs thub pa'i mgyogs lam btsal na dga' zhes shod skabs/ rme ri dgra 'dul gyis mgyogs lam yod kyang lam 'phrang dog pas kho tsho'i bang mi las snga 'byor yong dka' rung mnyams slebs tsam yong mdog red ces bshad bzhin nga tsho mgyogs lam debargyud song bas de nub rtsam sder kha zer ba der zhag chugs byas nas sdad/phyi nyin dngos su ri ba la dgra rgyag rgyu yin pas rme ri dgra 'dul la ri ba'i sa babs skor skad cha dris/ khos sa cha de ma gzhi byang 'brog gi sa yin rung gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i sa btsan yod/ byang khog rong dang lcags dkar spu gu zer ba de gnyis gcong rong shin tu dog la brag 'phrang chu 'bab yin pas lam de brgyud dgos pa dang / brag chen bu zhes pa nas 'gro lam thabs chags tsam yod la mdo ru sa rgya cung yangs bar kho tsho'i ru dud phyug po rnamasasdod sa red/ glang chen sna ljag ces pa bragari glang sna 'dra ba'i rog tu ri ba dpom mi 'gyur gyi sdod sa red de'i 'gram nas rdza chu babs kyi yod/ de min gyi la sgo dang brag 'phrang rnamasakyang thin tu dog po yod pa red ces bshad/ de nub ga rgya 'gram nag gis dodagong snga tsam nyal nas gnyid thun gcig khug rjes ja bkol te nam dkyil tsam nas ra ring mabargal thub pa byed dgos zer bzhin nga tsho nyal tsam byas nas yar langs te za btung tshar rjes ga rgyas dmag rnams skong 'tshogs byas thog a phrug mdo ba bstan grags nas ga rgya'i tshab 136

byas te bshad don/ mdang nub a bu'i dgongs lam ltar na/ nga tsho'i mirmas pa 'dra byung na ma gtog gsod shor gyi ma red/ nag ru nam mkha'i bu de sbra yi re mig tu 'dzul song ba rmis byung de ring khrid rgyu med/ de 'phros hrag bsdus rta pa brgya thams pa dngos su dgra rgyag sar 'gro dgos gsung gi 'dug ces zer song / de mtshams nga tshos so so'i rta khrid nas la brgal te ri ba'i dbyar sa rgyab rong zer sar slebs pa yin/ lam bar zhag tshugs byed sar dgong rma (dal ba'o )dang / me mda' 'dzam grags zer ba'i sgar mda' thengs mang rgyag gi 'dugagasum ba / dajos su dgra brgyab pa'i skor/ga rgya 'gram nag nas dang thog nga tsho gang che'i mi rnams la brag chen ri ldebs brgyud nas so ltos la byang khog dang lcags dkar brgyud du ri ba'i sde e 'dug mthong thub pa dgos zer ba dang / dmar—ru'i mi rnams ka gu ra bar nas so ltosal brag chen brgyud du ri ba'i sde e 'dug mthong thub pa byas rjes 'phral du lan dgos zhes zer bzhin nga tshos so bltas nas tshur 'khor ba dang / ga rgyas gtsos dmag mang rnams kyis bsangakhri mtho po zhig brtsegs 'dug pa de ru hrag bsdus kyi rta nga/ brgya bdam gses kyis bsang bskor byas pa yin/ rta pa brgya po ni/ dmar ru/gong tha/ brda chen gong tha/ glan ne/ gang che/ khang skor/ ga rgyadapon 'khor bcas mi rta hrag cing go lag bzang ba'i thog sngon gyi ༵༷ra ————— —

ma kha shas bsnan nas khyon rta pa brgya gtan 'khel bzosapa red/ skab 5 der ga rgya 'gram nag gis de ring nga dgra bo yis gsod thub na ro chas re 'dug snyam gyi red/ des na gzab spros yas po byed dgos zer nas gos chen smug khya'i tshar rtsag gsar pa sha chung zhig gyon te gzi byur phreng zhags gnyis g.yas g.yon nas ga sha'i tshu9pagyis gon/ gser ljang brdung gi ga'u gnyis brang dkyil dang rgyab dkyil du 'khel bar byas/ de min zha lham nang 'jug tshang ma gsar rkyang brjes te mdzes nyam 4/ dod par byas de mtshams nga tsho g.yul sar 'gro mkhan tshang ma rta la bzhom nas chas pa/4 kadoḥ ra bar ma la slebs/ pa dang tshang ma rta las babar naca/ mnyams 'dzomar do byas thol/ ga rgya 'gram nag nas da lta dgra dngos su rgyag rgyu yin paru dmar ru sho4/ gis/ brag chen ri rtser 'dzegs nas ri bzung thog mar mar blug dgos/ gang che khang skor gnyis mi rta hrab/ pas bis rdze 'gag brgyud na— glang chem sna ljab na5 zhu bskyod de rgya / dgos / gong tha ni ka gu'i ra bar bsdad nas sa/ srung mkhan yin/ glar des bim rdza 'a—ga srung mkhan gyir nged ga rgya dpung 'khor gyis brag chen phu nas mar blub ste brgyab yong ze nas bkod 'doms byas song / dus tshod ni nam gsal pa ma gsal ri ba'i ru thog tu blug rgyu red ces zer gyi 'dug de'i snga nyin ri ba'i sdo rnams ston mtsher babs ma thag yin 'dug pas phyi dro tsam lari ba dpon mi 'gyur tshang sbra phub nas thab ka bca' bzhin yod stabs glo bur du skya mi nag po zhig slebs nas dpon mi 'gyur la thug 'phrad byas/ skya mi de pa ra138

'o sgo 'phralami 'gyur khyimanang du yar 'dzul nas lag chu 'khrud bzhin par da ho ra dmag bo ran 'dug nga lam seng dmag grab tu 'gro dgos 'dug ces bshad/ de 'phral kho rang gi bza' zlas de sngon a pho khyed kyi gang zer las ngas sne gcig shod ma myong da res don chen yin pas khyed tshe gcig gi ri ba mi 'gyur byed na dga' ba las nyin gcig gi ri ba mi 'gyur byas na mi dga'/ 'di lo nga rmi lam yang sdug po 'ga' rmis byung / de ring a pho sted byang khog rong du g.yol te de nas rdza chu brga lathabs byas 'o e drag de ring hor la ma 'dzing na dga' zhes bshad/ mi 'gyur gyis bza' zla'i ngag bkod la ma nyan par de ring hor dmag slebs dus g.yol rgyu phar bzhag hor gyi dmar las de ngas las dgos kyi red zer nas kho rang dang sdu ma grwa pa zhig yod pa gnyis ka rta sbod rang 'gri9 kyis thonate ri ba'i sde dud rnams la lan brda byas nas dmag skya rkang brgya lhag skor bsdus yod tshod 'dug dmag de rnams gtso shugs gcig bsdus kyis brag chen mdo 'gram gyi lam 'gag nas kha sgug sprad de hor dmas gcig kyang ra shor ba byed dgos ces bkod sgrigs kyang byas yod 'dug kho tshos nam stod nas sgug ra sprad tshar ba dang nga tsho nam smad tsam la ma gtogs 'byor ma thub/ snga nyin ri bar lan skyel mkhan rta ba na4 po de 'brong smad spyi srib shob nas btang ba zhig yin 'dug nga tsho gang 'khor gnyis kyi dmag mi rnams nam ma gsal tsam la bis jo ri 'phrang brgal dgos 'dug pas 'phrang der rta khrid nas rkang thang gcig139—————— — ——— ——— —— — —

hrengabyas nas 'gro thub tsam byung bas lam nyag phra po zhig la/ bur du zag na chu nang du lhung 'gro ba dang gyen du 'tsheḍa sa med pa'i g.yang gzaracanal4ltag la sgug ra sprod sa'i sa phug chung chung 'ga' yod sa zhig 'dugang tsho ni kha ba 'bab ba thin kha mun gyi khrod nas 'gyel brdabs kyi 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs glo bur du khob khob ces me mda'i skad dus gcig tu grags pa dang mdun phyogs la blta dus mdong mo zhig gi kha nas me dpung thon pa ltar dmar tshub tshub yod pa/ rgyab dang nye 'gram la bltas na me 'od kyis gsal lhang lhang mthong ba zhig byung song / me skad kyi khob sgra dang po bsgrags pa dang nga tsho'i gras kyi mi sdon ma de lam 'og tu zag song ( mi gnyis pa ni rta phug a khi yin pa dang / gsum pa nga rang yin/ a khis mdun phyoḍa la gtad nas me mda' rgyag gin song / ngas rta de dbyuganas rkang thang du me mda' khyer nas sgug ra'i phyogs su lcebs song bas khongatshos mda' char phabs rung nga'i lus ma thebs/ nga tsho rim bzhio 'gag gong du thon pa dang / ri ba'i kha sgug sprod mkhan rnams kyis hor dmag bkag ma thub par kho tsho nag thar re bros bzhin 'dug kho tsho'i rta bzung yang de'i nye 'gram du yod pas rta rnams bskor ba kyil le dang / yob kyi silasgra kyang lhang nger 'dug de nas nam langs bzhin yod pas/ ri ba'i dmag rmas ma zhig lam 'og tu zag 'dug pa nga tsho'i gras nas ju mor dar skyabs kyis de ma gsod skad cha 'dri dgos zer rung / a khi nged gnyis kyis ma nyan nas me mda' shan rub byas te bsad pa yin/ phar blta 140

dus ri ba'i dmag khag gcig brag chen nang du song ba dang 'ga' re bur du bros kyi 'dug ga rgya'i gras kyis brag chen phu nas mar blug dus ri ba'i dmag dang thug nas 'then res byas te ri ba'i dmag 'ga' zhig der bsadatshar ba ma zad kho tshos ga rgya'i gdong ma brtan nas lagram lung gram gyis 'thor 'gro ba dang chabs cig ga rgya'i gras rnams nga tsho dang mnyam du 'dzoms byung / de nas nga tsho mnyam du mar tsam song ba dang / ri ba'i dud tshang 'ga' zhig gi sgra rnams thang la 'gyel ba'i steng du thal ba bkram 'dug pa/ de ni nga tshos mi mthong ba'i ched du yin pa 'dra/ de ru bud med kha shas las gzhan gyi mi ni mi 'dug yar tsam zhig na mi 'ga' zhig gis phyugs zogs dum gcig ded nas bros 'gro ba mthong / de mtshams nga tshos rjes 'ded byas nas dang thog ga rgya 'gram nag gis khyod tshos ltos dang ngas gcig rgyag zer nas/ lang mda' byas nas brgyab pas mi gcig der bsad song / mi gcig la kha nas thon la khad ngas me mda' gcig brgyab pas mi de rmas nas dal bur 'gro skabs rta zhug a khi lam seng rgyug nas mgo la gri gzhus nas bsad pa'i klad khrag a khi'i lus thog tu 'gos nas /nga slebs dus kho kha ba'i nang la phar 'dril tshur 'dril byas te klad khrag rnams 'phyis thabs byed kyin 'dug da dung me mda' gnyis nyis 'khur byed mkhan skya mi zhig bros nas rdza chu brgal rtsis byas nas chur lceb pas pha rir thon ma bub/ sa cha der ri kha'i rgya rdo tshang dang mang ra'i gras phyus pomi tshang nyi shu'i yas mas tsam gyi sbra gzhis 'dug pa der rgyab nas sbra kun 141

bri gtsab byas te 'gyel/ khro zangs dang sdod chas sogs chag dum du btang ste med par bzos pa dang gos/ lham dang 'phyar ba sogs gri gtub byas/ gro nas dang za chas rnams thang du bshos nas rta la zar bcug pa dang 'phro ma rnams sa la bshos gtor byas 'o zho rnams btung te dgra bor thub thub dang /rang snang gang shar byas pa yin/ kho tshos pha ri tshur ri nas me mda' rgyang 'ben byed mkhan las gdong gtug shi lcib byed mkhan 'ga' mi 'dug spyi ra btang 'brog mi'i dgra 'thab sgyu rtsal ni rang byung gi gab rdzong sa 'bur dang rdo 'bur la thod btug nas lus sbo nyal byed pa'am/ grog shu ra dang sa sbug ko mog sogs btsa'/ nas lus cher mi mngom/ par dgos/ mod/ 'gram nag gis de las ldog ste/ marngan che ra nas tsos 'du4 gi lag mda' rgyag pa dang mda' char phab rung goms stab brto/ pos nyam snang med par 'gro gi 'dug 'on kyang lus dang gos la mde'u dngos su thebs shulani rtsi 'dug nga'i semaru / la 'di mtshor mi chod zer ba de bdem nges min nam rṣa masapa dang / gang ltar kho la gdeng tshor yod pa 'dra bsam byung /de nas ga rgyari gzhe mis nyi ca/rishar rdod tsam la sngar bshad pa'i bu nga ma ri rdosproshā smyo ri rig mokhob rong 3 ra ba'i sa btsan ming grags can de brgyud nas thor song / khongarnams 'gag rong de brgal cwa bas dka' ngal ga 'dra byung yod med dang khagag rong brgal rjes dgra 'thab ga 'dra byas min zhib gsal ma shes/ ja chu'i pha ri tshur ri nas me skad theng theng zer ba rgyun ma chad par go rgyu 'dupa /nga tsho'i gras nas mang ra'i sdod sar dge rgyas rdza gseb kyi tshong pa ja sgam 1 /2

sogayomi kha shas thur du 'jab yong ba dang / gsham nas brdal chen gongatha'i ju mur dga' bde dang / gang tshe'i thogs med gnyis gyen la yar 'dzegs/ de min rnams kyis thad nas brag phug la gtad nas me mda' rgyag bzhin par khong gnyis kyi mtha' bskor te nye bar bcar ba dang lag mnyam 'gyog gis rdo phong gi 'gram nas me mda'i rting pa bkyag nas thengs mang brgyab par mi gcig po de'i mgo la phog nas klad pa gtor te bsad pa dang gcig shos de'i lus la mthu'u mang po thebs nas rmas skyon tshabs chen bzos shing / kho rang gi me mda'i mde'u rdzogs nas ci bya med par me mda' gnyis lag khyer gyis brag phug nas thon te brag lam phra bo zhig nas me mda' lag rten byas te 'gro skabs nga tsho'i gras kyis mgo sgu ra zer nas yang yang bos kyang ya lan med par am gtsigs bsdams nas 'gro gi 'dug de 'phral nga tshos mda' rub brgyab nas sa la thengs resgril yang sgar yang langs pa/ de 'dra kha shas byas rjes nga tsho 'gram du klebs nas gri gtsab byas rung kho'i dbug chad mi thub pa dang mthar gos bshus nas blta skabs lus por mdel rmas ja tshags ltar 'dug rung da dung shi mi thub pa de 'dra ltas ngan zhig red bsam nas nga tshos/ brag kha nas rteto 11 1—1 1ba/ cas :sgo1sno :rdogayangs la bskyur sha 'a ra rus 'a ra ba sa pa na/ ba dpon gyi spun tshul khrims zer ba'i grwa pa de yin pa dang / gcig shos ka ligator nas bsad pa de ri ba dpon mi 'gyur kho rang yin pa rjes su gzhi nas shes byung / nyi ma phyi yol tsam la ga rgya'i gras kyis nor chig stong ma

dmag tshos dgra thob kyi nor lug rnam ded nas lalol gshar 'go tshuḍa/ de mtshams glo brir du khu phang thar thor du 'babs bzhin gnam gshis 'thib pa dang bstun nas nged gnyis phyir 'then gyis dmag mang gi rjes zin pa byas payin/ de nas nga tsho phar 'gro'i rta pa brgya po mang che ba bla 'gril ba dang dus tshod kyang phyi por slebs 'dug de mtshamasab/ rgyas dgra thob kyi no ra lug rnamasa'abrog shog gi dmag byings dang ga skor bcas kyis 'ded thub pa dgoca// gangache shog gi mi gcig rmas song ba khong tsho rmas ma skyor nas 'gro ru bcug dgos zhes bshad song / de nas yar yar 'gro mus su mang che ba'i nor rkyang 'ded kyis sdon du 'gro mus la ga rgyas gtsos nga tsho nyung shas 'ig lus 'ded sar lhag 'dug pa lug ha cang mang drag pa dang lam yang cung zad 'dzol bar brten lug rnams 'ba' tshag ldir nas bskor ba 'khor gyinasdod pa las mdun du gom gang tsam yang bgrod mi thub/ lug gi 'ba' sgra'i khrod du me skad mi go rung lug mang po phag dang phag zer nas ril 'gro gi 'dug la lug khrag kyang gang sar dmar shar shar 'gro gi yod stabs nga tshos phyir bltas byas pas rgyang tsam nas skya mi bra nag zhig gis gtsos rta mi kha shas kyis nga tshor me mda' 'phed gyin rjes 'ded yong gi 'dug de nas gtog tsam song ba dang lam ltag gi brag gseb nas kyang rma skad kug kug zer ba dang / nga tsho'i gras kyi ba ngan slon lam bsad song zer ba zhig thos byung / de 'phral ga rgyas de'i lan po zhig ma loca po nga milog zer nas me mda' khyer te rgyug song yang yud tsam nang/ tshur log byung rte/146

ngas a bu gang red 'dug lab pas/ bla btsong mdi'u zil gyis brgyal pa las skyon mi 'dug zer/ de nas ngas ra lug 'ded nas 'gro thub thabs gtan nas mi 'dug nyi ma phyi po 'di tsam phyin pa dang dgra yes memada' yang 'phen bzhin 'dug lug lon na za ran dus 'brog shog phyed drug brgya yod/ 'ded ran dus nga tsho kha shas las mi 'dug ces bshad pa yin/ ga rgyas de bden/ ngas khyod sngon dus mi hab be hob be dang dkrog dkrog tsha bo zhig yin gyi red snyams yang da lta'i skad cha de do dotan tan dang bden mdos kha po zhig 'dug nga tsho'i me skad kyang da nang las zhan du song 'dug lug bskyur na yang bskyur zer byung / de —nas nga tshos lug dbyug nas/ song bas sa yang rub song / nor 'ded kyi gras nas mang che ba gcig thar gnyis thar gyis sngon du phyin 'dug rjeca ma'i gras ga rgyas gtsos nga tsho rta pa bdun brgyad tsam lus 'dug de nas rjesa'aded kyang yong mkhan mi 'dug nam stod ring song bas sngon ma'i gras rnams rgyab rong phu zer sar sgang babs nas sdad 'dug de nub nor srung mkhan gyi thun pa sdod res/ bzhag ga rgya'imab phrug sdo na ma 'gro mkhan tshos 'brog shog dmag mi 'asa' zhig la khyod tsho'i me mda' da gra la 'phen mi nus la nor 'ded dus kyang go mi chod pas me mda' yod med khyad par mi 'dug zer nas me mda' 'ga' zhig 'phrog 'dug ga rgya dang nga tsho 'byor rjes me mda'i bdag po rnams kyi ga rgya la zhu 'bul gyis sdug nga — — ḍa gi 'dug ga rgyas gnas skabs dbyugs zhog phugs su 147

'phrog gi ma red/ yar slebs rjes sprod kyi red ces zer song mtshanamo nyal rjes rmas ma byi lu tsha bas 'khrul nas de gyob dang de gsod zer gyi 'dug rkang thung rin chen nas ga rgya la byi lu 'khrul lab rgyag gi 'dugapas/a busabaka' bsgo byed rogs zer song / ga rgyas ngas bka' bsgo mi shes sbod rga na ma mgo la 'jog dgos red dam/ 'don pa 'don dgos na khyod kyis thon zer bar/ rkang thung rin chen gyis khyed da gra lha 'khor ba'i mi yin pas me mda' yis bka' bsgo byas kyang los chog zer zhing / khong gnyis byi lu'i sar so nga nas sbod rga ma ma mgo la 'jog tsam byas rjes byi lu'i 'khrul lab 'jabathing phyin song zer rgyun 'dug de nyin dmag 'dzing skabs 'brog shog khongs ar shog gi mi tshab shi g.yu nga dbang zer ba de sdon brdal khal ri bas 'phrog pa'i do bdag yin pa de dmag sar yod/ 'khrug 'dzing dngos kyi nang kho skrag thag chod naṭa/ brag — ldebs chu 'babs pa'i chu 'og zhig la gab nas rjes su chu dzar re yar langs yong ba red/ rjes su mi rnams kyi kho la 'phya dmod byas nas bshad pa/ g.yung dbang chu la rang dbang thob/ da gra chu chang 'dres dus—chu nang 'dzul/ ar shog mi la chu gshog yod ces zer rgyun yod/bzhi ba/ hor dmag gis ri ba gtor nas yar log pazhi lam thud kyi gnas tshul/de'i phyi nyin tsher nag la gnyis brgyud nas 'gro skabs/ khal sga148

khu‘bo dpon sba nyog kyang der bsdad 'dug tshong pa de ga rgya'i tshong shag yin pas der ngal gso dang gleng mol byed skabs dpon sba nyog nas ga rgyard lam a phos de 'dra'i dgra chen zhig brgyab song / nged 'brong pa dponami shi khyi lus yin rung spra hrul ser gog ma da dung bsdad yod pas kha mchu zhig gtam na 'grig tsam yong thub kyang da tshar ba red zer/ de mtshams ga rgyas khyod de 'dra'i kha mchu gtam 'dod yod na sdon dge rgyas lta 'brug dpon tshang nang dme byung dus nged ga rgya tshang gi bu lon ṭam rdo sum brgya'iskor zhig de ru 'thor yod pa de'i kha mchu 'dum thabs byas na 'grig ces bshad/ sba nyog nas kha mchu de a mtsho bstan chos dang ga rgya tshang gnyis /mi gnyis sems gcig lta bu'i grogs po yin stabs snang dag ci yod zer ba dang / ri ba mi 'gyur spun gnyis bsad tshar ba tshed dam zhes dris gong / ga rgyas ri ba spun gnyis bsad yod med gsal po mi shes/ khong tshos mi gnyis sdeb gcig tu bsad pa de'i gcig gi glo la rgya dngulaglo khug cig yod pa'i nang du yig dzar kha shas 'dug pa de'i nang rta zog 'ga' shong ba'i don yod pa dang / mi 'gyur mkhyen mkhyen zer ba 'a/bod 'dug stabs mi 'gyur yin shas che zer gyi 'dug ces bshad song / sba nyog nang/ ri ba dpon spun gnyis bsad yod med khur mda' blang yod tshe der bltas na shes thub ces zer bar/ ga rgyas nag ru nam mkha' la mre mda' gnyis pokhyer shog brjod nas kho la bstan song / de 'phral sba nyog ngo mdangs 'gyur bzhin mig rtsa mchi zhag 'khor ba dang / ya de 'dra bzos 'dug pha150

yang khos khyod tsho'i gras kyi nor 'ded rnams kyis lam brgyud nor 'dres pa rnams mnyam 'ded byas song zer/ ga rgyas mi mang po 'dzul na rku rgyag gi red zer gyi 'dug ces lab par/ a phrug tshos gcig langs gnyis langs kyis sgo khre dga' tshul thang la brdabs nas nyes brdung rgyun chad med par btang ba dang ga rgyas da brdung ba las bkyig bzhag na nyams mtshar zer ma thag a phrug tshos rtod thag blangs nas mi de tshag po bzhin bsdam skabs rkang thung rin chen nas khyi 'dog byed rgya sar lcags thag cig bu dung nas 'then te sku rgyag gi 'dug khyim nang phor ba dngul shan zhig 'dug pa de yang gcig gi rkus tshar 'dug ngas khoca/ bshad pa bden 'dug bsam byung / ra mdar rgyug yong mkhan spo ru'i me rgan pa zhig sngon du yong gi yod pa red/ nga gnyis rjes nas yong skabs glo bur du ga rgya rta 'brong nag 'dur ma rgyug gis phyir log tu yong gi yod pa dang /de rjes hor dmag skya mi mang po zhig kyang phreng thag chad pa bzhin yong bzhena'adug gang yen snyams phyi ltas byas pas rjes nas skya mi 'ga' zhig gra thar re yong gi 'dug sdon nas yong mkhan spo ru'i me rgan pa des kha btag g.yug kyin 'go sgur ba yin zer ga rgya'i mdun du rgyug gi 'dug rjes nas yong mkhan sbo ru'i rta ba rnams ga rgya yin pa shes pa dang la gram lung gram gyisaphyir bros song / de nas nga tsho dro tshugs tshar ba dang mdo ba bstan gragasakyis ga rgyar bka' 'dri zhus pa/ ga rgyas spo khri dga' tshul kho rang da gar 152

dbyug zhog ces zer/ de nas nga tshos kho bskyur nas yong ba yin/ hor dmag rnams pha yul 'brog shog tu slebs ran khar 'ga' shas kyiyodanangs zhus—dang 'ga' shas rang 'tshams byas te nye 'gram gyi sde nang song bar brten mi yang nyin bzhin je nyung dang / dgra thob kyi gnag lcaḍa kyang nyin bzhin je nyung du 'gro gi 'dugalnga pa/ dgra thob kyi daros bo bgos brgyab pa'i skar/dpon rgyal sras kyang gnang brgas rgyag par gdan zhu byas te brga rgyu'i dngos po'i grangs/ brga yul dmag mi'i grangs dang shor ma'i grangs thor ma so so'i thor tshad che chung / skal 'thob thog dmigayobasal gyi skal 'apar ji 'jos dmag thog mi gsod mkhan la sdig gla sprod rgyu sogs gang 'gab gros sdur skabs dgra thob kyi ca lag smos ci/ byugs zog kyang sko ga tu dum gcod kyis mang che batshang med par brten dmag mi rnam4dmag mda' rga tshoms byas pa'i 'og tu 'dzul ste rgyu nor lkog khyer yod med mna' skyel du bcug kyang khas len byed mkhan ha lam byung med pa red/ sdig gla'i skor ri ba'i dpon spun gnyis gsod mkhan dmar ru'i tshab thi bsod grags dang / brdal tshen rkang tha'i ju mur dasa' bde/ gang che'i thog med gsum pos nga yin kho yin zer ba dang /'brog shog gi mi grags dang / dmag mi mang che bas ga rgya 'gram nag gi / bsad yod pa gtan 'khel ma byas na hor gyi la rgya dang ga rgya'i snyan gra0sa la gnod nges re da ces kyang bshad pa red/ ga rgya'i a phrug 'ga' 153

res ri ba spun gnyis dngos su gsod sar med kyang ga rgya dpon 'khor byang khog rong du sus kyang lcebs ma phod par phyugs zog 'bor chen de— tsam ded nas yong ba dang / ri ba spun gnyis kyang bros mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan a bus me mda' brgyab nas rmas pa red ces zer nas sdig sdig 'donagyi yod pa red/ g.yul sa'i thog tu mi dngos su bsad pa bcu gcig las byung med rung ngas bsad khos bsad zer mkhan grangs 'bor de las brga la gyi yod pa red/ don dngos thog ga rgyas bsad pa mi gsum dang /a khi nged gnyis kyis bsad pa mi gnyis rgang gsal ju mur dga' bde can mi gsum gyis bsad pa'i ri ba spun gnyis/ me mda' mnyam 'khel gyi nang sus bsad nges med mi bzhi/ da dung rga thos la chu'i nang du lcebasapa 'am/ bros nas chu brgal ma thub pa shi ba'i mi grangs sdom na nyi shu skorayod skad 'dug 'brog shog gi mi rta lnga bsad shor ba dang / mi gcig rmas pa las gzhan skyon mi 'dug dang thog dpon rgyal sras la gnang bud 'os 'tshams bzhag rjes dgra thob drag chas dang / 'bri bzhonam nyi shu skor/ ga rgya la che skal ba'ag pa dang / mi dngos su gsod mkhan rnams la sdeg gla sne sel tsam/ shor ma rnams la'ang rta tshab srab 'jal lta bu'i ming btags tsam/ de byings dmag dmangs la brgas par thob rgyu ha cang nyung nyung red/ dang thog nged gang che dang khang skor gnyis la skal thob cung mang ba sprod rtsis byasakyang / glan ne'i rga na chen o ma bkra this nas khang skor gyis dmag thog tu nus pa gang 154

yang bton med par dmigs bsal sprod mi 'os zer nas khang skor dang glan ne'i dbar lab gleng byung ba dang / khang skor gyi rgyab gang ches/ byas nas brtsod gleng byasakyang don 'bras ma byung ba red/ sngon du rdza sreb kyi mi'ilag nas khal ma nyi shu de ded pa bgos thob spyi 'dre zhig rag nas log song ba yin/ rje sa su 'brog shog gi gnang brga byed stangs de la 'brog shog g.yam thi ju nga rga na ca ca ma zer ba des shag rgyab bar/ dba' yod med ka gu'i ra bar shes/ khre0 yod med gnang brgas rgyab nyin shes/mna' yod med rga'og/ 'dzul nyin shes/ dpa' yod med med la pags phyed re zhes cog mang po yod pa brjed nas dran gyi mi 'dug rjes sor du tshod gang dazams song rjes sngon chad nas ri bas 'dzin khrid byas pa'i skar cha'i bu gro rgod zer ba ya nga pha yul du bros yong ba red/ de nas nga zung ngamangs gtso'i bcos sgyur bar lo nyi shu lhag la ri ba nas hor la —gra lam dang gyod lacha gang yang len nuca med pa red/ de'i skor ho ra rgyal snge ra/tshar dang ga rgya'i bar gnyen sgrigs bag ston skabs su hor lugs gtarnga grags pa sgra chen zer ba le tshan mang po zhig—shod sro' yo/da pa de 'i nang rta ra blon gtsang tsha bon gshen gyis 'babs gdan slog skabs ga rgya la che bsto da byasate lha sa btsan lcags nakar spu gu la/ ri ba mi yi spyang ki de/spyang kha shus byed mi ser po hor/ bu rta lcags kyi ser ba de/ lcags bzhu brdung byed rmi ga rgya bu zhes sogs mang du bshad pa red/153
